1709
1710def _pack_gf2_rows(matrix: Any) -> Tuple[Any, int]:
1711 """
1712 Packs a 2D binary matrix (scipy sparse, numpy array, array-like, or MatrixMarket file path; odd entries are 1,
1713 duplicate sparse entries summed mod 2) into a row-major np.uint64 array of shape (m, (n + 63) // 64), without
1714 allocating unpacked int64 copies (memory ~ m * n / 8 bytes). Returns (packed, n).
1715 """
1716 import numpy as np
1717 if isinstance(matrix, (str, Path)):
1718 if _qec_cert_mod is not None:
1719 from qec_cert import _lib as _qec_lib
1720 matrix = _qec_lib.mtx_read(str(matrix))
1721 else:
1722 import scipy.io
1723 try:
1724 matrix = scipy.io.mmread(str(matrix), spmatrix=False)
1725 except TypeError:
1726 matrix = scipy.io.mmread(str(matrix))
1727 if hasattr(matrix, "tocoo"):
1728 coo = matrix.tocoo(copy=False)
1729 m, n = int(coo.shape[0]), int(coo.shape[1])
1730 nw = (n + 63) >> 6
1731 packed = np.zeros((m, nw), dtype=np.uint64)
1732 if m == 0 or n == 0 or coo.nnz == 0:
1733 return packed, n
1734 data = np.asarray(coo.data)
1735 if data.dtype == np.bool_:
1736 mask = data
1737 elif np.issubdtype(data.dtype, np.integer):
1738 mask = (data & 1) != 0
1739 else:
1740 mask = np.fmod(np.trunc(data), 2.0) != 0
1741 r = np.asarray(coo.row[mask], dtype=np.intp)
1742 c = np.asarray(coo.col[mask], dtype=np.intp)
1743 if r.size:
1744 np.bitwise_xor.at(packed, (r, c >> 6), np.uint64(1) << np.uint64(c & 63))
1745 return packed, n
1746 a = matrix if isinstance(matrix, np.ndarray) else np.asarray(matrix)
1747 if a.ndim != 2:
1748 return np.zeros((0, 0), dtype=np.uint64), 0
1749 m, n = int(a.shape[0]), int(a.shape[1])
1750 nw = (n + 63) >> 6
1751 packed = np.zeros((m, nw), dtype=np.uint64)
1752 if m == 0 or n == 0:
1753 return packed, n
1754 for r0 in range(0, m, 1024):
1755 sub = a[r0:min(r0 + 1024, m)]
1756 if sub.dtype == np.bool_:
1757 bits = sub.view(np.uint8)
1758 elif np.issubdtype(sub.dtype, np.integer):
1759 bits = (sub & 1).astype(np.uint8, copy=False)
1760 else:
1761 bits = (np.fmod(np.trunc(sub), 2.0) != 0).astype(np.uint8)
1762 pb = np.packbits(bits, axis=1, bitorder="little")
1763 rem_b = pb.shape[1] & 7
1764 if rem_b:
1765 pb = np.pad(pb, ((0, 0), (0, 8 - rem_b)))
1766 packed[r0:r0 + pb.shape[0]] = np.ascontiguousarray(pb).view(np.uint64)
1767 return packed, n
1768
1769
1770def _gf2_echelon(packed: Any) -> Tuple[int, List[int]]:
1771 """
1772 In-place upper-triangular GF(2) row elimination over bit-packed np.uint64 words using sparse-aware 8-bit
1773 Four-Russians panels. Returns (rank, pivots), where packed[i] (0 <= i < rank) has 1 in column pivots[i] and 0 in
1774 pivots[0..i-1], and rows rank..m-1 are zero.
1775 """
1776 import numpy as np
1777 m, nw = packed.shape
1778 rank = 0
1779 pivots: List[int] = []
1780 w = 0
1781 while w < nw and rank < m:
1782 cw = packed[rank:, w].copy()
1783 if not np.any(cw):
1784 w += 1
1785 continue
1786 p_bits: List[int] = []
1787 while len(p_bits) < 8 and rank + len(p_bits) < m:
1788 j = len(p_bits)
1789 nz = np.flatnonzero(cw[j:])
1790 if nz.size == 0:
1791 break
1792 rel = j + int(nz[0])
1793 if rel != j:
1794 cw[j], cw[rel] = cw[rel], cw[j]
1795 tmp = packed[rank + j, w:].copy()
1796 packed[rank + j, w:] = packed[rank + rel, w:]
1797 packed[rank + rel, w:] = tmp
1798 orig_w = int(packed[rank + j, w])
1799 for i in range(j):
1800 if (orig_w >> p_bits[i]) & 1:
1801 packed[rank + j, w:] ^= packed[rank + i, w:]
1802 v = int(packed[rank + j, w])
1803 b = (v & -v).bit_length() - 1
1804 for i in range(j):
1805 if (int(packed[rank + i, w]) >> b) & 1:
1806 packed[rank + i, w:] ^= packed[rank + j, w:]
1807 p_bits.append(b)
1808 pivots.append((w << 6) + b)
1809 if j + 1 < cw.size:
1810 cw[j + 1:] ^= ((cw[j + 1:] >> np.uint64(b)) & np.uint64(1)) * np.uint64(v)
1811 k = len(p_bits)
1812 rem = rank + k
1813 if rem < m:
1814 sub_w = packed[rem:, w]
1815 idx = ((sub_w >> np.uint64(p_bits[0])) & np.uint64(1)).astype(np.intp)
1816 for i in range(1, k):
1817 idx |= (((sub_w >> np.uint64(p_bits[i])) & np.uint64(1)).astype(np.intp)) << i
1818 nz_rows = np.flatnonzero(idx)
1819 if nz_rows.size:
1820 if nz_rows.size <= 4 or k == 1:
1821 for i in range(k):
1822 hit = nz_rows[((idx[nz_rows] >> i) & 1) != 0]
1823 if hit.size:
1824 packed[rem + hit, w:] ^= packed[rank + i, w:]
1825 else:
1826 table = np.zeros((1 << k, nw - w), dtype=np.uint64)
1827 for i in range(k):
1828 step = 1 << i
1829 table[step:2 * step] = table[:step] ^ packed[rank + i, w:]
1830 for c0 in range(0, nz_rows.size, 1024):
1831 rows_c = nz_rows[c0:c0 + 1024]
1832 packed[rem + rows_c, w:] ^= table[idx[rows_c]]
1833 rank += k
1834 return rank, pivots
1835
1836
1837def _gf2_rank(matrix: Any) -> int:
1838 """The rank over GF(2) of a matrix (a numpy array, array-like, scipy sparse matrix, or MatrixMarket file; odd
1839 entries are 1), computed over bit-packed uint64 rows (or qec_cert._lib.rank on small inputs when loaded)."""
1840 if _qec_cert_mod is not None and hasattr(matrix, "shape") and len(matrix.shape) == 2:
1841 m, n = int(matrix.shape[0]), int(matrix.shape[1])
1842 if m == 0 or n == 0:
1843 return 0
1844 if m * n <= 4_000_000:
1845 try:
1846 from qec_cert import _lib as _qec_lib
1847 return int(_qec_lib.rank(matrix))
1848 except Exception:
1849 pass
1850 packed, n = _pack_gf2_rows(matrix)
1851 if packed.shape[0] == 0 or n <= 0:
1852 return 0
1853 return _gf2_echelon(packed)[0]
1854
1855
1856def _matrix_shape_2d(M: Any) -> Optional[Tuple[int, int]]:
1857 """Returns (rows, cols) of a matrix or MatrixMarket header without reading all entries, or None if unknown."""
1858 if isinstance(M, (str, Path)):
1859 try:
1860 with open(str(M), "r") as f:
1861 first = f.readline().strip().lower().split()
1862 if len(first) < 5 or first[0] != "%%matrixmarket":
1863 return None
1864 for ln in f:
1865 s = ln.strip()
1866 if s and not s.startswith("%"):
1867 parts = s.split()
1868 return (int(parts[0]), int(parts[1])) if len(parts) >= 2 else None
1869 except Exception:
1870 return None
1871 return None
1872 if hasattr(M, "shape"):
1873 sh = M.shape
1874 return (int(sh[0]), int(sh[1])) if len(sh) == 2 else (0, 0)
1875 return None
1876
1877
1878def _k0_of_matrices(H: Any, G: Any = None, L: Any = None, classical: bool = False) -> bool:
1879 """
1880 Whether a code given by matrices (or MatrixMarket files) has no logical codeword (k = 0): a classical code with
1881 rank H = n (false immediately when m < n), a quantum code with n = rank H + rank G, or with no row of L independent
1882 of the rows of H (k = rank([H; L]) - rank(H) == 0, reduced in a single bit-packed elimination; also an empty or
1883 zero L). Used on the codedistance paths (the binary and qec_cert find it themselves, since version 0.17.2).
1884 """
1885 import numpy as np
1886 if H is None:
1887 return False
1888 try:
1889 sh_h = _matrix_shape_2d(H)
1890 if sh_h is not None:
1891 m_h, n = sh_h
1892 if n <= 0:
1893 return False
1894 if classical and m_h < n:
1895 return False
1896 if not classical and G is not None:
1897 sh_g = _matrix_shape_2d(G)
1898 if sh_g is not None and m_h + sh_g[0] < n:
1899 return False
1900 if not classical and G is None and L is not None:
1901 # Pack L first: empty or zero L gives k = 0 immediately without packing H.
1902 l_packed, n_l = _pack_gf2_rows(L)
1903 if l_packed.shape[0] == 0 or not np.any(l_packed):
1904 if sh_h is None:
1905 _, n = _pack_gf2_rows(H)
1906 return n > 0
1907 h_packed, n = _pack_gf2_rows(H)
1908 if n <= 0:
1909 return False
1910 if l_packed.shape[1] != h_packed.shape[1]:
1911 if l_packed.size == 0:
1912 return True
1913 l_arr = np.asarray(L.toarray() if hasattr(L, "toarray") else L).reshape(-1, n)
1914 l_packed, _ = _pack_gf2_rows(l_arr)
1915 if not np.any(l_packed):
1916 return True
1917 if h_packed.shape[0] == 0:
1918 return False
1919 r_h, pivots = _gf2_echelon(h_packed)
1920 if r_h == n:
1921 return True
1922 for j in range(l_packed.shape[0]):
1923 v = l_packed[j]
1924 for i in range(r_h):
1925 c = pivots[i]
1926 w = c >> 6
1927 if (int(v[w]) >> (c & 63)) & 1:
1928 v[w:] ^= h_packed[i, w:]
1929 if np.any(v):
1930 return False
1931 return True
1932 h_packed, n = _pack_gf2_rows(H)
1933 if n <= 0:
1934 return False
1935 m_h = h_packed.shape[0]
1936 if classical:
1937 return False if m_h < n else (_gf2_echelon(h_packed)[0] == n)
1938 if G is not None:
1939 g_packed, n_g = _pack_gf2_rows(G)
1940 if n_g != n or m_h + g_packed.shape[0] < n:
1941 return False
1942 r_h = _gf2_echelon(h_packed)[0]
1943 if r_h + g_packed.shape[0] < n:
1944 return False
1945 return r_h + _gf2_echelon(g_packed)[0] == n
1946 except Exception: # (an unreadable input: left to the solver)
1947 return False
1948 return False
1949
1950
1951def _to_binary_csr(matrix: Any) -> Any:
1952 """
1953 Converts a 2D binary matrix (MatrixMarket file path, SciPy sparse matrix/array, NumPy array, or array-like)
1954 to a canonical binary `scipy.sparse.csr_matrix` (dtype uint8, odd entries are 1, duplicate entries summed mod 2).
1955 """
1956 import numpy as np
1957 import scipy.sparse as sp
1958 if isinstance(matrix, (str, Path)):
1959 import scipy.io
1960 try:
1961 matrix = scipy.io.mmread(str(matrix), spmatrix=False)
1962 except TypeError:
1963 matrix = scipy.io.mmread(str(matrix))
1964 m, n, rows, cols = _gf2_entries(matrix)
1965 return sp.csr_matrix((np.ones(len(rows), dtype=np.uint8), (rows, cols)), shape=(m, n))
1966
1967
1968def _gf2_logicals_from_hg(H: Any, G: Any, ortho: bool = True) -> Any:
1969 """
1970 Constructs a binary CSR logical operator matrix `L` over GF(2) from parity-check matrix `H` and degeneracy
1971 generator `G`, matching `Lx_for_CSS_code()` in `src/util_m4ri.c`: the rows of `L` lie in `ker(G)` (so
1972 `G L^T = 0`) and span a complement of `rowspace(H)` inside `rowspace(H) + ker(G)`. For any `e` in `ker(H)`,
1973 `L e != 0` iff `e` is not in `rowspace(G)`. If `ortho=True` (default), checks `H G^T = 0 (mod 2)` and raises
1974 RuntimeError otherwise.
1975 """
1976 import numpy as np
1977 import scipy.sparse as sp
1978 H_csr = _to_binary_csr(H)
1979 G_csr = _to_binary_csr(G)
1980 n = int(H_csr.shape[1])
1981 if int(G_csr.shape[1]) != n:
1982 raise ValueError(f"H has {n} columns and G has {int(G_csr.shape[1])} columns")
1983 if ortho and H_csr.nnz and G_csr.nnz:
1984 prod = H_csr.astype(np.int32) @ G_csr.T.astype(np.int32)
1985 if prod.nnz and np.any(prod.data & 1):
1986 raise RuntimeError("rows of H and G matrices are not orthogonal")
1987 if n == 0:
1988 return sp.csr_matrix((0, 0), dtype=np.uint8)
1989 g_packed, _ = _pack_gf2_rows(G_csr)
1990 r_g, piv_g = _gf2_echelon(g_packed)
1991 for i in range(r_g - 1, 0, -1): # back-substitution to full RREF of G
1992 c = piv_g[i]
1993 w, bit = c >> 6, np.uint64(1) << np.uint64(c & 63)
1994 hit = np.flatnonzero((g_packed[:i, w] & bit) != 0)
1995 if hit.size:
1996 g_packed[hit, w:] ^= g_packed[i, w:]
1997 piv_set = set(piv_g)
1998 free_cols = [c for c in range(n) if c not in piv_set]
1999 if not free_cols:
2000 return sp.csr_matrix((0, n), dtype=np.uint8)
2001 nw = (n + 63) >> 6
2002 n_free = len(free_cols)
2003 ker_supports: List[List[int]] = []
2004 V = np.zeros((n_free, nw), dtype=np.uint64)
2005 for idx, f in enumerate(free_cols):
2006 wf, bitf = f >> 6, np.uint64(1) << np.uint64(f & 63)
2007 piv_hits = np.flatnonzero((g_packed[:r_g, wf] & bitf) != 0) if r_g else np.empty(0, dtype=np.intp)
2008 supp = [piv_g[int(i)] for i in piv_hits]
2009 supp.append(f)
2010 supp.sort()
2011 ker_supports.append(supp)
2012 c_arr = np.asarray(supp, dtype=np.intp)
2013 np.bitwise_xor.at(V[idx], c_arr >> 6, np.uint64(1) << np.uint64(c_arr & 63))
2014 h_packed, _ = _pack_gf2_rows(H_csr)
2015 r_h, piv_h = _gf2_echelon(h_packed)
2016 for i in range(r_h): # reduce all ker(G) basis vectors modulo rowspace(H)
2017 c = piv_h[i]
2018 w, bit = c >> 6, np.uint64(1) << np.uint64(c & 63)
2019 hit = np.flatnonzero((V[:, w] & bit) != 0)
2020 if hit.size:
2021 V[hit, w:] ^= h_packed[i, w:]
2022 nz_idx = np.flatnonzero(np.any(V, axis=1))
2023 basis: List[Tuple[int, Any]] = []
2024 l_rows: List[int] = []
2025 l_cols: List[int] = []
2026 out_r = 0
2027 for idx in nz_idx.tolist():
2028 v = V[idx]
2029 for p, brow in basis:
2030 if (int(v[p >> 6]) >> (p & 63)) & 1:
2031 v ^= brow
2032 nz_w = np.flatnonzero(v)
2033 if nz_w.size:
2034 w0 = int(nz_w[0])
2035 word = int(v[w0])
2036 b0 = (word & -word).bit_length() - 1
2037 basis.append(((w0 << 6) + b0, v.copy()))
2038 supp = ker_supports[idx]
2039 l_rows.extend([out_r] * len(supp))
2040 l_cols.extend(supp)
2041 out_r += 1
2042 return sp.csr_matrix((np.ones(len(l_rows), dtype=np.uint8), (l_rows, l_cols)), shape=(out_r, n))
2043
2044
2045def _dem_to_hl_csr(dem: Any, pmin: float = 0.0) -> Tuple[Any, Any]:
2046 """
2047 Exports a DEM (a stim.DetectorErrorModel, .dem file, or DEM text) after probability cutoff `pmin` into merged,
2048 zero-column-stripped binary CSR matrices `(H, L)` over GF(2) (matching `_dem_k0()`).
2049 """
2050 import numpy as np
2051 import scipy.sparse as sp
2052 cols = _dem_error_columns(dem, pmin=pmin)
2053 seen: Set[Tuple[frozenset, frozenset]] = set()
2054 h_r: List[int] = []
2055 h_c: List[int] = []
2056 l_r: List[int] = []
2057 l_c: List[int] = []
2058 max_d = max_o = -1
2059 out_c = 0
2060 for dets, obs in cols:
2061 if not dets and not obs:
2062 continue
2063 key = (dets, obs)
2064 if key in seen:
2065 continue
2066 seen.add(key)
2067 for d in dets:
2068 if d > max_d:
2069 max_d = d
2070 h_r.append(d)
2071 h_c.append(out_c)
2072 for o in obs:
2073 if o > max_o:
2074 max_o = o
2075 l_r.append(o)
2076 l_c.append(out_c)
2077 out_c += 1
2078 n_det = max(max_d + 1, 1) if out_c > 0 else 0
2079 n_obs = max_o + 1 if l_r else 0
2080 H = sp.csr_matrix((np.ones(len(h_r), dtype=np.uint8), (h_r, h_c)), shape=(n_det, out_c))
2081 L = sp.csr_matrix((np.ones(len(l_r), dtype=np.uint8), (l_r, l_c)), shape=(n_obs, out_c))
2082 return H, L
2083
2084
2085def _verify_matrix_witness(H_csr: Any, L_csr: Any, witness: Any, classical: bool = False) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
2086 """
2087 Independently verifies that `witness` (0-based column indices) is a valid non-trivial codeword: non-empty,
2088 distinct indices in `[0, n)`, `H x = 0 (mod 2)`, and (when `not classical`) `L x != 0 (mod 2)`.
2089 """
2090 import numpy as np
2091 if not isinstance(witness, (list, tuple)) or not witness:
2092 return False, "empty witness"
2093 ncols = int(H_csr.shape[1])
2094 cols: List[int] = []
2095 seen: Set[int] = set()
2096 for c in witness:
2097 if isinstance(c, bool) or not isinstance(c, numbers.Integral):
2098 return False, f"non-integer column index {c!r}"
2099 ic = int(c)
2100 if ic < 0 or ic >= ncols:
2101 return False, f"column index {ic} out of range [0, {ncols})"
2102 if ic in seen:
2103 return False, f"duplicate column index {ic}"
2104 seen.add(ic)
2105 cols.append(ic)
2106 syn_h = np.asarray(H_csr[:, cols].sum(axis=1)).ravel() & 1
2107 if np.any(syn_h):
2108 return False, "H x != 0 (mod 2)"
2109 if not classical:
2110 if L_csr is None or L_csr.shape[0] == 0:
2111 return False, "L has no rows"
2112 syn_l = np.asarray(L_csr[:, cols].sum(axis=1)).ravel() & 1
2113 if not np.any(syn_l):
2114 return False, "L x == 0 (mod 2)"
2115 return True, ""

2134 (the locals() of a compute_*() function) which are not at their defaults (see _CODEDISTANCE_UNUSED).

2141def _warn_cert_ignored(cert_mode: str, finC: Any = None, smax: Optional[int] = None, dW: int = -1,

2143 """
2144 With engine='cert' or engine='tropidist' (cert_mode, see _resolve_cert_engine()): a warning (see _warn_ignored())
2145 on the options of the dist_m4ri binary which that external engine does not use: finC, smax > 0, dW >= 0, and
2146 maxC > 0 (and method=1 for engine='tropidist', which always runs its certifying pipeline; codeword output is an
2147 error, and outD, out_reduced, and the start list have their own warnings).
2148 """
2149 if cert_mode not in ("cert", "tropidist"):
2150 return
2151 names = [k for k, on in (("finC", bool(finC)), ("smax", smax is not None and smax > 0), ("dW", dW >= 0),
2152 ("maxC", maxC > 0)) if on]
2153 if cert_mode == "tropidist" and method == 1:
2154 names.append("method")
2155 if names:
2156 _warn_ignored(f"{', '.join(k + '=' for k in names)}: not used with engine='{cert_mode}'; ignored")

2277def _parse_rw_opt(val: str, arg: str) -> int:

2279 s = str(val).strip()

2282 except ValueError:
2283 v = None
2284 if v is None or not -1 <= v <= 63:
2285 raise ValueError(f"invalid '{arg}': rw_opt should be -1 (automatic), 0 (off), or a bitmask 1 to 63 (also "
2286 f"0x...)")

2302def _check_kwargs(func: Callable[..., Any], kwargs: Dict[str, Any], aliases: Sequence[str] = ("win",)) -> None:
2303 """
2304 Raises TypeError for the keyword arguments in kwargs (the **kwargs of func) other than the accepted aliases
2305 (`win` for kwin), e.g., misspelled or unsupported options, with the closest parameter names as hints.
2306 """
2307 unknown = [k for k in kwargs if k not in aliases]
2308 if not unknown:
2309 return
2310 import difflib
2311 import inspect
2312 names = [n for n, p in inspect.signature(func).parameters.items() if p.kind is not inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD]
2313 names += list(aliases)
2314 items = []
2315 for k in unknown:
2316 close = difflib.get_close_matches(k, names, n=1)
2317 items.append(f"'{k}'" + (f" (did you mean '{close[0]}'?)" if close else ""))
2318 if len(items) == 1:
2319 raise TypeError(f"{func.__name__}() got an unexpected keyword argument {items[0]}")
2320 raise TypeError(f"{func.__name__}() got unexpected keyword arguments {', '.join(items)}")
2321

2323def _prepare_start_option(
2324 start: Any,
2325 trust_start: bool = False,
2326 noscan: Any = 0,
2327 cbeg: Any = None,
2328 cend: Any = None,
2329 solver: str = "dist_m4ri",
2330 start_scan: bool = False,
2331 engine_cert: Union[bool, str] = False
2332) -> Optional[List[int]]:
2333 """
2334 Validates the expert CC options of a compute_*_distance() call and issues the warnings to stderr (engine_cert:
2335 True/'cert' or 'tropidist', which run no CC: the start list is ignored with a warning instead of the warning on the
2336 validity of the CC lower bound).
2337
2338 Returns:
2339 The normalized start list (with the flag `scan` for start_scan, see _StartList), or None if unset (or not
2340 applicable to the selected solver).
2341 """
2342 _warn_disabled_options(noscan, cbeg, cend)
2343 start_list = _normalize_start_list(start)
2344 if start_list is None:
2345 if trust_start:
2346 _warn_ignored("trust_start=1 has no effect without a start list")
2347 if start_scan:
2348 _warn_ignored("start_scan=1 has no effect without a start list")
2349 return None
2350 if solver == "codedistance" or engine_cert:
2351 if engine_cert:
2352 eng = engine_cert if isinstance(engine_cert, str) else "cert"
2353 name = f"engine='{eng}'"
2354 else:
2355 name = "solver='codedistance'"
2356 _warn_ignored(f"start={_format_start_list(start_list)} is ignored with {name}")
2357 return None
2358 start_list = _scan_start_list(start_list, start_scan)
2359 msg = _start_warning_text(start_list)
2360 if _use_distance_cache and trust_start:
2361 msg += "# trust_start=1: start-list results are accepted as valid and copied to the main cache record\n"
2362 elif _use_distance_cache:
2363 msg += (
2364 "# results are cached under a separate ':start=...' key; only dmax and codewords update the\n"
2365 "# main cache record (use trust_start=1 to also accept dmin)\n"
2366 )
2367 sys.stderr.write(msg)
2368 return start_list
2369
2370
2371def _seed_bounds_from_entry(eff_dmin: int, eff_dmax: int, entry: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Tuple[int, int]:
2372 """
2373 Tightens the bounds (eff_dmin, eff_dmax) with those stored in a cache entry (a CSS code is cached as the
2374 records of its two sectors, see _matrix_cache_key()).
2375 """
2376 if not entry:
2377 return eff_dmin, eff_dmax
2378 c_dmin = entry.get("dmin", 0) or 0
2379 c_dmax = entry.get("dmax", 0) or 0
2380 if c_dmax > 0:
2381 eff_dmax = min(eff_dmax, c_dmax) if eff_dmax > 0 else c_dmax
2382 if c_dmin > 1:
2383 eff_dmin = max(eff_dmin, c_dmin) if eff_dmin > 1 else c_dmin
2384 return eff_dmin, eff_dmax
2385
2386
2387def _union_cws(base: Optional[List[List[int]]], extra: Optional[List[List[int]]]) -> List[List[int]]:
2388 """Returns the union of two codeword lists (duplicates removed, sorted by weight)."""
2389 combined = [list(cw) for cw in (base or [])]
2390 seen = {tuple(cw) for cw in combined}
2391 for cw in (extra or []):
2392 t = tuple(cw)
2393 if t not in seen:
2394 combined.append(list(cw))
2395 seen.add(t)
2396 combined.sort(key=len)
2397 return combined
2398

2400def _dist_from_bounds(dmin: int, dmax: int) -> int:
2401 """The distance reported for the bounds [dmin, dmax]: dmin if exact or without an upper bound, otherwise dmax."""
2402 return dmin if (dmin == dmax or dmax == 0) else dmax

2404
2405def _single_entry_is_exact(entry: Dict[str, Any], need_cws: bool = False, dstop: int = 0) -> bool:
2406 """
2407 Cache hit test for a classical / quantum / DEM entry: the exact distance, or with the stop target dstop > 0 a
2408 lower bound dmin >= dstop (and codewords if needed).
2409 """
2410 c_dmin = entry.get("dmin", 0) or 0
2411 if not ((c_dmin > 0 and c_dmin == entry.get("dmax")) or (dstop > 0 and c_dmin >= dstop)):
2412 return False
2413 return (not need_cws) or bool(entry.get("cws"))

2416def _resolve_cert_engine(solver: str = "dist_m4ri", engine: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
2417 """
2418 Resolves the external engine delegation mode ('off', 'auto', 'cert', or 'tropidist') from `solver` and `engine`.
2419 Default ('dist_m4ri', engine=None) returns 'off'.
2420 """
2421 if engine is not None:
2422 e = str(engine).strip().lower()
2423 if e in ("", "dist_m4ri", "m4ri", "native", "off", "0", "false", "none"):
2424 return "off"
2425 if e == "auto":
2426 return "auto"
2427 if e in ("cert", "qec_cert", "qec-cert"):
2428 return "cert"
2429 if e == "tropidist":
2430 return "tropidist"
2431 if e == "codedistance":
2432 return "off"
2433 raise ValueError(f"invalid engine={engine!r}: expected 'dist_m4ri', 'auto', 'tropidist', 'cert', or "
2434 f"'codedistance'")
2435 s = str(solver or "dist_m4ri").strip().lower()
2436 if s in ("dist_m4ri", "codedistance"):
2437 return "off"
2438 if s == "auto":
2439 return "auto"
2440 if s in ("cert", "qec_cert", "qec-cert"):
2441 return "cert"
2442 if s == "tropidist":
2443 return "tropidist"
2444 raise ValueError(f"invalid solver={solver!r}: expected 'dist_m4ri', 'codedistance', 'auto', 'cert', or 'tropidist'")
2445
2446
2447def _auto_cert_eligible(
2448 *,
2449 method: int = 3,
2450 do_cws: bool = False,
2451 outC: Optional[str] = None,
2452 finC: Optional[str] = None,
2453 smax: Optional[int] = None,
2454 dW: int = -1,
2455 maxC: int = 0,
2456 start_list: Optional[List[int]] = None,
2457 outD: Optional[Any] = None,
2458 out_reduced: Optional[Any] = None,
2459 pmin: float = 0.0,
2460 classical: bool = False,
2461) -> bool:
2462 """
2463 engine='auto': whether a calculation may use qec_cert at all, without importing it: a distance-only method=3 call
2464 (no codeword enumeration do_cws / outC / dW / maxC, no finC, smax, start list, outD, out_reduced, or pmin > 0) of
2465 a quantum code, a CSS sector, or a DEM; never for a classical code (classical=True: the dist_m4ri binary is much
2466 faster there than the import of qec_cert alone, about 0.6 s).
2467 """
2468 if classical or do_cws or outC:
2469 return False
2470 return not (
2471 method != 3 or finC or (smax is not None and smax > 0) or dW >= 0 or maxC > 0
2472 or start_list is not None or outD or out_reduced or pmin > 0.0
2473 )
2474
2475
2476def _can_delegate_to_cert(
2477 mode: str,
2478 *,
2479 method: int = 3,
2480 do_cws: bool = False,
2481 outC: Optional[str] = None,
2482 finC: Optional[str] = None,
2483 smax: Optional[int] = None,
2484 dW: int = -1,
2485 maxC: int = 0,
2486 start_list: Optional[List[int]] = None,
2487 outD: Optional[Any] = None,
2488 out_reduced: Optional[Any] = None,
2489 pmin: float = 0.0,
2490 classical: bool = False,
2491) -> bool:
2492 """
2493 Whether a distance calculation should be delegated to `qec_cert`.
2494 In 'auto' mode, delegates only when safe (see _auto_cert_eligible(): no codeword enumeration, finC, smax, start
2495 list, outD, out_reduced, pmin > 0, single-sided method 1/2, or classical code) and `qec_cert` is usable; the
2496 compute_*() functions run the two-stage portfolio of engine='auto' (_auto_two_stage()) instead, which imports
2497 qec_cert only when its Stage B runs. In 'cert' mode, always (classical codes too; ImportError if qec_cert is not
2498 usable, see _get_qec_cert(); with pmin > 0, compute_dem_distance() certifies the DEM without the errors of
2499 probability < pmin, see _dem_pmin_cut()).
2500 """
2501 if mode == "off":
2502 return False
2503 if do_cws or outC:
2504 if mode == "cert":
2505 raise ValueError("Codeword extraction is not supported with engine='cert'; use solver='dist_m4ri'.")
2506 return False
2507 if mode == "auto":
2508 if not _auto_cert_eligible(method=method, finC=finC, smax=smax, dW=dW, maxC=maxC, start_list=start_list,
2509 outD=outD, out_reduced=out_reduced, pmin=pmin, classical=classical):
2510 return False
2511 return _has_qec_cert()
2512 if mode != "cert":
2513 return False
2514 _get_qec_cert()
2515 if outD or out_reduced:
2516 _warn_ignored("outD and out_reduced are only used with solver='dist_m4ri'; ignored")
2517 return True
2518
2519
2520def _can_delegate_to_tropidist(
2521 mode: str,
2522 *,
2523 do_cws: bool = False,
2524 outC: Optional[str] = None,
2525 outD: Optional[Any] = None,
2526 out_reduced: Optional[Any] = None,
2527) -> bool:
2528 """
2529 Whether a distance calculation should be delegated directly to `tropidist` (engine='tropidist').
2530 Raises ValueError for codeword extraction (do_cws / outC) and ImportError if `tropidist` is not configured.
2531 """
2532 if mode != "tropidist":
2533 return False
2534 if do_cws or outC:
2535 raise ValueError("Codeword extraction is not supported with engine='tropidist'; use solver='dist_m4ri'.")
2536 _get_tropidist_root()
2537 if outD or out_reduced:
2538 _warn_ignored("outD and out_reduced are only used with solver='dist_m4ri'; ignored")
2539 return True

2543 """Converts a matrix (file path, numpy array, or scipy sparse matrix) to a binary CSR matrix for qec_cert."""
2544 if M is None:

2551def _cert_is_conditional(cert: Any) -> bool:
2552 """Whether a qec_cert Certificate (or dict) has a conditional lower bound (e.g., unverified symmetry)."""
2553 get = cert.get if isinstance(cert, dict) else lambda k, d=None: getattr(cert, k, d)
2554 if get("status") == "conditional" or bool(get("lb_conditional", False)):
2555 return True
2556 for s in get("stages", ()) or ():
2557 if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("lb_conditional"):
2558 return True
2559 for r in get("reductions", ()) or ():
2560 if isinstance(r, dict) and (r.get("conditional") or (r.get("params") or {}).get("lb_conditional")):
2561 return True
2562 return False
2563
2564
2565def _cert_extract_bounds(cert: Any, certified_dmin: int = 1) -> Tuple[int, int]:
2566 """
2567 Extracts unconditional (dmin, dmax) from a qec_cert Certificate for dist_m4ri reporting and caching:
2568 - An exact result (dmin = dmax = d) only if status == 'exact', witness_verified is True, and not conditional.
2569 - For bounds, an upper bound dmax only if witness_verified is True, and a lower bound dmin only when
2570 status in ('exact', 'bounds', 'timeout') and not lb_conditional.
2571 A lower bound conditional only on lb_assumed_wmin <= certified_dmin is accepted (see _cert_wmin_discharged()).
2572 Such a lower bound which meets the verified upper bound gives the exact distance as well, e.g., of certify_dem() of
2573 qec_cert P0, which stops as soon as its lower bound meets a verified upper bound also from a floor wmin > 1, with
2574 the status 'bounds' (see _cert_handoff_kw()).
2575 """
2576 get = cert.get if isinstance(cert, dict) else lambda k, d=None: getattr(cert, k, d)
2577 status = str(get("status", "") or "")
2578 wit_ver = get("witness_verified") is True
2579 is_cond = _cert_is_conditional(cert)
2580 raw_lb = int(get("lower_bound") or 0)
2581 raw_ub = int(get("upper_bound") or 0)
2582 if is_cond and certified_dmin > 1 and _cert_wmin_discharged(cert, certified_dmin):
2583 is_cond = False
2584 if status == "exact" and wit_ver and not is_cond and raw_ub > 0 and raw_lb == raw_ub:
2585 return raw_ub, raw_ub
2586 c_ub = raw_ub if (wit_ver and raw_ub > 0) else 0
2587 c_lb = raw_lb if (status in ("exact", "bounds", "timeout") and not is_cond and raw_lb > 1) else 0
2588 if c_ub > 0 and c_lb > c_ub:
2589 c_lb = c_ub
2590 return c_lb, c_ub
2591
2592
2593def _cert_search_no_symmetry(d: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
2594 """
2595 Whether a search stage of qec_cert (or the params of its cc_mitm_search reduction) used no symmetry and no trusted
2596 input: every column an anchor (sym_kind 'unknown', not verified, and none of the rules sym_anchors, schreier,
2597 centroid, trust_sym, trust_quot), e.g., with no symmetry found or more than max_sym_cols columns. qec_cert marks
2598 such a search lb_conditional only for the caller's floor wmin > 1 (unless trust_sym or trust_quot is passed, which
2599 dist_m4ri does not do). A symmetry file, also one of kind 'unknown' (version 1), always sets the rule
2600 sym_anchors, and an unverified symmetry or quotient file is used only with trust_sym or trust_quot (as checked in
2601 src/search/driver.c, sym.c, and quot.c of qec_cert).
2602 """
2603 rules = d.get("rules")
2604 if not isinstance(rules, (list, tuple)) or d.get("sym_kind") != "unknown" or bool(d.get("sym_verified")):
2605 return False
2606 return not {"sym_anchors", "schreier", "centroid", "trust_sym", "trust_quot"} & {str(r) for r in rules}
2607
2608
2609def _cert_wmin_discharged(cert: Any, certified_dmin: int) -> bool:
2610 """
2611 True iff the certificate's conditionality is caused solely by an assumed lower bound
2612 lb_assumed_wmin <= certified_dmin (already certified in _distance_cache), with no trust
2613 flags, no precondition violation, and no other conditional stage or reduction.
2614
2615 A conditional search must have a verified symmetry (or verified polymer pinning), or no symmetry at all (since
2616 version 0.17.0, see _cert_search_no_symmetry()). A floor certified for a DEM is not one of its relaxations, whose
2617 distance may be smaller (d(P_1) <= d(DEM), Sec. 4-5 of doc/soundness_circuits.md of qec-cert), although
2618 certify_dem() searches them from the same wmin: since version 0.17.4, a conditional lower bound above
2619 certified_dmin of the P_1 projection (stage and reduction p1_projection_lb) is accepted only with the exact
2620 zero-solve sandwich (stage zero_solve_sandwich 'exact', where d(P_1) = d(DEM), Theorem 3.2 there), and one of the
2621 spacetime folding (stage fold_mod_<p>, reduction capped_spacetime_folding) never.
2622 """
2623 if certified_dmin <= 1:
2624 return False
2625 get = cert.get if isinstance(cert, dict) else lambda k, d=None: getattr(cert, k, d)
2626 if get("status") == "conditional" or bool(get("precondition_violated", False)):
2627 return False
2628 if bool(get("trust_sym", False)) or bool(get("trust_quot", False)):
2629 return False
2630 inst = get("instance", None)
2631 inst_d = inst if isinstance(inst, dict) else {}
2632 if (
2633 bool(inst_d.get("trust_sym", False))
2634 or bool(inst_d.get("trust_quot", False))
2635 or bool(inst_d.get("precondition_violated", False))
2636 ):
2637 return False
2638 assumed_wmin = int(get("lb_assumed_wmin", None) or inst_d.get("lb_assumed_wmin", 0) or 0)
2639 if not (1 < assumed_wmin <= certified_dmin):
2640 return False
2641 sectors = inst_d.get("sectors")
2642 if isinstance(sectors, dict):
2643 for sec in sectors.values():
2644 if _cert_is_conditional(sec) and not _cert_wmin_discharged(sec, certified_dmin):
2645 return False
2646 stages = get("stages", ()) or ()
2647 pinned_ok = any(
2648 isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("name") == "polymer_pinning" and s.get("shift_verified") is True
2649 for s in stages
2650 )
2651 sand_exact = any(
2652 isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("name") == "zero_solve_sandwich" and s.get("status") == "exact" for s in stages
2653 )
2654 for s in stages:
2655 if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("lb_conditional"):
2656 sname = str(s.get("name", "") or "")
2657 if bool(s.get("trust_sym", False)) or bool(s.get("trust_quot", False)):
2658 return False
2659 if sname == "search":
2660 sym_ok = bool(s.get("sym_verified", True)) or (
2661 s.get("sym_kind") == "pinned" and pinned_ok
2662 ) or _cert_search_no_symmetry(s)
2663 if not sym_ok:
2664 return False
2665 elif sname == "p1_projection_lb" or sname.startswith("fold_mod_"):
2666 # (a relaxation of a DEM, searched from its floor: its bound only up to certified_dmin)
2667 if int(s.get("lb", 0) or 0) > certified_dmin and not (sand_exact and sname == "p1_projection_lb"):
2668 return False
2669 else:
2670 return False
2671 reductions = get("reductions", ()) or ()
2672 pinned_red_ok = pinned_ok or any(
2673 isinstance(r, dict)
2674 and r.get("name") == "polymer_pinning"
2675 and (r.get("params") or {}).get("shift_verified") is True
2676 for r in reductions
2677 )
2678 for r in reductions:
2679 if not isinstance(r, dict):
2680 continue
2681 rp = r.get("params") or {}
2682 if r.get("conditional"):
2683 return False
2684 if rp.get("lb_conditional"):
2685 rname = str(r.get("name", "") or "")
2686 if rname == "cc_mitm_search":
2687 sym_ok = bool(rp.get("sym_verified", True)) or (
2688 rp.get("sym_kind") == "pinned" and pinned_red_ok
2689 ) or _cert_search_no_symmetry(rp)
2690 wmin_r = int(rp.get("wmin", 0) or 0)
2691 if not sym_ok or (wmin_r > certified_dmin):
2692 return False
2693 elif not (rname == "p1_projection_lb" and sand_exact): # (raised the bound: see the stages)
2694 return False
2695 return True
2696
2697
2698def _qec_cert_has_force_dom(qec_pipeline: Any) -> bool:
2699 """
2700 Whether qec_cert (its module pipeline: qec_pipeline) has the search option force_dom (see _cert_search_kw()): its
2701 certify() takes the parameter search_opts (which certify_dem() and certify_circuit() forward to it in **kwargs),
2702 and its search kernel has the option force_dom (qec_cert.search.OPTION_NAMES). False for an older qec_cert, or
2703 one which cannot be inspected; it is then called as before.
2704 """
2705 try:
2706 import importlib
2707 import inspect
2708 if "search_opts" not in inspect.signature(qec_pipeline.certify).parameters:
2709 return False
2710 pkg = getattr(qec_pipeline, "__package__", None) or "qec_cert"
2711 return "force_dom" in getattr(importlib.import_module(pkg + ".search"), "OPTION_NAMES", ())
2712 except Exception:
2713 return False
2714
2715
2716def _cert_search_kw(qec_pipeline: Any, wmin: int, search_opts: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, *,
2717 search: bool = True, debug: int = 0, verbose: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2718 """
2719 The keyword argument search_opts of a call of qec_cert (certify(), certify_dem(), or certify_circuit() of
2720 qec_pipeline) with the floor wmin (since version 0.17.4): {"search_opts": {...}}, or {} if there is nothing to
2721 pass (the call is then as before).
2722
2723 qec_cert switches off the stabilizer half-weight dominance of its search with a floor wmin > 1 (its default
2724 force_dom = int(wmin == 1), unless search_opts sets force_dom), which slowed Stage B of engine='auto' down (e.g.,
2725 bb_360 at 64 threads: 7.25-8.80 s in Stage B, against 2.26 s for engine='cert', which starts from wmin=1). Yet the
2726 rule is sound whenever wmin is a certified lower bound (Sec. 8 of doc/soundness_search.md of qec-cert): like the
2727 other pruning rules of the search, it drops a codeword of weight W only if one of weight < W exists. The floor of
2728 dist_m4ri is always certified (the dmin of a cache record, or the certified_dmin of Stage A, see
2729 _cert_code_distance()), so with wmin > 1, force_dom=1 is merged into a copy of search_opts, unless search_opts sets
2730 force_dom already (an explicit choice is kept). With wmin <= 1, the default of qec_cert (dominance on) is left
2731 alone; so it is with search=False, for a call which runs no search (mode='ub'). A classical code has no
2732 stabilizer dominance (its call does not use this function). For a DEM, certify_dem() also searches relaxations of
2733 it (the P_1 projection, folding) from wmin, where this floor may not hold; their conditional lower bounds above the
2734 floor are not accepted (see _cert_wmin_discharged()), so dominance there cannot change an accepted lower bound.
2735 An older qec_cert without the option (see _qec_cert_has_force_dom()) is called as before. With verbose or the
2736 debug bit PY_DBG_COMMANDS, a note says which. Since version 0.17.5, the calls of qec_cert get it from
2737 _cert_handoff_kw(), together with the handoff parameters.
2738 """
2739 opts = dict(search_opts or {})
2740 if search and wmin > 1 and "force_dom" not in opts:
2741 say = verbose or bool(debug & PY_DBG_COMMANDS)
2742 if _qec_cert_has_force_dom(qec_pipeline):
2743 opts["force_dom"] = 1
2744 if say:
2745 print(f"[dist_m4ri] qec_cert: search option force_dom=1 with the certified floor wmin={wmin} (its "
2746 f"stabilizer dominance stays on)")
2747 elif say:
2748 print(f"[dist_m4ri] qec_cert: no search option force_dom (an older version): its stabilizer dominance is "
2749 f"off with the floor wmin={wmin} > 1")
2750 return {"search_opts": opts} if opts else {}
2751
2752
2753# The keyword parameters of the handoff to qec_cert which dist_m4ri may pass (since version 0.17.5, see
2754# _cert_handoff_kw()): the known upper bound (dmax_init), and the codeword of that weight found by the binary, as its
2755# JSON summary (from_dm4ri) or as a list of 0-based columns (ub_witness, with ub_witness_base=0). The floor_hint of
2756# qec_cert is not passed: the floor is wmin, as before.
2757_QEC_CERT_HANDOFF_PARAMS = ("dmax_init", "from_dm4ri", "ub_witness", "ub_witness_base")
2758_qec_cert_handoff_probed: Dict[int, Tuple[Any, frozenset]] = {} # id(function) -> (function, its handoff parameters)
2759
2760
2761def _qec_cert_handoff(qec_pipeline: Any, func: str = "certify") -> frozenset:
2762 """
2763 The handoff parameters (_QEC_CERT_HANDOFF_PARAMS) which the function func ('certify', 'certify_dem', or
2764 'certify_circuit') of qec_cert (its module pipeline: qec_pipeline) names in its signature (inspect.signature, once
2765 per function object; since version 0.17.5). A parameter accepted only by **kwargs does not count (certify_dem()
2766 forwards those to its own certify() calls, e.g., for the P_1 projection, where an upper bound or a codeword of the
2767 DEM does not hold), except that certify_circuit() with **kwargs has those of certify_dem(), to which it forwards
2768 them. Empty for an older qec_cert, or one which cannot be inspected: it is then called as before.
2769 """
2770 fn = getattr(qec_pipeline, func, None)
2771 if fn is None:
2772 return frozenset()
2773 hit = _qec_cert_handoff_probed.get(id(fn))
2774 if hit is not None and hit[0] is fn:
2775 return hit[1]
2776 try:
2777 import inspect
2778 params = inspect.signature(fn).parameters
2779 named = (inspect.Parameter.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD, inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY)
2780 have = frozenset(k for k, p in params.items() if k in _QEC_CERT_HANDOFF_PARAMS and p.kind in named)
2781 if func == "certify_circuit" and any(p.kind == inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD for p in params.values()):
2782 have |= _qec_cert_handoff(qec_pipeline, "certify_dem")
2783 except Exception:
2784 have = frozenset()
2785 _qec_cert_handoff_probed[id(fn)] = (fn, have) # (the function is kept: its id is not reused)
2786 return have
2787
2788
2789def _cert_handoff_kw(qec_pipeline: Any, wmin: int, search_opts: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, *,
2790 func: str = "certify", search: bool = True, dmax: int = 0,
2791 dm4ri_json: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, debug: int = 0,
2792 verbose: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2793 """
2794 The keyword arguments of a call of the function func ('certify', 'certify_dem', or 'certify_circuit') of qec_cert
2795 (its module pipeline: qec_pipeline) from the certified floor wmin (since version 0.17.5): wmin and search_opts, as
2796 before (see _cert_search_kw()), and the handoff parameters which func names in its signature (see
2797 _qec_cert_handoff(); none for an older qec_cert, which is called as before):
2798
2799 - dmax_init: the upper bound dmax of the call if dmax > wmin (the dmax of the caller or of the cache record, see
2800 _cert_code_distance(), e.g., dmax_A of Stage A in engine='auto'). qec_cert stops its exact search below it (as
2801 with wmax = dmax - 1, which the caller passes anyway) and reports it in its instance, but never as its upper
2802 bound without a verified codeword.
2803 - from_dm4ri: the JSON summary dm4ri_json (schema 'dm4ri-result/1') of the run of the binary in Stage A of
2804 engine='auto', with its codeword of weight dmax_A (see _auto_stage_a_witness()), whose 1-based original columns
2805 (witness.support) qec_cert imports: the columns of H for a quantum code or a CSS sector, and for certify_dem()
2806 the error mechanisms of the DEM in the order of its flattened text (repeat blocks unrolled; the first one of the
2807 equal columns merged by the binary; a codeword found with detectors dropped is one of the DEM). qec_cert
2808 verifies it itself (H x = 0 and L x != 0, for a DEM on its error mechanisms), and does not use it otherwise,
2809 see _cert_code_distance(); with the stop code 'rw_converged' of the binary (method=1 only: Stage A with
2810 method=3 ends by its time limit or the bounds), certify() also skips its Stage-1 Stern search. If func names
2811 ub_witness but not from_dm4ri, the codeword is passed as ub_witness instead, a sorted list of 0-based columns
2812 (with ub_witness_base=0 if func names it). Never for certify_circuit(), whose DEM is generated by qec_cert from
2813 the circuit: its error mechanisms need not be those of the DEM of the binary.
2814
2815 The floor stays wmin, as before: qec_cert searches from it (it would search the weights below it again from
2816 wmin=1), and its lower bound, conditional on lb_assumed_wmin = wmin, is accepted if wmin is certified (see
2817 _cert_wmin_discharged()); since its P0 version, certify_dem() also stops as soon as its lower bound meets a
2818 verified upper bound from wmin > 1, with the status 'bounds', whose bounds are then exact here (see
2819 _cert_extract_bounds()). The floor_hint of qec_cert is not passed: with the floor wmin, it would change nothing
2820 (qec_cert uses it only for the target max(lb, floor_hint) of its randomized upper-bound stages, where lb >= wmin,
2821 and to report a verified codeword below it, which it reports with wmin as precondition_violated). With verbose or
2822 the debug bit PY_DBG_COMMANDS, a note lists dmax_init and the codeword passed.
2823 """
2824 kw: Dict[str, Any] = {"wmin": wmin}
2825 kw.update(_cert_search_kw(qec_pipeline, wmin, search_opts, search=search, debug=debug, verbose=verbose))
2826 have = _qec_cert_handoff(qec_pipeline, func)
2827 if dmax > max(1, wmin) and "dmax_init" in have:
2828 kw["dmax_init"] = int(dmax)
2829 wit = dm4ri_json.get("witness") if (isinstance(dm4ri_json, dict) and func != "certify_circuit") else None
2830 if isinstance(wit, dict) and wit.get("available") is True:
2831 if "from_dm4ri" in have:
2832 kw["from_dm4ri"] = dm4ri_json
2833 elif "ub_witness" in have:
2834 kw["ub_witness"] = sorted(int(j) - 1 for j in wit.get("support") or ())
2835 if "ub_witness_base" in have:
2836 kw["ub_witness_base"] = 0
2837 if verbose or bool(debug & PY_DBG_COMMANDS):
2838 what = [f"dmax_init={kw['dmax_init']}"] if "dmax_init" in kw else []
2839 for k in ("from_dm4ri", "ub_witness"):
2840 if k in kw:
2841 what.append(f"{k} (the codeword of weight {wit.get('weight')} found by dist_m4ri in Stage A)")
2842 if what:
2843 print(f"[dist_m4ri] qec_cert {func}(): wmin={wmin}, {', '.join(what)}")
2844 return kw
2845
2846
2847def _cert_handoff_warnings(cert: Any, w_lo: int, label: str) -> None:
2848 """
2849 The warnings to stderr on a certificate of qec_cert from the floor w_lo certified by the binary (since version
2850 0.17.5, see _cert_code_distance()): qec_cert did not verify the codeword of the binary passed to it (see
2851 _cert_handoff_kw(): ub_witness_status 'invalid' or 'unreadable'; qec_cert warns itself as well, and runs as without
2852 it), or it found a verified codeword of weight below w_lo (which qec_cert reports as precondition_violated, or as
2853 floor_hint_contradicted with the floor passed as floor_hint), i.e., the two programs contradict each other.
2854 """
2855 get = cert.get if isinstance(cert, dict) else lambda k, d=None: getattr(cert, k, d)
2856 inst = get("instance", None)
2857 inst_d = inst if isinstance(inst, dict) else {}
2858 status = inst_d.get("ub_witness_status")
2859 if status in ("invalid", "unreadable"):
2860 err = inst_d.get("ub_witness_error")
2861 sys.stderr.write(f"# Warning: qec_cert did not verify the codeword found by dist_m4ri for the {label} distance "
2862 f"(ub_witness_status '{status}'{': ' + str(err) if err else ''}); it was not used: please "
2863 f"report this\n")
2864 try:
2865 ub = int(get("upper_bound") or 0)
2866 except (TypeError, ValueError):
2867 ub = 0
2868 if (get("witness_verified") is True and 0 < ub < w_lo) or inst_d.get("floor_hint_contradicted"):
2869 flags = [k for k in ("precondition_violated", "floor_hint_contradicted") if get(k, False) or inst_d.get(k)]
2870 sys.stderr.write(f"# Warning: qec_cert found a verified codeword of weight {ub} below the lower bound "
2871 f"{w_lo} certified by dist_m4ri for the {label} distance"
2872 f"{' (' + ', '.join(flags) + ')' if flags else ''}: please report this\n")
2873
2874
2875def _cert_code_distance(
2876 key_fn: Callable[[], str],
2877 run_cert_fn: Callable[[int, int, int], Any],
2878 *,
2879 label: str = "code",
2880 dmin: int = 0,
2881 dmax: int = 0,
2882 dstop: int = 0,
2883 wmax: int = 0,
2884 eff_cache_file: Optional[str] = None,
2885 debug: int = 0,
2886 verbose: bool = False,
2887 certified_dmin: int = 0,
2888 keep_stats: bool = False,
2889) -> Dict[str, Any]:
2890 """
2891 Runs a qec_cert certification callback with dist_m4ri cache lookup and safe cache write-back.
2892
2893 The callback run_cert_fn(wmin, wmax, dmax) gets wmin = max(1, d_cert), where d_cert is the certified lower bound:
2894 the dmin of the cache record, or certified_dmin (the dmin certified by the CC of the dist_m4ri binary in Stage A of
2895 engine='auto', also with the cache disabled; 0: none); wmax = dmax - 1 (or wmax, dstop - 1), with dmax tightened by
2896 the cache record, or 40 without any of them (qec_cert then searches no larger weight, but its stages which do not
2897 depend on wmax, e.g., the graphlike or rank-DP bounds, may still certify a larger distance); and this dmax if it is
2898 above wmin, otherwise 0 (since version 0.17.5: the callbacks of the compute_*() functions pass it to qec_cert as
2899 dmax_init, see _cert_handoff_kw(), so that it always agrees with wmax). A lower bound of qec_cert which is
2900 conditional only on its assumption lb_assumed_wmin <= d_cert is accepted, see _cert_wmin_discharged(). Since
2901 version 0.17.4, the callbacks of the compute_*() functions for quantum codes and DEMs pass
2902 search_opts={"force_dom": 1} with wmin > 1, so that qec_cert keeps the stabilizer dominance of its search on (see
2903 _cert_search_kw()). Since version 0.17.5, a warning is written to stderr if qec_cert does not verify the codeword
2904 of the binary passed to it by the callback, or if it finds a verified codeword below wmin (see
2905 _cert_handoff_warnings()). A caller's dmin is not certified here (since version 0.17.2): it is not passed as wmin
2906 (the lower bound of qec_cert would then be conditional on it), it only tightens the returned bounds (as the dmin of
2907 the binary, a known lower bound), and it is never cached. The statistics _last_run_stats are replaced by
2908 {"engine_cert": {...}} (the bounds of qec_cert "lb", "ub", "wmin", "wmax", "dmax" (the dmax of the callback), its
2909 run time "time", and "cached"; no run of the binary), unless keep_stats (engine='auto').
2910 """
2911 global _distance_cache, _last_run_stats
2912 if not keep_stats:
2913 _last_run_stats = {}
2914 code_key: Optional[str] = None
2915 entry: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
2916 eff_dmin, eff_dmax = dmin, dmax
2917 if _use_distance_cache:
2918 if eff_cache_file:
2919 load_distance_cache(eff_cache_file)
2920 code_key = key_fn()
2921 entry = _distance_cache.get(code_key)
2922 if entry is not None and _single_entry_is_exact(entry, need_cws=False, dstop=dstop):
2923 if verbose or (debug & PY_DBG_CACHE):
2924 c_dmin = entry.get("dmin", 0) or 0
2925 found = ("exact distance" if c_dmin == entry.get("dmax") else f"dmin={c_dmin} >= dstop={dstop}")
2926 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Cache hit for {label} distance ({found} known)!")
2927 if not keep_stats:
2928 _last_run_stats["engine_cert"] = {"cached": True}
2929 return {
2930 "dist": entry["dist"], "dmin": entry["dmin"], "dmax": entry["dmax"],
2931 "rw_steps": entry.get("rw_steps", 0), "d_info": list(entry["d_info"]),
2932 "cws": list(entry.get("cws", [])), "cached": True,
2933 }
2934 eff_dmin, eff_dmax = _seed_bounds_from_entry(eff_dmin, eff_dmax, entry)
2935 p_dmin = (entry.get("dmin", 0) or 0) if entry else 0
2936 w_lo = max(1, p_dmin, certified_dmin) # (not the caller's dmin: see above)
2937 w_hi = wmax if wmax > 0 else 40
2938 if eff_dmax > 0:
2939 w_hi = min(w_hi, max(1, eff_dmax - 1)) if wmax > 0 else max(1, eff_dmax - 1)
2940 if dstop > 0:
2941 w_hi = min(w_hi, max(1, dstop - 1)) if (wmax > 0 or eff_dmax > 0) else max(1, dstop - 1)
2942 dmax_init = eff_dmax if eff_dmax > w_lo else 0 # (not at or below the floor, e.g., a caller's inconsistent dmax)
2943 t_cert = time.monotonic()
2944 cert = run_cert_fn(w_lo, max(w_lo, w_hi), dmax_init)
2945 t_cert = time.monotonic() - t_cert
2946 c_get = cert.get if isinstance(cert, dict) else lambda k, d=None: getattr(cert, k, d)
2947 if str(c_get("status", "") or "") == "infeasible": # (qec_cert certified k = 0: no logical codeword)
2948 _note_k0("certified by qec_cert")
2949 _last_run_stats["k0"] = "certified by qec_cert"
2950 if not keep_stats:
2951 _last_run_stats["engine_cert"] = {"cached": False, "k0": True, "wmin": w_lo, "time": t_cert}
2952 return _k0_result((code_key,), eff_cache_file)
2953 _cert_handoff_warnings(cert, w_lo, label)
2954 c_lb, c_ub = _cert_extract_bounds(cert, max(p_dmin, certified_dmin))
2955 if not keep_stats:
2956 _last_run_stats["engine_cert"] = {"cached": False, "lb": c_lb, "ub": c_ub, "wmin": w_lo,
2957 "wmax": max(w_lo, w_hi), "dmax": dmax_init, "time": t_cert}
2958 p_dmax = (entry.get("dmax", 0) or 0) if entry else 0
2959 p_rw = (entry.get("rw_steps", 0) or 0) if entry else 0
2960 p_cws = list(entry.get("cws", [])) if entry else []
2961 cache_dmin = max(p_dmin, c_lb)
2962 cache_dmax = min(p_dmax, c_ub) if (p_dmax > 0 and c_ub > 0) else max(p_dmax, c_ub)
2963 if cache_dmax > 0 and cache_dmin > cache_dmax:
2964 cache_dmin = cache_dmax
2965 if _use_distance_cache and code_key is not None and (c_lb > 1 or c_ub > 0):
2966 record = _sector_record(cache_dmin, cache_dmax, p_rw, p_cws)
2967 if entry is not None and "dmin_model" in entry:
2968 record["dmin_model"] = entry["dmin_model"]
2969 if record != entry:
2970 _distance_cache[code_key] = record
2971 if eff_cache_file:
2972 save_distance_cache(eff_cache_file)
2973 dmin_res = max(eff_dmin, cache_dmin)
2974 pos_ub = [x for x in (eff_dmax, cache_dmax) if x > 0]
2975 dmax_res = min(pos_ub) if pos_ub else 0
2976 if dmax_res > 0 and dmin_res > dmax_res: # (a caller's dmin above an upper bound: only the certified one counts)
2977 dmin_res = min(cache_dmin, dmax_res)
2978 dist = _dist_from_bounds(dmin_res, dmax_res)
2979 return {
2980 "dist": dist, "dmin": dmin_res, "dmax": dmax_res, "rw_steps": p_rw,
2981 "d_info": format_bounds_list(dmin_res, dmax_res, p_rw), "cws": p_cws, "cached": False,
2982 }
2983
2984
2985def _kill_proc_group(proc: Any) -> None:
2986 """Terminates a subprocess started with `start_new_session=True`, escalating SIGTERM -> SIGKILL."""
2987 try:
2988 os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
2989 except OSError:
2990 try:
2991 proc.terminate()
2992 except OSError:
2993 pass
2994 try:
2995 proc.wait(timeout=2.0)
2996 return
2997 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
2998 pass
2999 try:
3000 os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
3001 except OSError:
3002 try:
3003 proc.kill()
3004 except OSError:
3005 pass
3006 try:
3007 proc.wait(timeout=2.0)
3008 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
3009 pass
3010
3011
3012def _tropidist_error_detail(rec: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
3013 """Extracts a concise one-line error description from a tropidist record."""
3014 notes = rec.get("notes")
3015 if isinstance(notes, str):
3016 try:
3017 parsed = json.loads(notes)
3018 if isinstance(parsed, dict):
3019 notes = parsed
3020 except ValueError:
3021 pass
3022 if isinstance(notes, dict):
3023 for key in ("error", "stop_reason"):
3024 if notes.get(key):
3025 return str(notes[key]).strip().splitlines()[0]
3026 if isinstance(notes, str) and notes.strip():
3027 return notes.strip().splitlines()[0]
3028 return f"status={rec.get('status')!r}"
3029
3030
3031def _run_tropidist(
3032 *,
3033 H_csr: Any = None,
3034 L_csr: Any = None,
3035 circuit: Any = None,
3036 w_lo: int = 1,
3037 w_hi: int = 40,
3038 threads: Optional[int] = None,
3039 timeout: Optional[float] = None,
3040 table_gb: Optional[int] = None,
3041 tropidist_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
3042 debug: int = 0,
3043 verbose: bool = False,
3044) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3045 """
3046 Runs `tropidist` (`python -m cdist`) in an isolated subprocess and returns its JSON record dict.
3047
3048 Passes `--config dp=2,kmin=...,kmax=...` (clamped to `1 <= kmin <= kmax <= 40` as required by
3049 `ours_pipeline.py`) and optionally `table_gb=N`. For Stim circuits, passes the `.stim` file directly so
3050 `tropidist` retains its native circuit relaxations and runs noiseless Stim witness replay; for matrices and
3051 standalone DEMs, writes MatrixMarket coordinate files and invokes `--matrices H.mtx L.mtx`.
3052 """
3053 import numpy as np
3054 import scipy.sparse as sp
3055 root = _get_tropidist_root(tropidist_root)
3056 kmax = min(max(1, int(w_hi)), 40)
3057 kmin = min(max(1, int(w_lo)), kmax)
3058 cfg_parts = ["dp=2", f"kmin={kmin}", f"kmax={kmax}"]
3059 if table_gb is not None:
3060 cfg_parts.append(f"table_gb={int(table_gb)}")
3061 n_thr = max(1, int(threads)) if threads else (os.cpu_count() or 8)
3062 t_lim = _auto_timeout(timeout)
3063 keep = bool(debug & PY_DBG_KEEP_FILES)
3064 tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dist_m4ri_tropidist_")
3065 if keep:
3066 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Keeping temporary tropidist directory: {tmp_dir}")
3067 try:
3068 out_json = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "record.json")
3069 cmd = [sys.executable, "-m", "cdist"]
3070 if circuit is not None:
3071 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)) and os.path.isfile(str(circuit)):
3072 stim_path = str(Path(circuit).resolve())
3073 else:
3074 stim_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "circuit.stim")
3075 with open(stim_path, "w") as f:
3076 f.write(str(circuit))
3077 cmd.append(stim_path)
3078 else:
3079 if H_csr is None or L_csr is None:
3080 raise ValueError("tropidist requires either a Stim circuit or both H and L matrices")
3081 h_write = H_csr
3082 if int(h_write.shape[0]) == 0:
3083 h_write = sp.csr_matrix((1, int(h_write.shape[1])), dtype=np.uint8)
3084 h_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "H.mtx")
3085 l_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "L.mtx")
3086 _write_mtx_gf2(h_path, h_write)
3087 _write_mtx_gf2(l_path, L_csr)
3088 cmd.extend(["--matrices", h_path, l_path])
3089 cmd.extend([
3090 "--out", out_json,
3091 "--threads", str(n_thr),
3092 "--time-limit", f"{t_lim:g}",
3093 "--config", ",".join(cfg_parts),
3094 ])
3095 env = os.environ.copy()
3096 env["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = str(n_thr)
3097 prev_pp = env.get("PYTHONPATH", "")
3098 env["PYTHONPATH"] = f"{root}{os.pathsep}{prev_pp}" if prev_pp else root
3099 if verbose or (debug & PY_DBG_COMMANDS):
3100 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Running tropidist: {' '.join(cmd)}")
3101 t0 = time.monotonic()
3102 hard_to = (t_lim + max(30.0, 0.25 * t_lim)) if t_lim > 0.0 else None
3103 proc = subprocess.Popen(
3104 cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True,
3105 cwd=root, env=env, start_new_session=True,
3106 )
3107 timed_out = False
3108 stdout, stderr = "", ""
3109 try:
3110 stdout, stderr = proc.communicate(timeout=hard_to)
3111 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
3112 timed_out = True
3113 _kill_proc_group(proc)
3114 try:
3115 stdout, stderr = proc.communicate(timeout=2.0)
3116 except Exception:
3117 pass
3118 except BaseException:
3119 _kill_proc_group(proc)
3120 raise
3121 if verbose or (debug & PY_DBG_COMMANDS):
3122 print(f"[dist_m4ri] tropidist finished in {time.monotonic() - t0:.3g} s (rc={proc.returncode})")
3123 if os.path.isfile(out_json):
3124 try:
3125 with open(out_json, "r") as f:
3126 rec = json.load(f)
3127 if isinstance(rec, dict):
3128 return rec
3129 except (OSError, ValueError):
3130 pass
3131 if timed_out:
3132 return {"status": "timeout", "lower_bound": 1, "upper_bound": None, "witness": None,
3133 "notes": "hard subprocess timeout"}
3134 tail = ((stderr or "").strip() or (stdout or "").strip()).splitlines()
3135 msg = tail[-1] if tail else f"exit code {proc.returncode}"
3136 raise RuntimeError(f"tropidist failed ({msg})")
3137 finally:
3138 if not keep:
3139 shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
3140
3141
3142def _tropidist_extract_bounds(
3143 rec: Dict[str, Any],
3144 *,
3145 H_csr: Any = None,
3146 L_csr: Any = None,
3147 classical: bool = False,
3148 is_circuit: bool = False,
3149 label: str = "code",
3150) -> Tuple[int, int, bool]:
3151 """
3152 Extracts verified `(dmin, dmax, witness_verified)` from a `tropidist` JSON record.
3153
3154 - Raises `ImportError` on `status == 'unavailable'` and `RuntimeError` on `status == 'error'`.
3155 - Accepts `upper_bound` ONLY when `value_only` is False, a witness list of matching weight is returned, and the
3156 witness passes independent verification (`H x = 0`, `L x != 0` for matrices/DEMs, or `replay.result == 'pass'`
3157 for Stim circuits).
3158 - Accepts `lower_bound > 1` only when `status in ('exact', 'bounds', 'timeout')`.
3159 """
3160 status = str(rec.get("status", "") or "")
3161 if status == "unavailable":
3162 raise ImportError(f"tropidist is unavailable: {_tropidist_error_detail(rec)}") from None
3163 if status == "error":
3164 raise RuntimeError(f"tropidist error: {_tropidist_error_detail(rec)}")
3165 raw_lb = int(rec["lower_bound"]) if rec.get("lower_bound") is not None else 0
3166 raw_ub = int(rec["upper_bound"]) if rec.get("upper_bound") is not None else 0
3167 value_only = bool(rec.get("value_only", False))
3168 wit = rec.get("witness")
3169 wit_ok = False
3170 c_ub = 0
3171 if raw_ub > 0 and not value_only and isinstance(wit, (list, tuple)) and len(wit) == raw_ub:
3172 if is_circuit:
3173 replay = rec.get("replay")
3174 if isinstance(replay, dict) and replay.get("result") == "pass" and rec.get("witness_ok") is not False:
3175 wit_ok = True
3176 c_ub = raw_ub
3177 else:
3178 reason = (replay.get("result") if isinstance(replay, dict) else "missing replay")
3179 sys.stderr.write(f"# Warning: tropidist circuit witness for the {label} distance did not pass Stim "
3180 f"replay ({reason}); upper bound {raw_ub} not used\n")
3181 else:
3182 ok, why = _verify_matrix_witness(H_csr, L_csr, wit, classical=classical)
3183 if ok:
3184 wit_ok = True
3185 c_ub = raw_ub
3186 else:
3187 sys.stderr.write(f"# Warning: tropidist returned an invalid witness for the {label} distance "
3188 f"({why}); upper bound {raw_ub} not used\n")
3189 elif raw_ub > 0 and wit is not None and not value_only:
3190 sys.stderr.write(f"# Warning: tropidist witness length does not match upper_bound={raw_ub} for the {label} "
3191 f"distance; upper bound not used\n")
3192 c_lb = raw_lb if (status in ("exact", "bounds", "timeout") and raw_lb > 1) else 0
3193 if c_ub > 0 and c_lb > c_ub:
3194 sys.stderr.write(f"# Warning: tropidist lower_bound={c_lb} exceeds verified upper_bound={c_ub} for the "
3195 f"{label} distance; clamping lower bound\n")
3196 c_lb = c_ub
3197 return c_lb, c_ub, wit_ok
3198
3199
3200def _tropidist_code_distance(
3201 key_fn: Callable[[], str],
3202 run_trop_fn: Callable[[int, int], Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Any, Any]],
3203 *,
3204 label: str = "code",
3205 classical: bool = False,
3206 is_circuit: bool = False,
3207 dmin: int = 0,
3208 dmax: int = 0,
3209 dstop: int = 0,
3210 wmax: int = 0,
3211 eff_cache_file: Optional[str] = None,
3212 debug: int = 0,
3213 verbose: bool = False,
3214 certified_dmin: int = 0,
3215 keep_stats: bool = False,
3216) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3217 """
3218 Runs a `tropidist` callback with `dist_m4ri` cache lookup, independent witness verification, and safe cache
3219 write-back (mirroring `_cert_code_distance()`).
3220
3221 `run_trop_fn(w_lo, w_hi)` receives the already-certified lower bound `w_lo = max(1, p_dmin, certified_dmin)`
3222 (never the caller's unverified `dmin`) and upper search target `w_hi`, and returns `(rec, H_csr, L_csr)` (or
3223 `({"k0": reason}, None, None)` when `k = 0` is detected before spawning `tropidist`). Only certified lower bounds
3224 and independently verified upper bounds are written to `_distance_cache`.
3225 """
3226 global _distance_cache, _last_run_stats
3227 if not keep_stats:
3228 _last_run_stats = {}
3229 code_key: Optional[str] = None
3230 entry: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
3231 eff_dmin, eff_dmax = dmin, dmax
3232 if _use_distance_cache:
3233 if eff_cache_file:
3234 load_distance_cache(eff_cache_file)
3235 code_key = key_fn()
3236 entry = _distance_cache.get(code_key)
3237 if entry is not None and _single_entry_is_exact(entry, need_cws=False, dstop=dstop):
3238 if verbose or (debug & PY_DBG_CACHE):
3239 c_dmin = entry.get("dmin", 0) or 0
3240 found = ("exact distance" if c_dmin == entry.get("dmax") else f"dmin={c_dmin} >= dstop={dstop}")
3241 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Cache hit for {label} distance ({found} known)!")
3242 if not keep_stats:
3243 _last_run_stats["engine_tropidist"] = {"cached": True}
3244 return {
3245 "dist": entry["dist"], "dmin": entry["dmin"], "dmax": entry["dmax"],
3246 "rw_steps": entry.get("rw_steps", 0), "d_info": list(entry["d_info"]),
3247 "cws": list(entry.get("cws", [])), "cached": True,
3248 }
3249 eff_dmin, eff_dmax = _seed_bounds_from_entry(eff_dmin, eff_dmax, entry)
3250 p_dmin = (entry.get("dmin", 0) or 0) if entry else 0
3251 w_lo = max(1, p_dmin, certified_dmin)
3252 w_hi = wmax if wmax > 0 else 40
3253 if eff_dmax > 0:
3254 w_hi = min(w_hi, max(1, eff_dmax - 1)) if wmax > 0 else max(1, eff_dmax - 1)
3255 if dstop > 0:
3256 w_hi = min(w_hi, max(1, dstop - 1)) if (wmax > 0 or eff_dmax > 0) else max(1, dstop - 1)
3257 t_trop = time.monotonic()
3258 rec, H_csr, L_csr = run_trop_fn(w_lo, max(w_lo, w_hi))
3259 t_trop = time.monotonic() - t_trop
3260 if rec.get("k0"):
3261 k0_reason = str(rec["k0"])
3262 _note_k0(k0_reason)
3263 _last_run_stats["k0"] = k0_reason
3264 if not keep_stats:
3265 _last_run_stats["engine_tropidist"] = {"cached": False, "k0": True, "wmin": min(w_lo, 40), "time": t_trop}
3266 return _k0_result((code_key,), eff_cache_file)
3267 c_lb, c_ub, wit_ok = _tropidist_extract_bounds(
3268 rec, H_csr=H_csr, L_csr=L_csr, classical=classical, is_circuit=is_circuit, label=label,
3269 )
3270 if wit_ok and 0 < c_ub < w_lo:
3271 sys.stderr.write(f"# Warning: tropidist found a verified codeword of weight {c_ub} below the certified lower "
3272 f"bound {w_lo} for the {label} distance: please report this\n")
3273 if not keep_stats:
3274 kmax_eff = min(max(w_lo, w_hi), 40)
3275 _last_run_stats["engine_tropidist"] = {
3276 "cached": False, "lb": c_lb, "ub": c_ub, "wmin": min(w_lo, kmax_eff), "wmax": kmax_eff,
3277 "status": str(rec.get("status", "") or ""), "witness_verified": wit_ok,
3278 "value_only": bool(rec.get("value_only", False)), "time": t_trop,
3279 }
3280 p_dmax = (entry.get("dmax", 0) or 0) if entry else 0
3281 p_rw = (entry.get("rw_steps", 0) or 0) if entry else 0
3282 p_cws = list(entry.get("cws", [])) if entry else []
3283 cache_dmin = max(p_dmin, c_lb)
3284 cache_dmax = min(p_dmax, c_ub) if (p_dmax > 0 and c_ub > 0) else max(p_dmax, c_ub)
3285 if cache_dmax > 0 and cache_dmin > cache_dmax:
3286 cache_dmin = cache_dmax
3287 if _use_distance_cache and code_key is not None and (c_lb > 1 or c_ub > 0):
3288 record = _sector_record(cache_dmin, cache_dmax, p_rw, p_cws)
3289 if entry is not None and "dmin_model" in entry:
3290 record["dmin_model"] = entry["dmin_model"]
3291 if record != entry:
3292 _distance_cache[code_key] = record
3293 if eff_cache_file:
3294 save_distance_cache(eff_cache_file)
3295 dmin_res = max(eff_dmin, cache_dmin)
3296 pos_ub = [x for x in (eff_dmax, cache_dmax) if x > 0]
3297 dmax_res = min(pos_ub) if pos_ub else 0
3298 if dmax_res > 0 and dmin_res > dmax_res:
3299 dmin_res = min(cache_dmin, dmax_res)
3300 dist = _dist_from_bounds(dmin_res, dmax_res)
3301 return {
3302 "dist": dist, "dmin": dmin_res, "dmax": dmax_res, "rw_steps": p_rw,
3303 "d_info": format_bounds_list(dmin_res, dmax_res, p_rw), "cws": p_cws, "cached": False,
3304 }
3305
3306
3307def _tropidist_prepare_quantum(H: Any, G: Any, L: Any, ortho: bool = True) -> Tuple[Any, Any, Optional[str]]:
3308 """
3309 Prepares binary CSR `(H_csr, L_csr, k0_reason)` for `tropidist` on a quantum code or CSS sector.
3310 Constructs `L_csr` from `(H, G)` via `_gf2_logicals_from_hg()` when `G` is given (checking `H G^T = 0` when
3311 `ortho=True`). Returns `k0_reason` (a non-empty string) if `k = 0`, else `None`.
3312 """
3313 H_csr = _to_binary_csr(H)
3314 if L is not None:
3315 L_csr = _to_binary_csr(L)
3316 if int(H_csr.shape[1]) != int(L_csr.shape[1]):
3317 raise ValueError(f"H has {int(H_csr.shape[1])} columns and L has {int(L_csr.shape[1])} columns")
3318 if int(L_csr.shape[0]) == 0 or _k0_of_matrices(H_csr, L=L_csr):
3319 return H_csr, L_csr, "every row of L is in the row space of H"
3320 return H_csr, L_csr, None
3321 L_csr = _gf2_logicals_from_hg(H_csr, G, ortho=ortho)
3322 if int(L_csr.shape[0]) == 0:
3323 return H_csr, L_csr, "rank H + rank G = n"
3324 return H_csr, L_csr, None
3325
3326
3327# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3328# engine='auto' (since version 0.17.0): the two-stage portfolio dist_m4ri -> qec_cert, see _auto_two_stage().
3329#
3330# - Classical codes: always the dist_m4ri binary (see _auto_cert_eligible()).
3331# - A DEM (or Stim circuit) with more than _AUTO_DEM_FAST_PATH_ERRORS raw error mechanisms and a timeout of at least
3332# _AUTO_DEM_FAST_PATH_MIN_TIMEOUT s (or none): qec_cert first, whose exact reductions of large DEMs (the spacetime
3333# P1 sandwich, twin retraction, ...) come before any search (see _auto_cert_first()).
3334# - Otherwise (quantum codes, the sectors of CSS codes, and smaller DEMs): Stage A, the binary (method=3) for
3335# tau_1 = timeout if timeout <= 2 s, else min(max(2, timeout / 10), 10) s; then, if the bracket is still open and
3336# more than _AUTO_STAGE_B_MIN_TIME s are left, Stage B, qec_cert with the remaining time, seeded with the bounds of
3337# Stage A. qec_cert (about 0.6 s to import) is imported only for Stage B.
3338# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3339_AUTO_DEM_FAST_PATH_ERRORS = 25000 # raw DEM error mechanisms above which engine='auto' runs qec_cert first
3340_AUTO_DEM_FAST_PATH_MIN_TIMEOUT = 3.0 # ... only with a timeout of at least this many seconds (or no timeout)
3341_AUTO_STAGE_B_MIN_TIME = 1.0 # Stage B (qec_cert) only with more than this many seconds left after Stage A
3342_AUTO_STAGE_B_UB_GAP = 3 # Stage B keeps qec_cert's upper-bound stage when dmax_s - max(1, dmin_s) >= this gap
3343_AUTO_STAGE1_MIN = 2.0 # Stage A: the whole timeout up to this many seconds, otherwise at least this many seconds
3344_AUTO_STAGE1_FRAC = 0.1 # ... and this fraction of the timeout (since version 0.17.1; 0.5 in 0.17.0)
3345_AUTO_STAGE1_MAX = 10.0 # ... but at most this many seconds (since version 0.17.1; 30.0 in 0.17.0)
3346_binary_json_ok: Dict[str, bool] = {} # the path of a dist_m4ri binary -> whether it writes json=1 (see below)
3347
3348
3349def _binary_has_json(dist_m4ri: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
3350 """
3351 Whether the dist_m4ri binary (dist_m4ri: its path, None for the default, see find_dist_m4ri_binary()) writes the
3352 JSON summary of json=1 (since version 0.17.5; checked once per binary, for Stage A of engine='auto'): its version
3353 (dist_m4ri --version) is at least 0.17.4, and it is not dist_m4ri_old, which prints the same version (and exits 0
3354 on 'dist_m4ri --help json', which both binaries share), but ignores json=1 with a warning. False for an older
3355 binary, for one of unknown version, or if it is not found.
3356 """
3357 try:
3358 path = find_dist_m4ri_binary(dist_m4ri)
3359 except (RuntimeError, FileNotFoundError):
3360 return False
3361 if path not in _binary_json_ok:
3362 ok = False
3363 if "dist_m4ri_old" not in (os.path.basename(path), os.path.basename(os.path.realpath(path))):
3364 try:
3365 ver = _binary_version(path)[1]
3366 ok = ver is not None and _parse_version(ver) >= (0, 17, 4)
3367 except Exception:
3368 ok = False
3369 _binary_json_ok[path] = ok
3370 return _binary_json_ok[path]
3371
3372
3373def _auto_timeout(timeout: Optional[float]) -> float:
3374 """
3375 The timeout of a call in seconds, for every engine (the binary, qec_cert, and engine='auto'; since version 0.17.2
3376 also for engine='cert' and method=2): 0 for no limit (also for an infinite timeout, as in the binary), 60 (the
3377 default of the binary) for None or a negative value.
3378
3379 Raises:
3380 ValueError: for a NaN timeout (the binary rejects it as well).
3381 """
3382 if timeout is None:
3383 return 60.0
3384 if math.isnan(timeout):
3385 raise ValueError(f"invalid timeout={timeout}: expected a number of seconds (0: no limit)")
3386 if timeout < 0:
3387 return 60.0
3388 return 0.0 if math.isinf(timeout) else float(timeout)
3389
3390
3391def _timeout_at_least(timeout: Optional[float], seconds: float) -> bool:
3392 """Whether the timeout of the binary (see _auto_timeout(); 0: no limit) is at least `seconds`."""
3393 t = _auto_timeout(timeout)
3394 return t <= 0 or t >= seconds
3395
3396
3397def _auto_stage_a_budget(timeout: Optional[float]) -> float:
3398 """
3399 engine='auto': the time budget tau_1 of Stage A (the dist_m4ri binary, method=3) of the two-stage portfolio: the
3400 whole timeout if it is at most _AUTO_STAGE1_MIN = 2 s (also 0: no limit), otherwise
3401 min(max(_AUTO_STAGE1_MIN, _AUTO_STAGE1_FRAC * timeout), _AUTO_STAGE1_MAX) = min(max(2, timeout / 10), 10) s (the
3402 module constants, e.g., for benchmarks of other budgets), rounded to 1 ns (e.g., 2.3 s, not 2.3000000000000003 s, in
3403 the command line of the binary).
3404 """
3405 t = _auto_timeout(timeout)
3406 if t <= _AUTO_STAGE1_MIN:
3407 return t
3408 return min(max(_AUTO_STAGE1_MIN, round(_AUTO_STAGE1_FRAC * t, 9)), _AUTO_STAGE1_MAX)
3409
3410
3411def _auto_stage_b_use_ub(dmin_s: int, dmax_s: int) -> bool:
3412 """
3413 engine='auto' Stage B: whether qec_cert runs its upper-bound stage: when no codeword is known (dmax_s <= 0), or
3414 when dmax_s - max(1, dmin_s) >= _AUTO_STAGE_B_UB_GAP (since version 0.17.1: qec_cert's slab-ISD can tighten a
3415 wide RW bracket).
3416 """
3417 return dmax_s <= 0 or (dmax_s - max(1, dmin_s) >= _AUTO_STAGE_B_UB_GAP)
3418
3419
3420def _dem_num_raw_errors(dem: Any, limit: int = 0) -> int:
3421 """
3422 The number of error mechanisms of a DEM (a stim.DetectorErrorModel, a .dem file, or the text of a DEM), counted as
3423 stim's num_errors: an error in a repeat block once for each repetition, equal errors separately (-1 if unknown).
3424 With limit > 0, the count of the text of a DEM may stop as soon as it exceeds the limit.
3425 """
3426 n = getattr(dem, "num_errors", None)
3427 if n is not None:
3428 try:
3429 return int(n)
3430 except (TypeError, ValueError):
3431 return -1
3432
3433 def count(lines: Any) -> int:
3434 total, mult = 0, [1]
3435 for line in lines:
3436 name, _, rest = _dem_instruction_parts(line) # (also with a tag, error[t](p) ...)
3437 if name == "error":
3438 total += mult[-1]
3439 if 0 < limit < total:
3440 break
3441 elif name == "repeat":
3442 try:
3443 mult.append(mult[-1] * max(0, int(rest.split()[0])))
3444 except (IndexError, ValueError):
3445 return -1
3446 elif name == "}" and len(mult) > 1:
3447 mult.pop()
3448 return total
3449
3450 try:
3451 if isinstance(dem, (str, Path)) and os.path.isfile(str(dem)):
3452 with open(str(dem)) as f:
3453 return count(f)
3454 return count(str(dem).splitlines())
3455 except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
3456 return -1
3457
3458
3459def _format_auto_info(info: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
3460 """The stages of engine='auto' (the dict _last_run_stats['engine_auto'], see _auto_two_stage()) on one line."""
3461 parts = []
3462 if info.get("path") == "qec_cert first":
3463 parts.append(f"qec_cert first ({info.get('num_errors')} raw DEM error mechanisms > "
3464 f"{_AUTO_DEM_FAST_PATH_ERRORS})")
3465 a = info.get("stage_a")
3466 if a is not None:
3467 tau = info.get("tau_1", 0.0) or 0.0
3468 t_str = f"at most {tau:.3g} s" if tau > 0 else "no time limit"
3469 src = "cached" if info.get("stage_a_cached") else f"in {info.get('stage_a_time', 0.0):.3g} s"
3470 parts.append(f"Stage A, dist_m4ri ({t_str}): [{a[0]}, {a[1]}] {src}")
3471 b = info.get("stage_b")
3472 if b is not None:
3473 b_eng = info.get("stage_b_engine") or "qec_cert"
3474 tl = info.get("stage_b_time_limit", 0.0) or 0.0
3475 tl_str = f"time limit {tl:.3g} s" if tl > 0 else "no time limit"
3476 parts.append(f"{'Stage B, ' if a is not None else ''}{b_eng} ({tl_str}): [{b[0]}, {b[1]}] in "
3477 f"{info.get('stage_b_time', 0.0):.3g} s")
3478 c = info.get("stage_c")
3479 if c is not None:
3480 tc = info.get("stage_c_timeout", 0.0) or 0.0
3481 tc_str = f"the remaining {tc:.3g} s" if tc > 0 else "no time limit"
3482 parts.append(f"dist_m4ri with {tc_str}: [{c[0]}, {c[1]}]")
3483 if info.get("reason"):
3484 parts.append(str(info["reason"]))
3485 return "; ".join(parts)
3486
3487
3488def _auto_done_reason(res: Dict[str, Any], stage: str, dstop: int, wmax: int, t_all: float, rem: float,
3489 binary: bool = True) -> str:
3490 """
3491 engine='auto': why no further stage runs after `stage` with the result res ('' if one should run). Without a time
3492 limit (t_all <= 0), a run of the binary (binary=True) ends only with the result, while qec_cert (binary=False) may
3493 end early with an open bracket: then the binary runs (since version 0.17.2).
3494 """
3495 if res.get("k0"):
3496 return "no logical codeword (k = 0)"
3497 r_dmin, r_dmax = res["dmin"], res["dmax"]
3498 if r_dmin > 0 and r_dmin == r_dmax:
3499 return f"exact after {stage}"
3500 if dstop > 0 and r_dmin >= dstop:
3501 return f"dmin >= dstop={dstop} after {stage}"
3502 if wmax > 0 and r_dmin > wmax:
3503 return f"CC reached wmax={wmax} in {stage}"
3504 if t_all <= 0:
3505 return f"no time limit: {stage} ran until the end" if binary else ""
3506 if rem <= _AUTO_STAGE_B_MIN_TIME:
3507 return f"{max(rem, 0.0):.3g} s left after {stage}"
3508 return ""
3509
3510
3511def _cert_time_left(t_lim: float, t_call: float) -> float:
3512 """
3513 engine='auto': the time limit of qec_cert in seconds, t_lim counted from the time t_call (time.monotonic()) of the
3514 call of its callback, i.e., the time left after the cache lookup and the import of qec_cert (since version 0.17.2);
3515 0.0 (no limit) for t_lim <= 0, and never less than 0.1 s otherwise (0.0 would mean no limit in qec_cert).
3516 """
3517 if t_lim <= 0.0:
3518 return 0.0
3519 return max(t_lim - (time.monotonic() - t_call), 0.1)
3520
3521
3522def _auto_seed_bounds(dmin: int, dmax: int, res: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[int, int]:
3523 """The bounds for the next stage of engine='auto': the caller's (dmin, dmax) tightened by those of res."""
3524 ub = [x for x in (dmax, res["dmax"]) if x > 0]
3525 return max(dmin, res["dmin"]), (min(ub) if ub else 0)
3526
3527
3528def _auto_stage_a_witness(res: Dict[str, Any], rj: Any, dmax_s: int) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
3529 """
3530 engine='auto' (since version 0.17.5): the JSON summary rj (schema 'dm4ri-result/1', _last_run_stats['result_json']
3531 of the run of the binary in Stage A with json=1, see _auto_two_stage()) for Stage B (see _cert_handoff_kw()), if its
3532 witness is a codeword of weight dmax_s, the upper bound of Stage B, found in this run, whose result is res:
3533 available, with base 1 and dmax_s distinct original columns (1-based). None otherwise: for a cached result res
3534 (no run: the statistics of an earlier run are never used), for k = 0, without a summary (e.g., an older binary or
3535 dist_m4ri_old, see _binary_has_json()), without a codeword (witness.available false, which qec_cert would report
3536 as 'invalid'), or with one of another weight (e.g., of a caller's dmax, below the weight found).
3537 """
3538 if res.get("cached") or res.get("k0") or dmax_s <= 0 or int(res.get("dmax", 0) or 0) != dmax_s:
3539 return None
3540 if not isinstance(rj, dict) or rj.get("schema") != "dm4ri-result/1" or rj.get("k0"):
3541 return None
3542 wit = rj.get("witness")
3543 if not isinstance(wit, dict) or wit.get("available") is not True or wit.get("base", 1) != 1:
3544 return None
3545 sup = wit.get("support")
3546 if not isinstance(sup, (list, tuple)):
3547 return None
3548 try:
3549 cols = {int(j) for j in sup}
3550 w = int(wit.get("weight") or 0)
3551 except (TypeError, ValueError):
3552 return None
3553 if w != dmax_s or len(sup) != w or len(cols) != w or min(cols) < 1:
3554 return None
3555 return rj
3556
3557
3558def _auto_add_rw(res: Dict[str, Any], prev_rw: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3559 """
3560 The result of a later stage of engine='auto' with the RW steps of the earlier runs of the binary (prev_rw) added if
3561 the cache is disabled (with the cache, the record counts all of them).
3562 """
3563 if _use_distance_cache or prev_rw <= 0:
3564 return res
3565 res = dict(res)
3566 res["rw_steps"] = (res.get("rw_steps", 0) or 0) + prev_rw
3567 res["d_info"] = format_bounds_list(res["dmin"], res["dmax"], res["rw_steps"])
3568 return res
3569
3570
3571def _auto_native_tail(
3572 run_native: Callable[[float, int, int], Dict[str, Any]],
3573 res: Dict[str, Any],
3574 info: Dict[str, Any],
3575 *,
3576 t0: float,
3577 t_all: float,
3578 dmin: int,
3579 dmax: int,
3580 prev_rw: int,
3581 say: bool,
3582) -> Dict[str, Any]:
3583 """
3584 engine='auto': the dist_m4ri binary with the time left (more than _AUTO_STAGE_B_MIN_TIME s, see
3585 _auto_done_reason(); without a time limit, t_all <= 0: also without one), seeded with the bounds of res (certified,
3586 as those of the binary); res if no time is left.
3587 """
3588 global _last_run_stats
3589 rem = 0.0 # (no time limit)
3590 if t_all > 0:
3591 rem = t_all - (time.monotonic() - t0)
3592 if rem <= _AUTO_STAGE_B_MIN_TIME:
3593 _last_run_stats["engine_auto"] = info
3594 return res
3595 s_dmin, s_dmax = _auto_seed_bounds(dmin, dmax, res)
3596 if say:
3597 t_str = f"the remaining {rem:.3g} s" if rem > 0 else "no time limit"
3598 print(f"[dist_m4ri] engine='auto': dist_m4ri with {t_str} from the bounds [{s_dmin}, {s_dmax}]")
3599 res_c = _auto_add_rw(run_native(rem, s_dmin, s_dmax), prev_rw)
3600 info.update(stage_c=[res_c["dmin"], res_c["dmax"]], stage_c_timeout=rem)
3601 _last_run_stats["engine_auto"] = info
3602 return res_c
3603
3604
3605def _auto_two_stage(
3606 run_native: Callable[..., Dict[str, Any]],
3607 run_cert: Callable[..., Dict[str, Any]],
3608 *,
3609 timeout: Optional[float],
