4671
4672def set_circuit_rounds(circuit: Any, rounds: int) -> Any:
4673 """Sets the repeat_count of top-level CircuitRepeatBlocks in a Stim circuit.
4674
4675 For circuits with a single top-level repeat block, sets its repeat_count to
4676 rounds. For circuits with two top-level repeat blocks (e.g. preamble +
4677 periodic body), adjusts them to achieve the requested total rounds. Nested
4678 REPEAT blocks inside a round body are kept unchanged.
4679
4680 Args:
4681 circuit: A stim.Circuit instance or path to a .stim file.
4682 rounds: Non-negative repetition count to set for top-level repeat
4683 blocks. If 0, top-level repeat blocks are omitted.
4684
4685 Returns:
4686 A new stim.Circuit instance with modified top-level repeat counts.
4687
4688 Raises:
4689 ValueError: If rounds < 0.
4690 """
4691 stim = _get_stim()
4692 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
4693 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
4694 if not isinstance(circuit, stim.Circuit):
4695 return circuit
4696 if rounds < 0:
4697 raise ValueError(f"Invalid rounds={rounds}; must be >= 0.")
4698
4699 top_blocks = [
4700 inst.repeat_count for inst in circuit
4701 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock)
4702 ]
4703 if len(top_blocks) > 1:
4704 sys.stderr.write(
4705 f"# Warning: Circuit has {len(top_blocks)} repeat blocks "
4706 f"({top_blocks}) which may not be handled correctly by this "
4707 "script.\n"
4708 )
4709
4710 new_circuit = stim.Circuit()
4711 if len(top_blocks) == 2:
4712 preamble = top_blocks[0]
4713 b1_count = min(preamble, rounds)
4714 b2_count = max(0, rounds - preamble)
4715 block_idx = 0
4716 for inst in circuit:
4717 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
4718 cnt = b1_count if block_idx == 0 else b2_count
4719 block_idx += 1
4720 if cnt > 0:
4721 new_circuit.append(
4722 stim.CircuitRepeatBlock(cnt, inst.body_copy())
4723 )
4724 else:
4725 new_circuit.append(inst)
4726 else:
4727 for inst in circuit:
4728 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
4729 if rounds > 0:
4730 new_circuit.append(
4731 stim.CircuitRepeatBlock(rounds, inst.body_copy())
4732 )
4733 else:
4734 new_circuit.append(inst)
4735 return new_circuit
4736
4737
4738def count_circuit_rounds(circuit: Any) -> int:
4739 """Returns total repeat count of all repeat blocks in circuit, or 1 if unrolled."""
4740 stim = _get_stim()
4741 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
4742 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
4743 if not isinstance(circuit, stim.Circuit):
4744 return 1
4745 blocks = [
4746 inst.repeat_count for inst in circuit
4747 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock)
4748 ]
4749 if len(blocks) > 1:
4750 sys.stderr.write(
4751 f"# Warning: Circuit has {len(blocks)} repeat blocks "
4752 f"({blocks}) which may not be handled correctly by this "
4753 "script.\n"
4754 )
4755 return sum(blocks) if blocks else 1
4756
4757
4758def circuit_measurement_rounds(circuit: Any) -> int:
4759 """
4760 The rounds T of syndrome measurements of a Stim circuit, as compute_dem_distance() passes them to the binary
4761 (dem_rounds=T): the largest number of measurements of one qubit, counting the repetitions of the REPEAT blocks (a
4762 single-qubit measurement, with or without reset, or a qubit of a Pauli-product measurement such as MPP or MZZ;
4763 MPAD and the heralded noise channels do not count). A memory circuit measures each ancilla once per round and the
4764 data qubits once at the end: T is its number of rounds, e.g., 1 with rounds=0 for a circuit with one round before
4765 its REPEAT block, or with rounds=1 for a circuit whose block holds all rounds. A circuit which measures a qubit
4766 several times in one round (Pauli-product measurements, ancillas reused within a round) gives more than its rounds,
4767 and one with fresh ancillas in every round fewer (not a stim convention). For T = 1, the automatic rw_opt of the
4768 binary has the row slabs of rw_opt 4 (the boundary slabs are the two detector layers of the round), for T >= 2 not
4769 (see run_dist_m4ri()).
4770
4771 Args:
4772 circuit: A stim.Circuit instance or path to a .stim file.
4773
4774 Returns:
4775 T (0 for a circuit without measurements).
4776 """
4777 stim = _get_stim()
4778 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
4779 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
4780 if not isinstance(circuit, stim.Circuit):
4781 return 0
4782 counts: Dict[int, int] = {}
4783
4784 def walk(block: Any, mult: int) -> None:
4785 for inst in block:
4786 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
4787 if inst.repeat_count > 0:
4788 walk(inst.body_copy(), mult * inst.repeat_count)
4789 continue
4790 name = inst.name
4791 if name == "MPAD" or name.startswith("HERALDED_") or not stim.gate_data(name).produces_measurements:
4792 continue
4793 for t in inst.targets_copy():
4794 q = t.qubit_value # (None for the combiners of MPP)
4795 if q is not None:
4796 counts[q] = counts.get(q, 0) + mult
4797 walk(circuit, 1)
4798 return max(counts.values()) if counts else 0
4799
4800
4801def circuit_single_round(circuit: Any) -> bool:
4802 """
4803 Whether a Stim circuit has a single round of syndrome measurements followed by the final readout: no qubit is
4804 measured twice, i.e., circuit_measurement_rounds() is 1 (e.g., a memory circuit whose REPEAT block holds all rounds
4805 but the first one, with rounds=0).
4806
4807 Args:
4808 circuit: A stim.Circuit instance or path to a .stim file.
4809
4810 Returns:
4811 True for a single round, False otherwise (also for a circuit without measurements).
4812 """
4813 return circuit_measurement_rounds(circuit) == 1
4814
4815
4816def detect_basis(
4817 circuit: Any,
4818 filepath: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
4819 basis_arg: Optional[str] = None
4820) -> str:
4821 """Determines the primary memory basis ('X' or 'Z') of a Stim circuit.
4822
4823 Precedence order:
4824 1. Explicit basis_arg ('X' or 'Z', case-insensitive).
4825 2. Filename stem token ('X' or 'HX' vs 'Z' or 'HZ' among '_'- or '-'-split
4826 tokens of filepath, needed when X prep/readout is decomposed into R/M + H).
4827 3. Initial resets before the first REPEAT block or measurement (RX vs R/RZ).
4828 4. Final measurements after the last REPEAT block (MX/MRX vs M/MZ/MR/MRZ),
4829 defaulting to 'Z'.
4830 """
4831 if basis_arg is not None and str(basis_arg).upper() in ["X", "Z"]:
4832 return str(basis_arg).upper()
4833
4834 if filepath is not None:
4835 stem = Path(filepath).stem.upper()
4836 parts = set(stem.replace("-", "_").split("_"))
4837 has_x = bool(parts & {"X", "HX"})
4838 has_z = bool(parts & {"Z", "HZ"})
4839 if has_x and not has_z:
4840 return "X"
4841 if has_z and not has_x:
4842 return "Z"
4843
4844 stim = _get_stim()
4845 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
4846 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
4847
4848 rx_count = 0
4849 rz_count = 0
4850 for inst in circuit:
4851 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
4852 break
4853 if inst.name == "RX":
4854 rx_count += len(inst.targets_copy())
4855 elif inst.name in ["R", "RZ"]:
4856 rz_count += len(inst.targets_copy())
4857 elif stim.gate_data(inst.name).produces_measurements:
4858 break
4859 if rx_count > rz_count:
4860 return "X"
4861 if rz_count > rx_count:
4862 return "Z"
4863
4864 mx_count = 0
4865 mz_count = 0
4866 for inst in reversed(list(circuit)):
4867 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
4868 break
4869 if inst.name in ["MX", "MRX"]:
4870 mx_count += len(inst.targets_copy())
4871 elif inst.name in ["M", "MZ", "MR", "MRZ"]:
4872 mz_count += len(inst.targets_copy())
4873 if mx_count > mz_count:
4874 return "X"
4875 return "Z"
4876
4877
4878def track_circuit_carriers(circuit: Any) -> List[List[int]]:
4879 """Dynamically tracks logical syndrome carriers across the circuit to measurements.
4880
4881 Accounts for physical qubit permutations via SWAP, CXSWAP, SWAPCX, CZSWAP,
4882 ISWAP, and ISWAP_DAG gates, as well as CNOT/CZ syndrome handoffs onto fresh
4883 ancilla or routing qubits. Every instruction that produces measurement
4884 records (including MPP, MXX/MYY/MZZ, MPAD, and HERALDED_*) emits one entry
4885 per measurement record.
4886
4887 Returns:
4888 meas_carriers: List mapping each measurement record index to a sorted
4889 list of initial logical qubit IDs whose syndrome or state is carried
4890 into that measurement (empty for MPAD and heralded noise channels).
4891 """
4892 stim = _get_stim()
4893 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
4894 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
4895 num_qubits = circuit.num_qubits
4896 phys_to_log = {q: q for q in range(num_qubits)}
4897 swap_gates = ("SWAP", "CXSWAP", "SWAPCX", "CZSWAP", "ISWAP", "ISWAP_DAG")
4898 entangling_swaps = ("CXSWAP", "SWAPCX", "CZSWAP", "ISWAP", "ISWAP_DAG")
4899 two_q_cliffords = (
4900 "CX", "ZCX", "CY", "ZCY", "CZ", "ZCZ",
4901 "XCX", "XCY", "XCZ", "YCX", "YCY", "YCZ",
4902 )
4903
4904 def apply_swaps(blk: Any, mapping: Dict[int, int]) -> None:
4905 for sub_inst in blk:
4906 if isinstance(sub_inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
4907 if sub_inst.repeat_count > 0:
4908 sub_body = sub_inst.body_copy()
4909 for _ in range(sub_inst.repeat_count):
4910 apply_swaps(sub_body, mapping)
4911 elif sub_inst.name in swap_gates:
4912 sub_t = sub_inst.targets_copy()
4913 for a, b in zip(sub_t[::2], sub_t[1::2]):
4914 if a.is_qubit_target and b.is_qubit_target:
4915 q1, q2 = a.value, b.value
4916 mapping[q1], mapping[q2] = mapping[q2], mapping[q1]
4917
4918 tot_resets: Dict[int, int] = {q: 0 for q in range(num_qubits)}
4919 tot_meas: Dict[int, int] = {q: 0 for q in range(num_qubits)}
4920
4921 def pass1(block: Any, p_to_l: Dict[int, int], mult: int = 1) -> None:
4922 for inst in block:
4923 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
4924 rep_count = inst.repeat_count
4925 if rep_count <= 0:
4926 continue
4927 body = inst.body_copy()
4928 map_copy = dict(p_to_l)
4929 apply_swaps(body, map_copy)
4930 if map_copy == p_to_l:
4931 pass1(body, p_to_l, mult * rep_count)
4932 else:
4933 for _ in range(rep_count):
4934 pass1(body, p_to_l, mult)
4935 continue
4936 name = inst.name
4937 gd = stim.gate_data(name)
4938 targets = inst.targets_copy()
4939 if gd.is_reset:
4940 for t in targets:
4941 if t.qubit_value is not None:
4942 tot_resets[p_to_l[t.qubit_value]] += mult
4943 if gd.produces_measurements and name != "MPAD":
4944 noise_ch = (
4945 gd.is_noisy_gate and 0 not in gd.num_parens_arguments_range
4946 )
4947 if not noise_ch:
4948 for grp in inst.target_groups():
4949 qs = [
4950 t.qubit_value for t in grp
4951 if t.qubit_value is not None
4952 ]
4953 if len(qs) == 1:
4954 tot_meas[p_to_l[qs[0]]] += mult
4955 if name in swap_gates:
4956 for a, b in zip(targets[::2], targets[1::2]):
4957 if a.is_qubit_target and b.is_qubit_target:
4958 q1, q2 = a.value, b.value
4959 p_to_l[q1], p_to_l[q2] = p_to_l[q2], p_to_l[q1]
4960
4961 pass1(circuit, dict(phys_to_log), 1)
4962 max_resets = max(tot_resets.values()) if tot_resets else 0
4963 max_meas = max(tot_meas.values()) if tot_meas else 0
4964 data_log = set()
4965 for q in range(num_qubits):
4966 if max_resets > 1:
4967 if tot_resets[q] <= 1:
4968 data_log.add(q)
4969 elif max_meas > 1:
4970 if tot_meas[q] <= 1:
4971 data_log.add(q)
4972
4973 active_carriers: Dict[int, Set[int]] = {
4974 q: {q} for q in range(num_qubits)
4975 }
4976 fresh_anc: Set[int] = set(range(num_qubits)) - data_log
4977 meas_carriers: List[List[int]] = []
4978
4979 def handoff_pair(l1: int, l2: int) -> None:
4980 if l1 not in data_log and l2 not in data_log:
4981 if l2 in fresh_anc and l1 not in fresh_anc:
4982 active_carriers[l2] = set(active_carriers[l1])
4983 fresh_anc.discard(l2)
4984 elif l1 in fresh_anc and l2 not in fresh_anc:
4985 active_carriers[l1] = set(active_carriers[l2])
4986 fresh_anc.discard(l1)
4987 else:
4988 comb = active_carriers[l1] | active_carriers[l2]
4989 active_carriers[l1] = set(comb)
4990 active_carriers[l2] = set(comb)
4991 fresh_anc.discard(l1)
4992 fresh_anc.discard(l2)
4993 elif l1 in data_log and l2 not in data_log:
4994 fresh_anc.discard(l2)
4995 elif l2 in data_log and l1 not in data_log:
4996 fresh_anc.discard(l1)
4997
4998 def pass2(block: Any, p_to_l: Dict[int, int]) -> None:
4999 for inst in block:
5000 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
5001 rep_count = inst.repeat_count
5002 body = inst.body_copy()
5003 if rep_count <= 0:
5004 continue
5005 map_copy = dict(p_to_l)
5006 apply_swaps(body, map_copy)
5007 if map_copy == p_to_l:
5008 idx0 = len(meas_carriers)
5009 pass2(body, p_to_l)
5010 idx1 = len(meas_carriers)
5011 if rep_count > 1 and idx1 > idx0:
5012 body_carriers = meas_carriers[idx0:idx1]
5013 meas_carriers.extend(body_carriers * (rep_count - 1))
5014 else:
5015 for _ in range(rep_count):
5016 pass2(body, p_to_l)
5017 continue
5018 name = inst.name
5019 gd = stim.gate_data(name)
5020 targets = inst.targets_copy()
5021 if gd.produces_measurements:
5022 noise_ch = (
5023 gd.is_noisy_gate and 0 not in gd.num_parens_arguments_range
5024 )
5025 for grp in inst.target_groups():
5026 if name == "MPAD" or noise_ch:
5027 meas_carriers.append([])
5028 else:
5029 qs = [
5030 t.qubit_value for t in grp
5031 if t.qubit_value is not None
5032 ]
5033 comb_c: Set[int] = set()
5034 for q in qs:
5035 comb_c |= active_carriers[p_to_l[q]]
5036 meas_carriers.append(sorted(comb_c))
5037 if gd.is_reset:
5038 for q in qs:
5039 lq = p_to_l[q]
5040 active_carriers[lq] = {lq}
5041 if lq not in data_log:
5042 fresh_anc.add(lq)
5043 elif gd.is_reset:
5044 for t in targets:
5045 if t.qubit_value is not None:
5046 lq = p_to_l[t.qubit_value]
5047 active_carriers[lq] = {lq}
5048 if lq not in data_log:
5049 fresh_anc.add(lq)
5050 elif name in two_q_cliffords:
5051 for a, b in zip(targets[::2], targets[1::2]):
5052 if a.is_qubit_target and b.is_qubit_target:
5053 handoff_pair(p_to_l[a.value], p_to_l[b.value])
5054 elif name == "SWAP":
5055 for a, b in zip(targets[::2], targets[1::2]):
5056 if a.is_qubit_target and b.is_qubit_target:
5057 q1, q2 = a.value, b.value
5058 p_to_l[q1], p_to_l[q2] = p_to_l[q2], p_to_l[q1]
5059 elif name in entangling_swaps:
5060 for a, b in zip(targets[::2], targets[1::2]):
5061 if a.is_qubit_target and b.is_qubit_target:
5062 q1, q2 = a.value, b.value
5063 handoff_pair(p_to_l[q1], p_to_l[q2])
5064 p_to_l[q1], p_to_l[q2] = p_to_l[q2], p_to_l[q1]
5065
5066 pass2(circuit, dict(phys_to_log))
5067 return meas_carriers
5068
5069
5070def _rewrite_circuit_internal(
5071 circ: Any,
5072 phys_to_log: Dict[int, int],
5073 active_gates_count: Dict[int, int]
5074) -> Any:
5075 """Rewrites a Stim circuit by tracking SWAPs virtually."""
5076 stim = _get_stim()
5077 new_circ = stim.Circuit()
5078 swap_gates = ("SWAP", "CXSWAP", "SWAPCX", "CZSWAP", "ISWAP", "ISWAP_DAG")
5079 non_active_instructions = {
5080 "QUBIT_COORDS", "SHIFT_COORDS", "TICK",
5081 "DETECTOR", "OBSERVABLE_INCLUDE", "MPAD"
5082 }
5083
5084 def apply_swaps(blk: Any, mapping: Dict[int, int]) -> None:
5085 for sub_inst in blk:
5086 if isinstance(sub_inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
5087 if sub_inst.repeat_count > 0:
5088 sub_body = sub_inst.body_copy()
5089 for _ in range(sub_inst.repeat_count):
5090 apply_swaps(sub_body, mapping)
5091 elif sub_inst.name in swap_gates:
5092 sub_t = sub_inst.targets_copy()
5093 for a, b in zip(sub_t[::2], sub_t[1::2]):
5094 if a.is_qubit_target and b.is_qubit_target:
5095 q1, q2 = a.value, b.value
5096 mapping[q1], mapping[q2] = mapping[q2], mapping[q1]
5097
5098 for inst in circ:
5099 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
5100 rep_count = inst.repeat_count
5101 if rep_count <= 0:
5102 continue
5103 body = inst.body_copy()
5104 map_copy = dict(phys_to_log)
5105 apply_swaps(body, map_copy)
5106 if map_copy == phys_to_log:
5107 new_body = _rewrite_circuit_internal(
5108 body, phys_to_log, active_gates_count
5109 )
5110 new_circ.append(stim.CircuitRepeatBlock(rep_count, new_body))
5111 else:
5112 for _ in range(rep_count):
5113 unrolled_body = _rewrite_circuit_internal(
5114 body, phys_to_log, active_gates_count
5115 )
5116 new_circ += unrolled_body
5117 continue
5118
5119 name = inst.name
5120 targets = inst.targets_copy()
5121 args = inst.gate_args_copy()
5122
5123 if name == "MPAD":
5124 new_circ.append(inst)
5125 elif name == "SWAP":
5126 for idx in range(0, len(targets), 2):
5127 q1 = targets[idx].value
5128 q2 = targets[idx + 1].value
5129 phys_to_log[q1], phys_to_log[q2] = (
5130 phys_to_log[q2], phys_to_log[q1]
5131 )
5132 elif name == "CXSWAP":
5133 cx_targets = []
5134 for idx in range(0, len(targets), 2):
5135 q1 = targets[idx].value
5136 q2 = targets[idx + 1].value
5137 l1 = phys_to_log[q1]
5138 l2 = phys_to_log[q2]
5139 cx_targets.extend([l1, l2])
5140 active_gates_count[l1] = active_gates_count.get(l1, 0) + 1
5141 active_gates_count[l2] = active_gates_count.get(l2, 0) + 1
5142 phys_to_log[q1], phys_to_log[q2] = (
5143 phys_to_log[q2], phys_to_log[q1]
5144 )
5145 new_circ.append("CX", cx_targets, args)
5146 elif name == "SWAPCX":
5147 cx_targets = []
5148 for idx in range(0, len(targets), 2):
5149 q1 = targets[idx].value
5150 q2 = targets[idx + 1].value
5151 l1 = phys_to_log[q1]
5152 l2 = phys_to_log[q2]
5153 cx_targets.extend([l2, l1])
5154 active_gates_count[l1] = active_gates_count.get(l1, 0) + 1
5155 active_gates_count[l2] = active_gates_count.get(l2, 0) + 1
5156 phys_to_log[q1], phys_to_log[q2] = (
5157 phys_to_log[q2], phys_to_log[q1]
5158 )
5159 new_circ.append("CX", cx_targets, args)
5160 elif name == "CZSWAP":
5161 cz_targets = []
5162 for idx in range(0, len(targets), 2):
5163 q1 = targets[idx].value
5164 q2 = targets[idx + 1].value
5165 l1 = phys_to_log[q1]
5166 l2 = phys_to_log[q2]
5167 cz_targets.extend([l1, l2])
5168 active_gates_count[l1] = active_gates_count.get(l1, 0) + 1
5169 active_gates_count[l2] = active_gates_count.get(l2, 0) + 1
5170 phys_to_log[q1], phys_to_log[q2] = (
5171 phys_to_log[q2], phys_to_log[q1]
5172 )
5173 new_circ.append("CZ", cz_targets, args)
5174 elif name in ["ISWAP", "ISWAP_DAG"]:
5175 cz_targets = []
5176 s_targets = []
5177 for idx in range(0, len(targets), 2):
5178 q1 = targets[idx].value
5179 q2 = targets[idx + 1].value
5180 l1 = phys_to_log[q1]
5181 l2 = phys_to_log[q2]
5182 cz_targets.extend([l1, l2])
5183 s_targets.extend([l1, l2])
5184 active_gates_count[l1] = active_gates_count.get(l1, 0) + 1
5185 active_gates_count[l2] = active_gates_count.get(l2, 0) + 1
5186 phys_to_log[q1], phys_to_log[q2] = (
5187 phys_to_log[q2], phys_to_log[q1]
5188 )
5189 new_circ.append("CZ", cz_targets)
5190 s_gate = "S" if name == "ISWAP" else "S_DAG"
5191 new_circ.append(s_gate, s_targets)
5192 else:
5193 new_targets = []
5194 for t in targets:
5195 if t.is_qubit_target:
5196 l_q = phys_to_log[t.value]
5197 if name not in non_active_instructions:
5198 active_gates_count[l_q] = (
5199 active_gates_count.get(l_q, 0) + 1
5200 )
5201 if t.is_inverted_result_target:
5202 new_targets.append(stim.target_inv(l_q))
5203 else:
5204 new_targets.append(l_q)
5205 elif t.is_x_target:
5206 l_q = phys_to_log[t.value]
5207 if name not in non_active_instructions:
5208 active_gates_count[l_q] = (
5209 active_gates_count.get(l_q, 0) + 1
5210 )
5211 new_targets.append(
5212 stim.target_x(l_q, invert=t.is_inverted_result_target)
5213 )
5214 elif t.is_y_target:
5215 l_q = phys_to_log[t.value]
5216 if name not in non_active_instructions:
5217 active_gates_count[l_q] = (
5218 active_gates_count.get(l_q, 0) + 1
5219 )
5220 new_targets.append(
5221 stim.target_y(l_q, invert=t.is_inverted_result_target)
5222 )
5223 elif t.is_z_target:
5224 l_q = phys_to_log[t.value]
5225 if name not in non_active_instructions:
5226 active_gates_count[l_q] = (
5227 active_gates_count.get(l_q, 0) + 1
5228 )
5229 new_targets.append(
5230 stim.target_z(l_q, invert=t.is_inverted_result_target)
5231 )
5232 else:
5233 new_targets.append(t)
5234 new_circ.append(name, new_targets, args)
5235 return new_circ
5236
5237
5238def classify_qubits_thorough(
5239 circuit: Any,
5240 verbose: bool = False,
5241 basis_arg: Optional[str] = None,
5242 filepath: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None
5243) -> Dict[str, Any]:
5244 """Classifies qubits and checks via virtual SWAP rewriting and Pauli basis tracking.
5245
5246 Tracks both ancilla stabilizer evolution and data qubit initial basis
5247 evolution through 1-qubit and 2-qubit Clifford gates. Supports standard
5248 CSS codes as well as locally basis-rotated CSS codes (such as XZZX codes)
5249 via 2-coloring of the check-data Pauli compatibility graph.
5250
5251 Args:
5252 circuit: A stim.Circuit object or path to a .stim file.
5253 verbose: Kept for API compatibility (unused).
5254 basis_arg: Optional explicit primary memory basis ('X' or 'Z').
5255 filepath: Optional file path hint used by detect_basis() when circuit
5256 is passed as a stim.Circuit object.
5257
5258 Returns:
5259 Dictionary with keys:
5260 - 'x_ancillas': Sorted list of X-type (or X-sector) ancilla qubit IDs.
5261 - 'z_ancillas': Sorted list of Z-type (or Z-sector) ancilla qubit IDs.
5262 - 'data_qubits': Sorted list of data qubit IDs.
5263 - 'routing_qubits': Sorted list of idle/routing qubit IDs.
5264 - 'rotated_data_qubits': Sorted list of data qubits with rotated local basis.
5265 - 'is_css': True if the circuit implements a (possibly locally rotated) CSS
5266 code with distinct X and Z check supports; False for CSS color codes
5267 (identical X and Z check supports), so drop="css" is not used on them.
5268 - 'is_rotated_css': True if CSS only after local data basis rotations (e.g. XZZX).
5269 - 'basis': Primary memory basis ('X' or 'Z').
5270 - 'rewritten_circuit': Virtual-SWAP rewrite of the circuit after capping
5271 every REPEAT count at 2.
5272 """
5273 stim = _get_stim()
5274 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
5275 if filepath is None:
5276 filepath = circuit
5277 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
5278
5279 all_qubits_set: Set[int] = set()
5280
5281 def collect_qubits(blk: Any) -> None:
5282 for inst in blk:
5283 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
5284 collect_qubits(inst.body_copy())
5285 elif inst.name != "MPAD":
5286 for t in inst.targets_copy():
5287 if t.qubit_value is not None:
5288 all_qubits_set.add(t.qubit_value)
5289
5290 collect_qubits(circuit)
5291 max_q = max(all_qubits_set) if all_qubits_set else -1
5292 phys_to_log = {q: q for q in range(max_q + 1)}
5293 active_gates_count = {q: 0 for q in all_qubits_set}
5294
5295 def cap_repeats(blk: Any) -> Any:
5296 out = stim.Circuit()
5297 for inst in blk:
5298 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
5299 if inst.repeat_count > 0:
5300 out.append(
5301 stim.CircuitRepeatBlock(
5302 min(inst.repeat_count, 2),
5303 cap_repeats(inst.body_copy())
5304 )
5305 )
5306 else:
5307 out.append(inst)
5308 return out
5309
5310 capped_circuit = cap_repeats(circuit)
5311 rewritten_circ = _rewrite_circuit_internal(
5312 capped_circuit, phys_to_log, active_gates_count
5313 )
5314 routing_qubits = {
5315 q for q, count in active_gates_count.items() if count == 0
5316 }
5317 active_qubits = all_qubits_set - routing_qubits
5318
5319 flat_circ = rewritten_circ.flattened()
5320
5321 tot_resets: Dict[int, int] = {q: 0 for q in active_qubits}
5322 tot_meas: Dict[int, int] = {q: 0 for q in active_qubits}
5323 meas_records: List[Tuple[int, ...]] = []
5324 used_in_detector: Set[int] = set()
5325 used_in_observable: Set[int] = set()
5326 first_detector_seen = False
5327 meas_before_first_det: Set[int] = set()
5328 r1_single_det_anc: Set[int] = set()
5329 multi_det_groups: List[Set[int]] = []
5330
5331 for inst in flat_circ:
5332 name = inst.name
5333 targets = inst.targets_copy()
5334 if name == "DETECTOR":
5335 first_detector_seen = True
5336 rec_tuples = [
5337 meas_records[len(meas_records) + t.value]
5338 for t in targets
5339 if t.is_measurement_record_target
5340 and 0 <= len(meas_records) + t.value < len(meas_records)
5341 ]
5342 rec_qubits = [q for qs in rec_tuples for q in qs]
5343 used_in_detector.update(rec_qubits)
5344 if len(rec_tuples) == 1 and len(rec_qubits) == 1:
5345 r1_single_det_anc.add(rec_qubits[0])
5346 elif len(rec_qubits) > 1:
5347 multi_det_groups.append(set(rec_qubits))
5348 elif name == "OBSERVABLE_INCLUDE":
5349 for t in targets:
5350 if t.is_measurement_record_target:
5351 idx = len(meas_records) + t.value
5352 if 0 <= idx < len(meas_records):
5353 used_in_observable.update(meas_records[idx])
5354 else:
5355 gd = stim.gate_data(name)
5356 if gd.is_reset:
5357 for t in targets:
5358 if t.qubit_value is not None and t.qubit_value in tot_resets:
5359 tot_resets[t.qubit_value] += 1
5360 if gd.produces_measurements:
5361 noise_ch = (
5362 gd.is_noisy_gate and 0 not in gd.num_parens_arguments_range
5363 )
5364 for grp in inst.target_groups():
5365 if name == "MPAD" or noise_ch:
5366 qs: Tuple[int, ...] = ()
5367 else:
5368 qs = tuple(
5369 t.qubit_value for t in grp
5370 if t.qubit_value is not None
5371 )
5372 if len(qs) == 1 and qs[0] in tot_meas:
5373 tot_meas[qs[0]] += 1
5374 if not first_detector_seen:
5375 meas_before_first_det.update(qs)
5376 meas_records.append(qs)
5377
5378 max_resets = max(tot_resets.values()) if tot_resets else 0
5379 max_meas = max(tot_meas.values()) if tot_meas else 0
5380
5381 data_qubits: Set[int] = set()
5382 anc_candidates: Set[int] = set()
5383
5384 for q in active_qubits:
5385 if max_resets > 1:
5386 is_data = (tot_resets[q] <= 1)
5387 elif max_meas > 1:
5388 is_data = (tot_meas[q] <= 1)
5389 else:
5390 if q not in used_in_detector:
5391 is_data = True
5392 else:
5393 is_data = (
5394 (q not in meas_before_first_det)
5395 or (q in used_in_observable)
5396 )
5397 if is_data:
5398 data_qubits.add(q)
5399 else:
5400 anc_candidates.add(q)
5401
5402 # First-round stabilizer & data-basis tracking
5403 reset_basis: Dict[int, str] = {}
5404 meas_basis: Dict[int, str] = {}
5405 first_round_insts: List[Tuple[str, List[int]]] = []
5406 measured_anc: Set[int] = set()
5407 has_any_anc_meas = False
5408 u1_cliffords = {
5409 "H", "H_XZ", "H_NXZ", "H_XY", "H_NXY", "H_YZ", "H_NYZ",
5410 "S", "S_DAG", "SQRT_Z", "SQRT_Z_DAG",
5411 "SQRT_X", "SQRT_X_DAG", "SQRT_Y", "SQRT_Y_DAG",
5412 "C_XYZ", "C_NXYZ", "C_XNYZ", "C_XYNZ",
5413 "C_ZYX", "C_NZYX", "C_ZNYX", "C_ZYNX",
5414 }
5415 u2_cliffords = {
5416 "CX", "ZCX", "CZ", "ZCZ", "CY", "ZCY",
5417 "XCX", "XCY", "XCZ", "YCX", "YCY", "YCZ",
5418 }
5419
5420 for inst in flat_circ:
5421 name = inst.name
5422 targets = inst.targets_copy()
5423 t_vals = [t.value for t in targets if t.is_qubit_target]
5424 if name in ["R", "RZ", "RX", "RY"]:
5425 if has_any_anc_meas and any(
5426 q in anc_candidates and q in measured_anc for q in t_vals
5427 ):
5428 break
5429 b = "X" if name == "RX" else ("Y" if name == "RY" else "Z")
5430 for q in t_vals:
5431 if q not in reset_basis:
5432 reset_basis[q] = b
5433 first_round_insts.append((name, t_vals))
5434 elif name in ["M", "MZ", "MX", "MY", "MR", "MRZ", "MRX", "MRY"]:
5435 if any(q in data_qubits for q in t_vals) and has_any_anc_meas:
5436 break
5437 if any(q in anc_candidates and q in measured_anc for q in t_vals):
5438 break
5439 b = (
5440 "X" if name in ["MX", "MRX"]
5441 else ("Y" if name in ["MY", "MRY"] else "Z")
5442 )
5443 for q in t_vals:
5444 if q in anc_candidates:
5445 meas_basis[q] = b
5446 measured_anc.add(q)
5447 has_any_anc_meas = True
5448 if q not in reset_basis and name in [
5449 "MR", "MRZ", "MRX", "MRY"
5450 ]:
5451 reset_basis[q] = b
5452 first_round_insts.append((name, t_vals))
5453 elif name in u1_cliffords:
5454 first_round_insts.append((name, t_vals))
5455 elif name in u2_cliffords:
5456 pair_vals: List[int] = []
5457 for a, b_t in zip(targets[::2], targets[1::2]):
5458 if a.is_qubit_target and b_t.is_qubit_target:
5459 pair_vals.extend([a.value, b_t.value])
5460 if pair_vals:
5461 first_round_insts.append((name, pair_vals))
5462
5463 c_xyz_set = {"C_XYZ", "C_NXYZ", "C_XNYZ", "C_XYNZ"}
5464 c_zyx_set = {"C_ZYX", "C_NZYX", "C_ZNYX", "C_ZYNX"}
5465
5466 def conj_1q(gate: str, p: str) -> str:
5467 if p == "I":
5468 return "I"
5469 if gate in ["H", "H_XZ", "H_NXZ", "SQRT_Y", "SQRT_Y_DAG"]:
5470 return "Z" if p == "X" else ("X" if p == "Z" else "Y")
5471 if gate in ["S", "S_DAG", "SQRT_Z", "SQRT_Z_DAG", "H_XY", "H_NXY"]:
5472 return "Y" if p == "X" else ("X" if p == "Y" else "Z")
5473 if gate in ["SQRT_X", "SQRT_X_DAG", "H_YZ", "H_NYZ"]:
5474 return "Z" if p == "Y" else ("Y" if p == "Z" else "X")
5475 if gate in c_xyz_set:
5476 return "Y" if p == "X" else ("Z" if p == "Y" else "X")
5477 if gate in c_zyx_set:
5478 return "Z" if p == "X" else ("Y" if p == "Z" else "X")
5479 return p
5480
5481 mul_tab = {
5482 ("I", "I"): "I", ("I", "X"): "X", ("I", "Y"): "Y", ("I", "Z"): "Z",
5483 ("X", "I"): "X", ("X", "X"): "I", ("X", "Y"): "Z", ("X", "Z"): "Y",
5484 ("Y", "I"): "Y", ("Y", "X"): "Z", ("Y", "Y"): "I", ("Y", "Z"): "X",
5485 ("Z", "I"): "Z", ("Z", "X"): "Y", ("Z", "Y"): "X", ("Z", "Z"): "I",
5486 }
5487
5488 def conj_2q(gate: str, p1: str, p2: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
5489 if p1 == "I" and p2 == "I":
5490 return "I", "I"
5491 if gate in ["CX", "ZCX"]:
5492 a, b = "Z", "X"
5493 elif gate in ["CZ", "ZCZ"]:
5494 a, b = "Z", "Z"
5495 elif gate in ["CY", "ZCY"]:
5496 a, b = "Z", "Y"
5497 elif gate == "XCX":
5498 a, b = "X", "X"
5499 elif gate == "XCY":
5500 a, b = "X", "Y"
5501 elif gate == "XCZ":
5502 a, b = "X", "Z"
5503 elif gate == "YCX":
5504 a, b = "Y", "X"
5505 elif gate == "YCY":
5506 a, b = "Y", "Y"
5507 elif gate == "YCZ":
5508 a, b = "Y", "Z"
5509 else:
5510 return p1, p2
5511 anti1 = (p1 != "I" and p1 != a)
5512 anti2 = (p2 != "I" and p2 != b)
5513 np1 = mul_tab[(p1, a)] if anti2 else p1
5514 np2 = mul_tab[(p2, b)] if anti1 else p2
5515 return np1, np2
5516
5517 # Simultaneously evolve all ancilla stabilizers and data initial bases
5518 # using bitmasks over sorted anc_list for O(1) gate updates.
5519 anc_list = sorted(list(anc_candidates))
5520 anc_to_bit = {anc: (1 << i) for i, anc in enumerate(anc_list)}
5521 all_anc_mask = (1 << len(anc_list)) - 1
5522 active_anc_mask = 0
5523 qx: Dict[int, int] = {q: 0 for q in all_qubits_set}
5524 qz: Dict[int, int] = {q: 0 for q in all_qubits_set}
5525
5526 for anc in anc_list:
5527 b = reset_basis.get(anc, meas_basis.get(anc, "Z"))
5528 bit = anc_to_bit[anc]
5529 if b in ["X", "Y"]:
5530 qx[anc] |= bit
5531 if b in ["Z", "Y"]:
5532 qz[anc] |= bit
5533 if anc not in reset_basis:
5534 active_anc_mask |= bit
5535
5536 data_init_basis: Dict[int, str] = {q: "Z" for q in data_qubits}
5537
5538 for name, t_vals in first_round_insts:
5539 if name in ["R", "RZ", "RX", "RY"]:
5540 b = "X" if name == "RX" else ("Y" if name == "RY" else "Z")
5541 for q in t_vals:
5542 if q in data_qubits:
5543 data_init_basis[q] = b
5544 if q in anc_to_bit:
5545 bit = anc_to_bit[q]
5546 if not (active_anc_mask & bit):
5547 active_anc_mask |= bit
5548 if b in ["X", "Y"]:
5549 qx[q] |= bit
5550 else:
5551 qx[q] &= ~bit
5552 if b in ["Z", "Y"]:
5553 qz[q] |= bit
5554 else:
5555 qz[q] &= ~bit
5556 elif name in ["M", "MZ", "MX", "MY", "MR", "MRZ", "MRX", "MRY"]:
5557 for q in t_vals:
5558 if q in anc_to_bit:
5559 active_anc_mask &= ~anc_to_bit[q]
5560 elif name in u1_cliffords:
5561 for q in t_vals:
5562 if q in data_qubits:
5563 data_init_basis[q] = conj_1q(name, data_init_basis[q])
5564 if q not in qx:
5565 continue
5566 # on a data qubit, the Paulis of all checks are transformed, also of the checks already measured:
5567 # all checks are then expressed in the same frame (that of the data qubits at the end of the first
5568 # round), e.g., for X checks measured in the Hadamard frame of the data qubits before the closing H
5569 # gates (with active_anc_mask, such checks would look like Z checks; see the tests)
5570 mask = active_anc_mask if q in anc_candidates else all_anc_mask
5571 x_m = qx[q] & mask
5572 z_m = qz[q] & mask
5573 if name in ["H", "H_XZ", "H_NXZ", "SQRT_Y", "SQRT_Y_DAG"]:
5574 nx_m, nz_m = z_m, x_m
5575 elif name in [
5576 "S", "S_DAG", "SQRT_Z", "SQRT_Z_DAG", "H_XY", "H_NXY"
5577 ]:
5578 nx_m, nz_m = x_m, x_m ^ z_m
5579 elif name in ["SQRT_X", "SQRT_X_DAG", "H_YZ", "H_NYZ"]:
5580 nx_m, nz_m = x_m ^ z_m, z_m
5581 elif name in c_xyz_set:
5582 nx_m, nz_m = x_m ^ z_m, x_m
5583 elif name in c_zyx_set:
5584 nx_m, nz_m = z_m, x_m ^ z_m
5585 else:
5586 nx_m, nz_m = x_m, z_m
5587 qx[q] = (qx[q] & ~mask) | nx_m
5588 qz[q] = (qz[q] & ~mask) | nz_m
5589 elif name in u2_cliffords:
5590 if name in ["CX", "ZCX"]:
5591 ax, az, bx, bz = 0, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, 0
5592 elif name in ["CZ", "ZCZ"]:
5593 ax, az, bx, bz = 0, all_anc_mask, 0, all_anc_mask
5594 elif name in ["CY", "ZCY"]:
5595 ax, az, bx, bz = 0, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask
5596 elif name == "XCX":
5597 ax, az, bx, bz = all_anc_mask, 0, all_anc_mask, 0
5598 elif name == "XCY":
5599 ax, az, bx, bz = all_anc_mask, 0, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask
5600 elif name == "XCZ":
5601 ax, az, bx, bz = all_anc_mask, 0, 0, all_anc_mask
5602 elif name == "YCX":
5603 ax, az, bx, bz = all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, 0
5604 elif name == "YCY":
5605 ax, az, bx, bz = (
5606 all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask
5607 )
5608 elif name == "YCZ":
5609 ax, az, bx, bz = all_anc_mask, all_anc_mask, 0, all_anc_mask
5610 else:
5611 continue
5612
5613 for idx in range(0, len(t_vals), 2):
5614 q1, q2 = t_vals[idx], t_vals[idx + 1]
5615 if q1 not in qx or q2 not in qx:
5616 continue
5617 mask = active_anc_mask
5618 if q1 in anc_to_bit and not (active_anc_mask & anc_to_bit[q1]):
5619 mask &= ~anc_to_bit[q1]
5620 if q2 in anc_to_bit and not (active_anc_mask & anc_to_bit[q2]):
5621 mask &= ~anc_to_bit[q2]
5622 x1 = qx[q1] & mask
5623 z1 = qz[q1] & mask
5624 x2 = qx[q2] & mask
5625 z2 = qz[q2] & mask
5626 anti1 = (x1 & (az & mask)) ^ (z1 & (ax & mask))
5627 anti2 = (x2 & (bz & mask)) ^ (z2 & (bx & mask))
5628 nx1 = x1 ^ (anti2 & ax)
5629 nz1 = z1 ^ (anti2 & az)
5630 nx2 = x2 ^ (anti1 & bx)
5631 nz2 = z2 ^ (anti1 & bz)
5632 qx[q1] = (qx[q1] & ~mask) | nx1
5633 qz[q1] = (qz[q1] & ~mask) | nz1
5634 qx[q2] = (qx[q2] & ~mask) | nx2
5635 qz[q2] = (qz[q2] & ~mask) | nz2
5636
5637 anc_data_paulis: Dict[int, Dict[int, str]] = {
5638 anc: {} for anc in anc_list
5639 }
5640 for q in data_qubits:
5641 xm = qx[q]
5642 zm = qz[q]
5643 active_m = xm | zm
5644 while active_m:
5645 lsb = active_m & -active_m
5646 anc_idx = lsb.bit_length() - 1
5647 anc = anc_list[anc_idx]
5648 has_x = bool(xm & lsb)
5649 has_z = bool(zm & lsb)
5650 p_str = (
5651 "Y" if (has_x and has_z)
5652 else ("X" if has_x else "Z")
5653 )
5654 anc_data_paulis[anc][q] = p_str
5655 active_m ^= lsb
5656
5657 active_ancillas = [a for a in anc_list if len(anc_data_paulis[a]) > 0]
5658 idle_ancillas = [a for a in anc_list if len(anc_data_paulis[a]) == 0]
5659 routing_qubits.update(idle_ancillas)
5660
5661 # Check commutation among active ancillas
5662 checks_commute = True
5663 for i in range(len(active_ancillas)):
5664 a1 = active_ancillas[i]
5665 s1 = anc_data_paulis[a1]
5666 for j in range(i + 1, len(active_ancillas)):
5667 a2 = active_ancillas[j]
5668 s2 = anc_data_paulis[a2]
5669 anti = 0
5670 for q, p1 in s1.items():
5671 p2 = s2.get(q)
5672 if p2 is not None and p1 != p2:
5673 anti ^= 1
5674 if anti != 0:
5675 checks_commute = False
5676 break
5677 if not checks_commute:
5678 break
5679
5680 # Build check-relation graph on active_ancillas via shared data qubits
5681 adj: Dict[int, Dict[int, int]] = {a: {} for a in active_ancillas}
5682 bipartite_paulis = True
5683 for q in data_qubits:
5684 touching = [
5685 (a, anc_data_paulis[a][q])
5686 for a in active_ancillas
5687 if q in anc_data_paulis[a]
5688 ]
5689 if not touching:
5690 continue
5691 pauli_set = {p for _, p in touching}
5692 if len(pauli_set) > 2:
5693 bipartite_paulis = False
5694 break
5695 a0, p0 = touching[0]
5696 for ak, pk in touching[1:]:
5697 rel = 0 if pk == p0 else 1
5698 if ak in adj[a0] and adj[a0][ak] != rel:
5699 bipartite_paulis = False
5700 break
5701 adj[a0][ak] = rel
5702 adj[ak][a0] = rel
5703 if not bipartite_paulis:
5704 break
5705
5706 # 2-color connected components of active_ancillas
5707 color: Dict[int, int] = {}
5708 components: List[Tuple[List[int], List[int]]] = []
5709 if bipartite_paulis:
5710 for a in active_ancillas:
5711 if a in color:
5712 continue
5713 c0: List[int] = []
5714 c1: List[int] = []
5715 color[a] = 0
5716 queue = [a]
5717 idx_q = 0
5718 while idx_q < len(queue):
5719 u = queue[idx_q]
5720 idx_q += 1
5721 if color[u] == 0:
5722 c0.append(u)
5723 else:
5724 c1.append(u)
5725 for v, rel in adj[u].items():
5726 expected = color[u] ^ rel
5727 if v not in color:
5728 color[v] = expected
5729 queue.append(v)
5730 elif color[v] != expected:
5731 bipartite_paulis = False
5732 break
5733 if not bipartite_paulis:
5734 break
5735 if not bipartite_paulis:
5736 break
5737 components.append((c0, c1))
5738
5739 # Determine if all checks are already pure-X or pure-Z (standard CSS)
5740 all_pure_xz = True
5741 for a in active_ancillas:
5742 ps = set(anc_data_paulis[a].values())
5743 if not (ps == {"X"} or ps == {"Z"}):
5744 all_pure_xz = False
5745 break
5746
5747 # Detect color code (pure X and pure Z checks with identical support)
5748 native_basis = detect_basis(
5749 circuit, filepath=filepath, basis_arg=basis_arg
5750 )
5751 final_det_anc: Set[int] = set()
5752 for grp in multi_det_groups:
5753 if grp & data_qubits:
5754 final_det_anc.update(grp & set(active_ancillas))
5755
5756 x_ancillas: Set[int] = set()
5757 z_ancillas: Set[int] = set()
5758 rotated_data_qubits: Set[int] = set()
5759 is_css = False
5760 is_rotated_css = False
5761
5762 if checks_commute and bipartite_paulis and active_ancillas:
5763 if all_pure_xz:
5764 for a in active_ancillas:
5765 ps = set(anc_data_paulis[a].values())
5766 if ps == {"X"}:
5767 x_ancillas.add(a)
5768 else:
5769 z_ancillas.add(a)
5770 x_supps = {
5771 frozenset(anc_data_paulis[a].keys()) for a in x_ancillas
5772 }
5773 z_supps = {
5774 frozenset(anc_data_paulis[a].keys()) for a in z_ancillas
5775 }
5776 is_color_code = (
5777 len(x_supps) > 0 and x_supps == z_supps
5778 and len(x_ancillas) == len(z_ancillas)
5779 )
5780 is_css = not is_color_code
5781 is_rotated_css = False
5782 else:
5783 is_css = True
5784 is_rotated_css = True
5785 for c0, c1 in components:
5786 # Score which sector is the primary memory basis
5787 def score_primary(sector: List[int]) -> Tuple[int, int, int]:
5788 r1_cnt = sum(1 for a in sector if a in r1_single_det_anc)
5789 fin_cnt = sum(1 for a in sector if a in final_det_anc)
5790 init_cnt = sum(
5791 1 for a in sector
5792 if all(
5793 anc_data_paulis[a][q] == data_init_basis.get(q, "Z")
5794 for q in anc_data_paulis[a]
5795 )
5796 )
5797 return (r1_cnt, fin_cnt, init_cnt)
5798
5799 sc0 = score_primary(c0)
5800 sc1 = score_primary(c1)
5801 if sc0 >= sc1:
5802 primary_sec, minority_sec = c0, c1
5803 else:
5804 primary_sec, minority_sec = c1, c0
5805
5806 if native_basis == "Z":
5807 z_ancillas.update(primary_sec)
5808 x_ancillas.update(minority_sec)
5809 else:
5810 x_ancillas.update(primary_sec)
5811 z_ancillas.update(minority_sec)
5812
5813 # Determine rotated data qubits (where check Pauli != sector label)
5814 for q in data_qubits:
5815 for a in active_ancillas:
5816 if q in anc_data_paulis[a]:
5817 sector_label = "X" if a in x_ancillas else "Z"
5818 if anc_data_paulis[a][q] != sector_label:
5819 rotated_data_qubits.add(q)
5820 break
5821 else:
5822 # Non-CSS fallback classification by majority Pauli weight
5823 is_css = False
5824 is_rotated_css = False
5825 for a in active_ancillas:
5826 s = anc_data_paulis[a]
5827 nx = sum(1 for p in s.values() if p == "X")
5828 nz = sum(1 for p in s.values() if p == "Z")
5829 if nz > nx:
5830 z_ancillas.add(a)
5831 else:
5832 x_ancillas.add(a)
5833
5834 return {
5835 "x_ancillas": sorted(list(x_ancillas)),
5836 "z_ancillas": sorted(list(z_ancillas)),
5837 "data_qubits": sorted(list(data_qubits)),
5838 "routing_qubits": sorted(list(routing_qubits)),
5839 "rotated_data_qubits": sorted(list(rotated_data_qubits)),
5840 "is_css": is_css,
5841 "is_rotated_css": is_rotated_css,
5842 "basis": native_basis,
5843 "rewritten_circuit": rewritten_circ,
5844 }
5845
5846
5847def verify_qubit_metadata(
5848 circuit: Any,
5849 verbose: bool = False,
5850 basis_arg: Optional[str] = None,
5851 filepath: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None
5852) -> Dict[str, Any]:
5853 """Verifies qubit classification and returns basis tracking metadata (see classify_qubits_thorough())."""
5854 return classify_qubits_thorough(
5855 circuit, verbose=verbose, basis_arg=basis_arg, filepath=filepath
5856 )
5857
5858
5859def strip_minority_detectors(
5860 circuit: Any,
5861 basis: str,
5862 verbose: bool = False,
5863 thorough: bool = True,
5864 thorough_res: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
5865 mask_out: Optional[List[bool]] = None
5866) -> Tuple[Any, int, int]:
5867 """Strips minority-basis (and empty) detectors from a Stim circuit.
5868
5869 Always uses ancilla and data basis tracking (and dynamic carrier tracking
5870 across SWAPs and syndrome handoffs) to identify each detector's basis.
5871 DETECTOR instructions with no measurement record targets are also stripped
5872 and counted in stripped_count (marked True in mask_out).
5873
5874 Args:
5875 circuit: A stim.Circuit object or path to a .stim file.
5876 basis: Primary memory basis ('X' or 'Z'). Detectors of the opposite
5877 basis (and empty detectors) are removed.
5878 verbose: Whether to print warnings/statistics.
5879 thorough: Kept for API compatibility (basis tracking is always enabled).
5880 thorough_res: Optional precomputed result from classify_qubits_thorough.
5881 mask_out: Optional list, extended by one entry per detector of the circuit (in the order of the detectors of
5882 its DEM, REPEAT blocks unrolled): True if the detector is stripped, False if it is kept.
5883
5884 Returns:
5885 Tuple of (simplified_circuit, stripped_count, kept_count).
5886 """
5887 stim = _get_stim()
5888 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
5889 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
5890
5891 t_res = (
5892 thorough_res
5893 if thorough_res is not None
5894 else classify_qubits_thorough(circuit, verbose=False, basis_arg=basis)
5895 )
5896 x_anc = set(t_res["x_ancillas"])
5897 z_anc = set(t_res["z_ancillas"])
5898 minority_basis = "Z" if basis.upper() == "X" else "X"
5899
5900 meas_carriers = track_circuit_carriers(circuit)
5901
5902 # Coordinate metadata for consistency check on standard (non-rotated) CSS
5903 qubit_coords: Dict[int, Tuple[float, ...]] = {}
5904
5905 def get_coords(blk: Any) -> None:
5906 for inst in blk:
5907 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
5908 get_coords(inst.body_copy())
5909 elif inst.name == "QUBIT_COORDS":
5910 args = inst.gate_args_copy()
5911 for t in inst.targets_copy():
5912 if t.is_qubit_target:
5913 qubit_coords[t.value] = tuple(float(x) for x in args)
5914
5915 get_coords(circuit)
5916 x_coords = {
5917 qubit_coords[q][:2]
5918 for q in x_anc
5919 if q in qubit_coords and len(qubit_coords[q]) >= 2
5920 }
5921 z_coords = {
5922 qubit_coords[q][:2]
5923 for q in z_anc
5924 if q in qubit_coords and len(qubit_coords[q]) >= 2
5925 }
5926 layout_well_defined = (
5927 not t_res.get("is_rotated_css", False)
5928 and len(x_coords) > 0
5929 and len(z_coords) > 0
5930 and x_coords.isdisjoint(z_coords)
5931 )
5932
5933 meas_history: List[Tuple[int, ...]] = []
5934 det_mask: List[bool] = [] # one entry per detector (REPEAT blocks unrolled): True if stripped
5935 stripped_count = 0
5936 kept_count = 0
5937 contradictions_c_count = 0
5938 floquet_suspected = False
5939
5940 def process_block(block: Any) -> Any:
5941 nonlocal stripped_count, kept_count
5942 nonlocal contradictions_c_count, floquet_suspected
5943 new_block = stim.Circuit()
5944 for inst in block:
5945 if isinstance(inst, stim.CircuitRepeatBlock):
5946 rep_count = inst.repeat_count
5947 if rep_count <= 0:
5948 continue
5949 body_copy = inst.body_copy()
5950 meas_before = len(meas_history)
5951 mask_before = len(det_mask)
5952 strip_before = stripped_count
5953 kept_before = kept_count
5954 new_body = process_block(body_copy)
5955 meas_after = len(meas_history)
5956 meas_per_rep = meas_after - meas_before
5957 if rep_count > 1:
5958 stripped_count += (stripped_count - strip_before) * (
5959 rep_count - 1
5960 )
5961 kept_count += (kept_count - kept_before) * (rep_count - 1)
5962 det_mask.extend(det_mask[mask_before:] * (rep_count - 1))
5963 if meas_per_rep > 0:
5964 meas_history.extend(
5965 meas_history[meas_before:meas_after]
5966 * (rep_count - 1)
5967 )
5968 new_block.append(stim.CircuitRepeatBlock(rep_count, new_body))
5969 elif inst.name == "DETECTOR":
5970 cur_meas = len(meas_history)
5971 rec_targets = [
5972 t for t in inst.targets_copy()
5973 if t.is_measurement_record_target
5974 ]
5975 if not rec_targets:
5976 stripped_count += 1
5977 det_mask.append(True)
5978 continue
5979
5980 qubits = [
5981 q
5982 for t in rec_targets
5983 if 0 <= cur_meas + t.value < cur_meas
5984 for q in meas_history[cur_meas + t.value]
5985 ]
5986 is_x_qubit = any(q in x_anc for q in qubits)
5987 is_z_qubit = any(q in z_anc for q in qubits)
5988 class_qubit = (
5989 "Both" if (is_x_qubit and is_z_qubit)
5990 else "X" if is_x_qubit
5991 else "Z" if is_z_qubit
5992 else "Unknown"
5993 )
5994
5995 args = inst.gate_args_copy()
5996 class_b = "Unknown"
5997 if layout_well_defined and args and len(args) >= 2:
5998 det_xy = (float(args[0]), float(args[1]))
5999 if det_xy in x_coords:
6000 class_b = "X"
6001 elif det_xy in z_coords:
6002 class_b = "Z"
6003
6004 class_c = "Unknown"
6005 if meas_carriers:
6006 carriers = [
6007 c
6008 for t in rec_targets
6009 if 0 <= cur_meas + t.value < len(meas_carriers)
6010 for c in meas_carriers[cur_meas + t.value]
6011 ]
6012 is_x_c = any(c in x_anc for c in carriers)
6013 is_z_c = any(c in z_anc for c in carriers)
6014 class_c = (
6015 "Both" if (is_x_c and is_z_c)
6016 else "X" if is_x_c
6017 else "Z" if is_z_c
6018 else "Unknown"
6019 )
6020
6021 is_minority = False
6022 if class_c != "Unknown":
6023 if class_c == "Both":
6024 contradictions_c_count += 1
6025 floquet_suspected = True
6026 elif class_b != "Unknown" and class_c != class_b:
6027 contradictions_c_count += 1
6028 elif len(rec_targets) == 1 and class_c == minority_basis:
6029 contradictions_c_count += 1
6030 is_minority = (class_c == minority_basis)
6031 elif layout_well_defined and class_b != "Unknown":
6032 is_minority = (class_b == minority_basis)
6033 elif len(rec_targets) == 1:
6034 is_minority = False
6035 else:
6036 if class_qubit == "Both":
6037 floquet_suspected = True
6038 is_minority = (class_qubit == minority_basis)
6039
6040 if is_minority:
6041 stripped_count += 1
6042 else:
6043 kept_count += 1
6044 new_block.append(inst)
6045 det_mask.append(is_minority)
6046 else:
6047 gd = stim.gate_data(inst.name)
6048 if gd.produces_measurements:
6049 if inst.name in ("MY", "MRY", "MYY"):
6050 floquet_suspected = True
6051 noise_ch = (
6052 gd.is_noisy_gate
6053 and 0 not in gd.num_parens_arguments_range
6054 )
6055 for grp in inst.target_groups():
6056 if inst.name == "MPAD" or noise_ch:
6057 meas_history.append(())
6058 else:
6059 meas_history.append(
6060 tuple(
6061 t.qubit_value for t in grp
6062 if t.qubit_value is not None
6063 )
6064 )
6065 new_block.append(inst)
6066 return new_block
6067
6068 simp_circuit = process_block(circuit)
6069 if mask_out is not None:
6070 mask_out.extend(det_mask)
6071
6072 if contradictions_c_count > 0 and verbose:
6073 sys.stderr.write(
6074 f"# Warning: {contradictions_c_count} detector contradiction(s) "
6075 "detected during dynamic carrier tracking.\n"
6076 )
6077 if floquet_suspected and verbose:
6078 sys.stderr.write(
6079 "# Warning: Floquet or dynamic measurement structure suspected; "
6080 "simplified circuit distance may be invalid.\n"
6081 )
6082
6083 return simp_circuit, stripped_count, kept_count
6084
6085
6086def _matrix_cache_key(H: Any, G: Optional[Any] = None, L: Optional[Any] = None, classical: bool = False) -> str:
6087 """
6088 Cache key of a classical code (H), or of a quantum code given by H with G (or with L). The two sectors of a CSS
6089 code are stored as the quantum codes (H=Hx, G=Hz) -> dZ and (H=Hz, G=Hx) -> dX (with L=Lx / L=Lz if given), so
6090 that compute_css_distance() and compute_quantum_distance() share their cache records.
6091 """
6092 h_state = get_sparse_array_state(H)
6093 if classical:
6094 return f"classical:{h_state}"
6095 if G is not None:
6096 return f"quantum:H={h_state}:G={get_sparse_array_state(G)}"
6097 return f"quantum:H={h_state}:L={get_sparse_array_state(L)}"
6098
