7529def _split_css_filename(filepath: Optional[str], sector: str) -> Optional[str]:
7530 """Generates sector-suffixed filename for CSS codewords (e.g. 'cws.nz' -> 'cws_X.nz')."""
7531 if not filepath:
7532 return None
7533 base, ext = os.path.splitext(filepath)
7534 if not ext:
7535 ext = ".nz"
7536 if base.endswith(f"_{sector}"):
7537 return f"{base}{ext}"
7538 elif base.endswith("_X") or base.endswith("_Z"):
7539 base = base[:-2]
7540 return f"{base}_{sector}{ext}"
7541
7542
7543def _css_sector_finc(finC: Optional[str], outC: Optional[str]) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str]]:
7544 """
7545 Input codeword files (finC_X, finC_Z) of the two CSS sectors: the sector files (e.g. 'cws.nz' -> 'cws_X.nz' and
7546 'cws_Z.nz') which exist and are not empty; if there are none, finC itself for both sectors (codewords which are
7547 not valid in a sector are skipped by the binary), unless finC is identical to outC and does not exist or is
7548 empty (see check_finc_outc()).
7549 """
7550 if not finC:
7551 return None, None
7552 files = [_split_css_filename(finC, s) for s in ("X", "Z")]
7553 files = [f if (os.path.isfile(f) and os.path.getsize(f) > 0) else None for f in files]
7554 if files[0] or files[1]:
7555 return files[0], files[1]
7556 raw = check_finc_outc(finC, outC)
7557 return raw, raw
7558
7559
7560def compute_css_distance(
7561 Hx: Any,
7562 Hz: Any,
7563 Lx: Optional[Any] = None,
7564 Lz: Optional[Any] = None,
7565 dist_m4ri: Optional[str] = None,
7566 method: int = 3,
7567 threads: Optional[int] = None,
7568 timeout: float = 60.0,
7569 num_steps: Optional[int] = None,
7570 d_exp: int = 0,
7571 d_min: int = 0,
7572 d_max: int = 0,
7573 dmin: int = 0,
7574 dmax: int = 0,
7575 dstop: int = 0,
7576 wmin: int = 1,
7577 wmax: int = 0,
7578 smax: Optional[int] = None,
7579 start: Optional[Union[int, str, Sequence[int]]] = None,
7580 cbeg: Optional[int] = None,
7581 cend: Optional[int] = None,
7582 noscan: int = 0,
7583 dW: int = -1,
7584 maxC: int = 0,
7585 finC: Optional[str] = None,
7586 outC: Optional[str] = None,
7587 do_cws: bool = False,
7588 cache_file: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
7589 solver: str = "dist_m4ri",
7590 codedistance_method: str = "QDistEvol",
7591 codedistance_params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
7592 seed: int = 0,
7593 debug: int = 0,
7594 verbose: bool = False,
7595 nothrottle: bool = False,
7596 chunk_size: int = 0,
7597 ksub: int = 0,
7598 kwin: int = 0,
7599 win_mode: int = 0,
7600 win_hyb: int = 0,
7601 pairs: int = -1,
7602 min_hits: Optional[int] = None,
7603 cov_cws: int = 100,
7604 refresh: Optional[int] = None,
7605 trust_start: bool = False,
7606 start_scan: bool = False,
7607 sort_rows: Optional[bool] = None,
7608 cc_prune: Optional[int] = None,
7609 ortho: bool = True,
7610 engine: Optional[str] = None,
7611 rw_opt: Optional[int] = None,
7612 table_gb: Optional[int] = None,
7613 **kwargs
7614) -> Tuple[Any, ...]:
7615 """
7616 Computes CSS quantum code distance d = min(d_X, d_Z).
7617
7618 Args:
7619 Hx: X-stabilizer parity check matrix (required, at least one row).
7620 Hz: Z-stabilizer parity check matrix (required, at least one row).
7621 Lx: Optional X-logical operator matrix (alternative to Hz as finG).
7622 Lz: Optional Z-logical operator matrix (alternative to Hx as finG).
7623 ortho: Expert option (default: True; since version 0.15.2): False skips the checks of the binary that the
7624 rows of Hx and Hz are orthogonal (Hx Hz^T = 0, in each sector with G; True: an error otherwise), e.g., to
7625 screen many codes which are orthogonal by construction; a warning is printed to stderr, and the result is
7626 valid only if Hx Hz^T = 0. No effect with both Lx and Lz. The cache key does not depend on it.
7627 dist_m4ri: Path to dist_m4ri executable (optional).
7628 method: Solver method (1=RW, 2=CC, 3=Bracketing default).
7629 threads: Maximum number of worker threads (default: all logical CPUs available; subject to throttling).
7630 timeout: Execution timeout in seconds (default: 60.0; 0 or inf: no limit).
7631 nothrottle: If True, the automatic thread throttling of the binary is disabled (default: False).
7632 chunk_size: Maximum RW batch claimed at once by a thread (default: 0: adaptive, 25-500 steps; in method=3,
7633 at most about 0.5 s of RW steps, and an RW thread leaves its batch between two steps for a CC round).
7634 num_steps: Maximum RW steps.
7635 min_hits: RW stops once the average number of hits per codeword reaches min_hits (with a nonzero resolved
7636 rw_opt, not counting the hits of the row slabs and of the hybrid index windows), both for the codewords of
7637 the minimum weight found and for a representative set of cov_cws lowest-weight codewords; with the
7638 canonical classes of rw_opt 16 (automatic for quantum codes and DEMs with kwin <= 0), once the classes of
7639 the minimum weight found by the uniform RW steps pass the Good-Turing and Chao2 tests instead (none found
7640 by them, e.g., on deep circuit DEMs: RW runs to num_steps or the timeout); see run_dist_m4ri(). Passed if
7641 not None and >= 0 (None, the default: the binary's 5; 0: off, and then the repeated hits are not counted,
7642 unless codewords are collected with do_cws, outC, or maxC).
7643 cov_cws: Size of the representative set of lowest-weight codewords for min_hits (default: 100; 0: only the
7644 minimum weight).
7645 kwin / win_mode: A window of kwin columns in every RW step (alias: win; win_mode=0, the default: a Tanner
7646 graph ball, 1: an index window); kwin=0 (default): the automatic hybrid windows for n >= 500 (with a
7647 nonzero resolved rw_opt, only for a DEM or with win_hyb > 0: matrices then use uniform random permutations;
7648 an automatic rw_opt which resolves to 0, e.g., on classical codes, keeps the hybrid windows), see win_hyb
7649 and run_dist_m4ri(); kwin=-1: no windows (uniform random permutations in every step).
7650 refresh: RW steps between the basis refreshes of the experimental ksub RW (passed if not None; None,
7651 the default: the binary's 5000 with ksub > 0; 0: no refresh).
7652 d_exp: Expected distance estimate.
7653 d_min / dmin: Known lower bound on d = min(dX, dZ), inclusive (a lower bound of both sectors).
7654 d_max / dmax: Known upper bound on d = min(dX, dZ), inclusive. As it is not an upper bound of either
7655 sector, it is passed to both sector runs as the stop target dstop (each sector is needed only up to this
7656 weight), and it is not stored in the sector cache records; the returned d is at most dmax.
7657 dstop: Stop target for the lower bound of d (default: 0 = off): both sector runs end once CC has certified
7658 dmin >= dstop, unless a lighter codeword is found (see compute_classical_distance()).
7659 wmin: Minimum distance of interest (terminate early if cw of weight <= wmin is found in RW or CC, default: 1).
7660 wmax: Maximum weight to search in CC.
7661 smax: Maximum syndrome weight for CC confinement profile.
7662 start: Expert option: list of CC start columns (int, comma-separated string "a,b,c", or
7663 sequence of ints; None or -1: all columns). CC clusters are grown only from the listed
7664 columns, and they are not limited to larger column indices. WARNING: the lower bound
7665 (and an exact result) is valid only if a code symmetry maps every minimum-weight codeword
7666 to one containing a listed column (e.g., one column per block of a quasi-cyclic code);
7667 the upper bound is always valid. Results are cached under the separate key
7668 '<key>:start=a,b,c'; only dmax and codewords update the main cache record.
7669 trust_start: Expert option: accept the start-list results as valid, i.e., also merge dmin and
7670 rw_steps into the main cache record, and copy an existing exact start-list record to the
7671 main record even if no calculation is needed (default: False).
7672 start_scan: Expert option, with start (default: False): a cluster grown from a listed column c only
7673 uses the columns > c (see run_dist_m4ri()), e.g., start=[0, l] for the two blocks of a two-block
7674 group-algebra code over an abelian group; cached under the key suffix ':start=a,b,c:scan' (not for a
7675 DEM: ignored with a warning).
7676 cbeg / cend / noscan: Disabled in the Python interface: accepted for backward compatibility,
7677 but ignored with a warning to stderr (use the dist_m4ri binary directly).
7678 sort_rows: Row order of H in the binary (see run_dist_m4ri()): True sorts the rows by increasing weight
7679 (faster CC for very different row weights with cc_prune=0), False keeps their order, and None (default)
7680 leaves the binary's default (sorted for matrices; the detectors of a DEM are kept in time order). The
7681 result and the cache key do not depend on it.
7682 cc_prune: The CC search of the binary (see run_dist_m4ri()): 0, the walk of the versions before 0.15.0; 1,
7683 the branch and bound (each codeword found once); 2, also the coverage and fractional cover bounds; None
7684 (default): the binary's default 1. The result and the cache key do not depend on it.
7685 win_hyb: Window size of the automatic hybrid RW steps (kwin=0, n >= 500: a window on every other step, for
7686 matrices only when the resolved rw_opt is 0 or win_hyb > 0; see run_dist_m4ri()); 0 (default): 256 columns
7687 for a DEM, 512 for matrices. The cache key does not depend on it.
7688 pairs: The RW pairs of non-pivot columns (p=2, see run_dist_m4ri()): the number of random pivot rows of
7689 their buckets (0: off; -1, the default: auto). The cache key does not depend on it.
7690 ksub: Experimental, should not be used (a warning is printed to stderr for ksub > 0 with method=1 or 3):
7691 subspace dimension sampled from ker(H) in RW (default: 0, full-matrix RW).
7692 dW: Extra weight window above dmin to collect codewords (only irreducible ones: not the union of a
7693 codeword and a disjoint nonzero vector with zero syndrome; the binary's default irred=1).
7694 maxC: Maximum number of codewords to collect.
7695 finC: Input file with initial codewords.
7696 outC: Output file to save codewords (NZLIST format).
7697 do_cws: Whether to return extracted X and Z codewords.
7698 cache_file: Optional JSON file path for persistent distance caching. The two sectors are cached as the
7699 quantum codes (H=Hx, G=Hz) -> dZ and (H=Hz, G=Hx) -> dX (with L=Lx / L=Lz if given), i.e., they share
7700 the records of compute_quantum_distance(); CSS records written before version 0.12.0 are converted.
7701 solver: "dist_m4ri", "cert", "tropidist", "auto", or "codedistance".
7702 codedistance_method: Method if using codedistance library.
7703 codedistance_params: Extra parameters for codedistance library.
7704 seed: Random seed.
7705 debug: Debug bitmap: the bits in BIN_DBG_MASK for the dist_m4ri binary, and the PY_DBG_* bits.
7706 verbose: Verbose reporting flag.
7707 engine: None or "dist_m4ri" (default): the dist_m4ri binary; "cert": qec_cert for each sector (as in
7708 compute_quantum_distance()); "tropidist": external `tropidist` subprocess for each sector (as in
7709 compute_quantum_distance(), constructing `Lx`/`Lz` over GF(2) when omitted); "auto" (since version
7710 0.17.0): the two-stage portfolio of compute_quantum_distance() for each sector (a distance-only method=3
7711 call): the binary first (Stage A, from the timeout as there), qec_cert (or tropidist when qec_cert is
7712 unavailable and tropidist is configured) only for a sector whose bracket is still open (Stage B; wmin =
7713 max(1, dmin_A), wmax = dmax_A - 1, qec_cert's upper-bound stage only for a wide bracket, and with wmin > 1
7714 search_opts={"force_dom": 1}, since version 0.17.4; since version 0.17.5, with a qec_cert which has the
7715 handoff parameters, also dmax_init=dmax_A and the codeword of weight dmax_A found in Stage A, see
7716 _cert_handoff_kw()), and the binary again with the time left if Stage B ends early with an open bracket;
7717 each sector has the whole timeout, as with the other engines.
7718 rw_opt: Expert option (since version 0.17.0): the stages of the RW search of the binary (None, the default:
7719 the binary's -1, automatic; 0: all off, the RW of version 0.16.1; a bitmask 1..63: only the stages listed,
7720 see run_dist_m4ri()). The distance and the cache key do not depend on it (for codeword collection, see
7721 run_dist_m4ri()).
7722 table_gb: Optional lookup-table memory budget in GiB for `engine="tropidist"` (or `engine="auto"` when
7723 falling back to `tropidist`; 0: tropidist default; ignored with a warning for other engines).
7724
7725 Returns:
7726 tuple (dist, dX_info, dZ_info, cws_X, cws_Z) if do_cws
7727 else (dist, dX_info, dZ_info)
7728 A code without logical operators (k = 0, the same in both sectors) gives (0, [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]) (since
7729 version 0.17.2, with every engine and solver, one note on stderr unless silent, a single sector run; not
7730 cached).
7731
7732 Raises:
7733 ValueError: if Hx or Hz is missing or empty (use compute_quantum_distance() for one sector, or
7734 compute_classical_distance() for a classical code), for matrices without columns (n = 0, since version
7735 0.17.2), for an invalid option value (e.g., start, cc_prune other than 0, 1, or 2, rw_opt outside -1..63,
7736 or negative table_gb), for method=2 with timeout <= 0 but without wmax, dmax, or dstop, or for do_cws /
7737 outC with solver="codedistance", engine="cert", or engine="tropidist".
7738 TypeError: for an unknown keyword argument (e.g., a misspelled option).
7739 FileNotFoundError: if the dist_m4ri binary is not found (see find_dist_m4ri_binary()).
7740 RuntimeError: if the binary (or tropidist) exits with an error (e.g., for a missing input file, or with
7741 ortho=True for rows of Hx and Hz which are not orthogonal).
7742 ImportError: if solver="codedistance", engine="cert", or engine="tropidist" is requested but unavailable.
7743 """
7744 def _as_matrix(M: Any) -> Any: # an array-like (e.g., a list of rows) as a NumPy array
7745 if M is None or isinstance(M, (str, Path)) or hasattr(M, 'shape'):
7746 return M
7747 import numpy as np
7748 return np.asarray(M)
7749
7750 Hx, Hz, Lx, Lz = (_as_matrix(M) for M in (Hx, Hz, Lx, Lz))
7751
7752 def _nonempty(M: Any) -> bool:
7753 return M is not None and (isinstance(M, (str, Path)) or (hasattr(M, 'shape') and M.shape[0] > 0))
7754
7755 if not (_nonempty(Hx) and _nonempty(Hz)):
7756 raise ValueError(
7757 "compute_css_distance() requires both Hx and Hz (file names, or matrices with at least one row); "
7758 "use compute_quantum_distance() for one sector, or compute_classical_distance() for a classical code."
7759 )
7760
7761 eff_dmin = dmin if dmin > 0 else d_min
7762 eff_dmax = dmax if dmax > 0 else d_max # an upper bound on d = min(dX, dZ), not on either sector
7763 _check_kwargs(compute_css_distance, kwargs)
7764 _check_has_columns("CSS", Hx, Hz, Lx, Lz)
7765 _check_rw_opt(rw_opt)
7766 eff_table_gb = _check_table_gb(table_gb)
7767 cert_mode = _resolve_cert_engine(solver, engine)
7768 is_codedist = solver == "codedistance" or str(engine or "").strip().lower() == "codedistance"
7769 start_list = _prepare_start_option(start, trust_start, noscan, cbeg, cend, solver, start_scan=start_scan,
7770 engine_cert=cert_mode if cert_mode in ("cert", "tropidist") else False)
7771 _warn_cert_ignored(cert_mode, finC=finC, smax=smax, dW=dW, maxC=maxC, method=method)
7772 _warn_table_gb_unused(eff_table_gb, cert_mode, is_codedist=is_codedist)
7773 _warn_experimental_ksub(ksub, method, solver)
7774 _warn_ortho(ortho, Lx is None or Lz is None, solver) # (G of the sectors: Hz unless Lx, Hx unless Lz)
7775
7776 if is_codedist:
7777 if do_cws or outC:
7778 raise ValueError("Codeword extraction is not supported with codedistance solver; use solver='dist_m4ri'.")
7779 _warn_codedistance_ignored(locals())
7780 codedistance = _get_codedistance()
7781 import numpy as np
7782 params = dict(codedistance_params or {})
7783 if num_steps is not None and "iterCount" not in params:
7784 params["iterCount"] = num_steps
7785
7786 if _k0_of_matrices(Hx, G=Hz): # (since 0.17.2)
7787 _k0_found("rank Hx + rank Hz = n", css=True)
7788 return (0, [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0])
7789 Hx_mat = Hx.toarray() if hasattr(Hx, 'toarray') else (
7790 np.asarray(Hx, dtype=np.int8) if isinstance(Hx, (np.ndarray, list)) else None
7791 )
7792 Hz_mat = Hz.toarray() if hasattr(Hz, 'toarray') else (
7793 np.asarray(Hz, dtype=np.int8) if isinstance(Hz, (np.ndarray, list)) else None
7794 )
7795 sector_d: Dict[str, int] = {}
7796 sector_info: Dict[str, List[int]] = {}
7797 for s in ("Z", "X"):
7798 res_s = codedistance.CSScodeDistance(
7799 Hx_mat, Hz_mat, method=codedistance_method, params=params.copy(),
7800 component=s, seed=seed if seed != 0 else None
7801 )
7802 sector_d[s] = res_s.get("d", -1)
7803 sector_info[s] = format_bounds_list(sector_d[s], sector_d[s], 0) if sector_d[s] > 0 else [0, 0, 0]
7804 d_z, d_x = sector_d["Z"], sector_d["X"]
7805 dist = min(d_z, d_x) if (d_z > 0 and d_x > 0) else max(d_z, d_x)
7806 return (dist, sector_info["X"], sector_info["Z"])
7807
7808 # Solver is native multithreaded dist_m4ri: the two sectors are quantum codes, (H=Hx, G=Hz) -> dZ and
7809 # (H=Hz, G=Hx) -> dX (with L=Lx / L=Lz instead if given), with the same cache records as compute_quantum_distance().
7810 # A user dmax (a bound on min(dX, dZ)) is not an upper bound of either sector: it is passed as the stop target.
7811 eff_cache_file = str(Path(cache_file).resolve()) if cache_file is not None else _distance_cache_file
7812 stops = [v for v in (dstop, eff_dmax) if v > 0]
7813 sector_stop = min(stops) if stops else 0
7814 need_cws = bool(do_cws or outC)
7815
7816 # Sector-specific input codewords: the files finC_X / finC_Z if they exist, otherwise finC itself
7817 finC_X, finC_Z = _css_sector_finc(finC, outC)
7818 if verbose and finC and not (finC_X or finC_Z):
7819 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Warning: finC='{finC}' (identical to outC) and its sector files are empty or "
7820 f"non-existent; silently ignoring input codewords.")
7821 if _use_distance_cache:
7822 if eff_cache_file:
7823 load_distance_cache(eff_cache_file)
7824 try:
7825 if _migrate_css_records(Hx, Hz, Lx, Lz, eff_cache_file) and verbose:
7826 print("[dist_m4ri] Converted the CSS cache records written before version 0.12.0 into sector records")
7827 except Exception:
7828 pass
7829
7830 codes = _css_sector_codes(Hx, Hz, Lx, Lz)
7831 res: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
7832 for s, finC_s in (("Z", finC_Z), ("X", finC_X)):
7833 H_s, G_s, L_s = codes[s]
7834 if verbose:
7835 dual = ("Hx" if s == "X" else "Hz") if G_s is not None else ("Lz" if s == "X" else "Lx")
7836 print(f"[dist_m4ri] CSS sector d{s}: H={'Hz' if s == 'X' else 'Hx'} with "
7837 f"{'G' if G_s is not None else 'L'}={dual}")
7838
7839 def run_native(t_budget: Optional[float], dmin_s: int, dmax_s: int, json_out: bool = False, s: str = s,
7840 H_s: Any = H_s, G_s: Any = G_s, L_s: Any = L_s,
7841 finC_s: Optional[str] = finC_s) -> Dict[str, Any]:
7842 return _cached_code_distance(
7843 H_s, G_s, L_s, False, f"CSS {s}-sector", dist_m4ri=dist_m4ri, method=method, threads=threads,
7844 timeout=t_budget, num_steps=num_steps, d_exp=d_exp, dmin=dmin_s, dmax=dmax_s, dstop=sector_stop,
7845 wmin=wmin, wmax=wmax, smax=smax, start_list=start_list, dW=dW, maxC=maxC, finC=finC_s,
7846 outC=_split_css_filename(outC, s) if outC else None, need_cws=need_cws, eff_cache_file=eff_cache_file,
7847 seed=seed, debug=debug, verbose=verbose, nothrottle=nothrottle, chunk_size=chunk_size, ksub=ksub,
7848 kwin=kwin if kwin != 0 else int(kwargs.get("win", 0) or 0), win_mode=win_mode, min_hits=min_hits,
7849 cov_cws=cov_cws, refresh=refresh, trust_start=trust_start, sort_rows=sort_rows, win_hyb=win_hyb,
7850 pairs=pairs, cc_prune=cc_prune, ortho=ortho, rw_opt=rw_opt, json_out=json_out
7851 )
7852
7853 if cert_mode == "auto" and _auto_cert_eligible(
7854 method=method, do_cws=do_cws, outC=outC, finC=finC_s, smax=smax, dW=dW, maxC=maxC, start_list=start_list,
7855 ):
7856 def run_cert(dmin_s: int, dmax_s: int, cert_dmin: int, t_lim: float,
7857 dm4ri_json: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, s: str = s, H_s: Any = H_s, G_s: Any = G_s,
7858 L_s: Any = L_s) -> Dict[str, Any]:
7859 t_call = time.monotonic()
7860
7861 def certify(w_lo: int, w_hi: int, dmax_c: int) -> Any:
7862 _, qec_io, qec_pipeline = _get_qec_cert() # (the import, before its time limit is counted)
7863 h_kw = _cert_handoff_kw(qec_pipeline, w_lo, dmax=dmax_c, dm4ri_json=dm4ri_json, debug=debug,
7864 verbose=verbose)
7865 return qec_pipeline.certify(
7866 qec_io.DistanceProblem(
7867 _cert_to_csr(H_s, qec_io), _cert_to_csr(L_s, qec_io), _cert_to_csr(G_s, qec_io)
7868 ),
7869 wmax=w_hi, threads=threads or (os.cpu_count() or 8),
7870 seed=seed if seed != 0 else 1, time_limit=_cert_time_left(t_lim, t_call), mode="auto",
7871 use_ub=_auto_stage_b_use_ub(dmin_s, dmax_s), **h_kw,
7872 )
7873 return _cert_code_distance(
7874 lambda: _matrix_cache_key(H_s, G_s, L_s, False), certify, label=f"CSS {s}-sector", dmin=dmin_s,
7875 dmax=dmax_s, dstop=sector_stop, wmax=wmax, eff_cache_file=eff_cache_file, debug=debug,
7876 verbose=verbose, certified_dmin=cert_dmin, keep_stats=True,
7877 )
7878 def run_trop(dmin_s: int, dmax_s: int, cert_dmin: int, t_lim: float,
7879 s: str = s, H_s: Any = H_s, G_s: Any = G_s, L_s: Any = L_s) -> Dict[str, Any]:
7880 def run_fn(w_lo: int, w_hi: int) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Any, Any]:
7881 H_csr, L_csr, k0_reason = _tropidist_prepare_quantum(H_s, G_s, L_s, ortho=ortho)
7882 if k0_reason is not None:
7883 return {"k0": k0_reason}, None, None
7884 rec = _run_tropidist(
7885 H_csr=H_csr, L_csr=L_csr, w_lo=w_lo, w_hi=w_hi, threads=threads, timeout=t_lim,
7886 table_gb=eff_table_gb, debug=debug, verbose=verbose,
7887 )
7888 return rec, H_csr, L_csr
7889 return _tropidist_code_distance(
7890 lambda: _matrix_cache_key(H_s, G_s, L_s, False), run_fn, label=f"CSS {s}-sector",
7891 dmin=dmin_s, dmax=dmax_s, dstop=sector_stop, wmax=wmax, eff_cache_file=eff_cache_file,
7892 debug=debug, verbose=verbose, certified_dmin=cert_dmin, keep_stats=True,
7893 )
7894 # (a sector: the user's dmax is a bound on min(dX, dZ), passed as the stop target, not as an upper bound)
7895 res[s] = _auto_two_stage(run_native, run_cert, timeout=timeout, dmin=eff_dmin, dmax=0, dstop=sector_stop,
7896 wmax=wmax, label=f"CSS {s}-sector", debug=debug, verbose=verbose,
7897 run_tropidist=run_trop)
7898 elif _can_delegate_to_tropidist(cert_mode, do_cws=do_cws, outC=outC):
7899 def run_trop_css(w_lo: int, w_hi: int, H_s: Any = H_s, G_s: Any = G_s,
7900 L_s: Any = L_s) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Any, Any]:
7901 H_csr, L_csr, k0_reason = _tropidist_prepare_quantum(H_s, G_s, L_s, ortho=ortho)
7902 if k0_reason is not None:
7903 return {"k0": k0_reason}, None, None
7904 rec = _run_tropidist(
7905 H_csr=H_csr, L_csr=L_csr, w_lo=w_lo, w_hi=w_hi, threads=threads, timeout=timeout,
7906 table_gb=eff_table_gb, debug=debug, verbose=verbose,
7907 )
7908 return rec, H_csr, L_csr
7909 res[s] = _tropidist_code_distance(
7910 lambda H_s=H_s, G_s=G_s, L_s=L_s: _matrix_cache_key(H_s, G_s, L_s, False),
7911 run_trop_css, label=f"CSS {s}-sector", dmin=eff_dmin, dmax=0, dstop=sector_stop, wmax=wmax,
7912 eff_cache_file=eff_cache_file, debug=debug, verbose=verbose,
7913 )
7914 elif _can_delegate_to_cert(
7915 cert_mode, method=method, do_cws=do_cws, outC=outC, finC=finC_s, smax=smax,
7916 dW=dW, maxC=maxC, start_list=start_list,
7917 ):
7918 _, qec_io, qec_pipeline = _get_qec_cert()
7919 mode_arg = "ub" if method == 1 else "auto"
7920 res[s] = _cert_code_distance(
7921 lambda H_s=H_s, G_s=G_s, L_s=L_s: _matrix_cache_key(H_s, G_s, L_s, False),
7922 lambda w_lo, w_hi, dmax_c, H_s=H_s, G_s=G_s, L_s=L_s: qec_pipeline.certify(
7923 qec_io.DistanceProblem(
7924 _cert_to_csr(H_s, qec_io), _cert_to_csr(L_s, qec_io), _cert_to_csr(G_s, qec_io)
7925 ),
7926 wmax=w_hi, threads=threads or (os.cpu_count() or 8),
7927 seed=seed if seed != 0 else 1,
7928 time_limit=_auto_timeout(timeout),
7929 mode=mode_arg,
7930 **_cert_handoff_kw(qec_pipeline, w_lo, search=mode_arg != "ub", dmax=dmax_c, debug=debug,
7931 verbose=verbose),
7932 ),
7933 label=f"CSS {s}-sector", dmin=eff_dmin, dmax=0, dstop=sector_stop, wmax=wmax,
7934 eff_cache_file=eff_cache_file, debug=debug, verbose=verbose,
7935 )
7936 else:
7937 res[s] = run_native(timeout, eff_dmin, 0)
7938 _last_css_stats[s] = dict(_last_run_stats)
7939 if res[s].get("k0"): # (no logical codeword: the same in the other sector; one note, no second run)
7940 other = "X" if s == "Z" else "Z"
7941 res[other], _last_css_stats[other] = dict(res[s]), dict(_last_run_stats)
7942 break
7943
7944 rx, rz = res["X"], res["Z"]
7945 dist, d_lo, d_hi, _ = _css_combine((rx["dmin"], rx["dmax"], rx["rw_steps"]),
7946 (rz["dmin"], rz["dmax"], rz["rw_steps"]), eff_dmax)
7947 if rx.get("k0") or rz.get("k0"):
7948 dist = 0
7949 if rx["cached"] and rz["cached"] and (debug & PY_DBG_CACHE) and not verbose:
7950 found = ("exact distance" if (d_lo > 0 and d_lo == d_hi) else
7951 f"dmin={d_lo} >= dstop={sector_stop}" if (sector_stop > 0 and d_lo >= sector_stop) else
7952 f"bounds dmin={d_lo}, dmax={d_hi}")
7953 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Cache hit for CSS distance ({found} known)!")
7954 if do_cws:
7955 return (dist, rx["d_info"], rz["d_info"], rx["cws"], rz["cws"])
7956 return (dist, rx["d_info"], rz["d_info"])
7957
7958
7959def _resolve_stim_dem_out_path(
7960 out_spec: Optional[Union[bool, str, Path]],
7961 circuit_src: str,
7962 mode_tag: str,
7963 ext: str,
7964 out_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None
7965) -> Optional[str]:
7966 """Resolves output filepath for --out-dem or --out-stim."""
7967 if out_spec is None or out_spec is False:
7968 return None
7969 if isinstance(out_spec, str) and out_spec.strip().lower() in (
7970 "0", "false", "no", "off", "none"
7971 ):
7972 return None
7973
7974 src_path = (
7975 Path(circuit_src)
7976 if (circuit_src and circuit_src != "stim.Circuit")
7977 else None
7978 )
7979 eff_out_dir = (
7980 Path(out_dir)
7981 if out_dir is not None
7982 else (src_path.parent if src_path is not None else Path("."))
7983 )
7984
7985 is_auto = (out_spec is True) or (
7986 isinstance(out_spec, str)
7987 and out_spec.strip().lower() in ("", "1", "true", "yes", "auto")
7988 )
7989 if is_auto:
7990 if src_path is not None:
7991 stem = src_path.stem
7992 if stem.endswith("_full") or stem.endswith("_simp"):
7993 stem = stem[:-5]
7994 else:
7995 stem = "circuit"
7996 out_path = eff_out_dir / f"{stem}{mode_tag}{ext}"
7997 else:
7998 spec_str = str(out_spec)
7999 spec_path = Path(spec_str)
8000 if not spec_path.is_absolute() and os.path.dirname(spec_str) == "":
8001 out_path = eff_out_dir / spec_path
8002 else:
8003 out_path = spec_path
8004
8005 parent_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(str(out_path)))
8006 if parent_dir:
8007 os.makedirs(parent_dir, exist_ok=True)
8008 return str(out_path)
8009
8010
8011def _circuit_dem(circuit: Any) -> Tuple[Any, bool, bool]:
8012 """
8013 The DEM of a Stim circuit: with decompose_errors=True if stim can decompose its errors (otherwise without). An
8014 error channel with disjoint cases which stim cannot write as independent error mechanisms (e.g., a PAULI_CHANNEL_1
8015 with X and Z but no Y errors, PAULI_CHANNEL_2, or ELSE_CORRELATED_ERROR) needs approximate_disjoint_errors=True,
8016 which is used only if the conversion fails without it: it only changes the probabilities of the error mechanisms,
8017 not which errors are possible (so neither the distance, unless pmin > 0, nor the codewords).
8018
8019 Returns:
8020 (dem, decompose_errors, approximate_disjoint_errors): the DEM, and the options used.
8021 """
8022 error: Optional[Exception] = None
8023 for approx in (False, True):
8024 for decomp in (True, False):
8025 try:
8026 return circuit.detector_error_model(decompose_errors=decomp, approximate_disjoint_errors=approx), \
8027 decomp, approx
8028 except Exception as e: # (stim raises ValueError)
8029 error = e
8030 assert error is not None
8031 raise error
8032
8033
8034def _warn_disabled_simple_full(simple: Optional[bool] = None, full: Optional[bool] = None, cli: bool = False) -> None:
8035 """
8036 Writes a warning to stderr if the options simple or full (CLI: --simple, --full) are given: they are disabled since
8037 version 0.13.0 (accepted for backward compatibility, but ignored). The DEM of a Stim circuit always has all
8038 detectors, and the binary drops detectors if this is exact (drop=auto, the default; e.g., the minority-basis
8039 detectors of a CSS circuit, which the simple mode stripped): as fast, with the distance of the full DEM (the
8040 simplified DEM only gives a lower bound when dropping them is not exact).
8041 """
8042 names = [f"--{n}" if cli else f"{n}=" for n, v in (("simple", simple), ("full", full)) if v is not None]
8043 if names:
8044 _warn_disabled(f"{', '.join(names)}: disabled since version 0.13.0, ignored: the DEM of a Stim circuit has all "
8045 f"detectors, and the binary drops detectors if this is exact (drop=auto, the default, e.g., the "
8046 f"minority-basis detectors of a CSS circuit; drop=0 keeps them)")
8047
8048
8049def _dem_from_input(
8050 dem: Optional[Any],
8051 circuit: Optional[Any],
8052 basis: Optional[str] = None,
8053 rounds: Optional[int] = None,
8054 p_noise: float = 0.001,
8055 out_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
8056 out_dem: Optional[Union[bool, str, Path]] = None,
8057 out_stim: Optional[Union[bool, str, Path]] = None,
8058 circ_verbose: bool = False,
8059 drop_out: Optional[List[int]] = None,
8060 force_noise: bool = False
8061) -> Tuple[Any, Optional[Any], Optional[str]]:
8062 """
8063 The DEM of compute_dem_distance() (also used by get_cached_distance() for the cache key). A DEM
8064 (stim.DetectorErrorModel or .dem file) is used as given. A Stim circuit (stim.Circuit or .stim file, also when
8065 given as `dem`) is processed: the empty detectors are removed, the qubits are classified, the REPEAT count is set
8066 (rounds), and circuit-level noise of strength p_noise is added to a noiseless circuit (see add_noise(); none for
8067 p_noise=0), or with force_noise=True replaces the noise of the circuit (see strip_noise(); with p_noise=0, all noise
8068 is removed); then it is converted to a DEM (with all detectors). The processed circuit and the DEM are saved if
8069 requested (out_stim, out_dem, out_dir; see compute_dem_distance()). For a CSS circuit, the list drop_out (if given)
8070 is extended by the minority-basis detectors (0-based detectors of the DEM, see strip_minority_detectors()), which
8071 the binary drops if this is exact (drop=css, passed as drop=FILE). The qubits are only classified for drop_out and
8072 circ_verbose.
8073
8074 Returns:
8075 (dem, circuit, saved_dem_path): the DEM (object or file name), the processed circuit (None for a DEM input),
8076 and the file to which the DEM was saved (None if it was not saved).
8077 """
8078 if dem is not None and circuit is not None:
8079 _warn_ignored("both 'dem' and 'circuit' were given; using 'dem' (the circuit is ignored).")
8080 circuit = None
8081 for what, src in (("DEM", dem), ("Stim circuit", circuit)): # (since version 0.17.2: a missing file was taken
8082 # for the text of a DEM)
8083 if isinstance(src, Path) or (isinstance(src, str) and "\n" not in src and "(" not in src):
8084 if not os.path.isfile(str(src)):
8085 raise FileNotFoundError(f"{what} file not found: '{src}'")
8086 if dem is not None and isinstance(dem, (str, Path)) and str(dem).endswith(".stim"):
8087 circuit = dem
8088 dem = None
8089
8090 if rounds is not None and circuit is None:
8091 raise ValueError(
8092 "--rounds option is only supported for Stim circuit (.stim) inputs."
8093 )
8094
8095 saved_dem_path: Optional[str] = None
8096 if dem is None and circuit is not None:
8097 circuit_src = str(circuit) if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)) else "stim.Circuit"
8098 if isinstance(circuit, (str, Path)):
8099 stim = _get_stim()
8100 circuit = stim.Circuit.from_file(str(circuit))
8101 if not hasattr(circuit, 'detector_error_model'):
8102 raise ValueError("Provided circuit object does not have detector_error_model() method.")
8103 has_rep = False
8104 if rounds is not None:
8105 if rounds < 0:
8106 raise ValueError(f"Invalid rounds={rounds}; must be >= 0.")
8107 has_rep = has_repeat_block(circuit)
8108 if not has_rep:
8109 sys.stderr.write(
8110 f"# Warning: Circuit '{circuit_src}' does not contain a "
8111 f"REPEAT block; ignoring rounds={rounds}.\n"
8112 )
8113
8114 circuit, empty_removed = remove_empty_detectors(circuit)
8115 if empty_removed > 0 and circ_verbose:
8116 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Removed {empty_removed} empty DETECTOR(s) from '{circuit_src}'")
8117
8118 filepath_hint = circuit_src if circuit_src != "stim.Circuit" else None
8119 t_res: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None # the classification of the qubits (only for drop=css and verbose)
8120 if circ_verbose or drop_out is not None:
8121 t_res = classify_qubits_thorough(circuit, verbose=False, basis_arg=basis, filepath=filepath_hint)
8122
8123 if rounds is not None and has_rep:
8124 circuit = set_circuit_rounds(circuit, rounds)
8125
8126 n_minority = None
8127 if t_res is not None and t_res["is_css"] and drop_out is not None:
8128 # the minority-basis detectors, for the exact reduction of the DEM in the binary (drop=css)
8129 mask: List[bool] = []
8130 strip_minority_detectors(circuit, t_res["basis"], verbose=False, thorough=True, thorough_res=t_res,
8131 mask_out=mask)
8132 if len(mask) == circuit.num_detectors:
8133 drop_out.extend(i for i, s in enumerate(mask) if s)
8134 n_minority = sum(mask)
8135 elif circ_verbose:
8136 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Warning: {len(mask)} detectors classified, but the circuit has "
8137 f"{circuit.num_detectors}; no detectors to drop")
8138
8139 mode_tag = "_full" # (the default names of the saved files, see _resolve_stim_dem_out_path())
8140
8141 if circ_verbose and t_res is not None:
8142 is_css_circ, is_rot_css = t_res["is_css"], t_res.get("is_rotated_css", False)
8143 css_type = "rotated-CSS (e.g. XZZX)" if is_rot_css else ("CSS" if is_css_circ else "non-CSS")
8144 rot_info = f", rotated_data={len(t_res.get('rotated_data_qubits', []))}" if is_rot_css else ""
8145 rnd_cnt = count_circuit_rounds(circuit)
8146 print(
8147 f"[dist_m4ri] Circuit basis tracking: type={css_type}, "
8148 f"basis={t_res['basis']}, data={len(t_res['data_qubits'])}, "
8149 f"X_anc={len(t_res['x_ancillas'])}, "
8150 f"Z_anc={len(t_res['z_ancillas'])}, "
8151 f"routing={len(t_res['routing_qubits'])}{rot_info}, "
8152 f"rounds={rnd_cnt}"
8153 )
8154 minority = (f", minority-basis={n_minority} (drop=css: the binary drops them if this is exact)"
8155 if n_minority is not None else "")
8156 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Circuit detectors: {circuit.num_detectors}{minority}")
8157
8158 if force_noise: # the noise of the circuit is replaced (p_noise=0: removed)
8159 noise_msg = (f"replaced the noise by circuit-level noise (p={p_noise})" if p_noise > 0.0 else
8160 "removed all noise (p_noise=0)")
8161 circuit = add_noise(circuit, p=p_noise, force=True)
8162 elif has_noise(circuit):
8163 noise_msg = "existing noise detected"
8164 elif p_noise > 0.0:
8165 noise_msg = f"added circuit-level noise (p={p_noise})"
8166 circuit = add_noise(circuit, p=p_noise)
8167 else:
8168 noise_msg = "no noise added (p_noise=0)"
8169
8170 stim_out_path = _resolve_stim_dem_out_path(out_stim, circuit_src, mode_tag, ".stim", out_dir=out_dir)
8171 if stim_out_path is not None:
8172 circuit.to_file(stim_out_path)
8173 if circ_verbose:
8174 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Saved Stim circuit to '{stim_out_path}'")
8175
8176 dem, decomp_used, approx_used = _circuit_dem(circuit)
8177 if circ_verbose:
8178 approx_msg = ", approximate_disjoint_errors=True" if approx_used else ""
8179 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Converted '{circuit_src}' to DEM ({noise_msg}, decompose_errors={decomp_used}"
8180 f"{approx_msg})")
8181 if all(hasattr(dem, a) for a in ("num_detectors", "num_observables", "num_errors")):
8182 print(
8183 f"[dist_m4ri] DEM size: {dem.num_detectors} detectors, {dem.num_observables} observables, "
8184 f"{dem.num_errors} error mechanisms"
8185 )
8186
8187 dem_out_path = _resolve_stim_dem_out_path(out_dem, circuit_src, mode_tag, ".dem", out_dir=out_dir)
8188 if dem_out_path is not None:
8189 _write_dem_file(dem, dem_out_path)
8190 saved_dem_path = dem_out_path
8191 if circ_verbose:
8192 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Saved DEM to '{dem_out_path}'")
8193 elif dem is not None and out_dem is not None and out_dem is not False:
8194 dem_src = str(dem) if isinstance(dem, (str, Path)) else "stim.Circuit"
8195 dem_out_path = _resolve_stim_dem_out_path(out_dem, dem_src, "_full", ".dem", out_dir=out_dir)
8196 if dem_out_path is not None:
8197 if isinstance(dem, (str, Path)) and os.path.exists(str(dem)):
8198 if os.path.abspath(str(dem)) != os.path.abspath(dem_out_path):
8199 shutil.copyfile(str(dem), dem_out_path)
8200 else:
8201 _write_dem_file(dem, dem_out_path)
8202 saved_dem_path = dem_out_path
8203 if circ_verbose:
8204 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Saved DEM to '{dem_out_path}'")
8205
8206 if dem is None:
8207 raise ValueError("Either 'dem' or 'circuit' must be provided.")
8208 return dem, circuit, saved_dem_path
8209
8210
8211def compute_dem_distance(
8212 dem: Optional[Any] = None,
8213 circuit: Optional[Any] = None,
8214 dist_m4ri: Optional[str] = None,
8215 method: int = 3,
8216 threads: Optional[int] = None,
8217 timeout: float = 60.0,
8218 num_steps: Optional[int] = None,
8219 d_exp: int = 0,
8220 d_min: int = 0,
8221 d_max: int = 0,
8222 dmin: int = 0,
8223 dmax: int = 0,
8224 dstop: int = 0,
8225 wmin: int = 1,
8226 wmax: int = 0,
8227 smax: Optional[int] = None,
8228 start: Optional[Union[int, str, Sequence[int]]] = None,
8229 cbeg: Optional[int] = None,
8230 cend: Optional[int] = None,
8231 noscan: int = 0,
8232 dW: int = -1,
8233 maxC: int = 0,
8234 pmin: float = 0.0,
8235 merge: bool = True,
8236 expand: bool = False,
8237 drop: Optional[Union[bool, int, str, Path]] = None,
8238 outD: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
8239 out_reduced: Optional[Union[bool, str, Path]] = None,
8240 finC: Optional[str] = None,
8241 outC: Optional[str] = None,
8242 do_cws: bool = False,
8243 cache_file: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
8244 solver: str = "dist_m4ri",
8245 codedistance_method: str = "UndetectableErrorStim",
8246 codedistance_params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
8247 seed: int = 0,
8248 debug: int = 0,
8249 verbose: bool = False,
8250 nothrottle: bool = False,
8251 chunk_size: int = 0,
8252 ksub: int = 0,
8253 kwin: int = 0,
8254 win_mode: int = 0,
8255 win_hyb: int = 0,
8256 pairs: int = -1,
8257 min_hits: Optional[int] = None,
8258 cov_cws: int = 100,
8259 refresh: Optional[int] = None,
8260 simple: Optional[bool] = None,
8261 full: Optional[bool] = None,
8262 basis: Optional[str] = None,
8263 rounds: Optional[int] = None,
8264 out_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
8265 out_dem: Optional[Union[bool, str, Path]] = None,
8266 out_stim: Optional[Union[bool, str, Path]] = None,
8267 p_noise: float = 0.001,
8268 force_noise: bool = False,
8269 trust_start: bool = False,
8270 start_scan: bool = False,
8271 sort_rows: Optional[bool] = None,
8272 cc_prune: Optional[int] = None,
8273 engine: Optional[str] = None,
8274 rw_opt: Optional[int] = None,
8275 dem_rounds: Optional[int] = None,
8276 table_gb: Optional[int] = None,
8277 **kwargs
8278) -> Tuple[Any, ...]:
8279 """
8280 Computes minimum graph/hypergraph distance of a Stim Detector Error Model (DEM).
8281
8282 Args:
8283 dem: stim.DetectorErrorModel object or path to .dem / .stim file.
8284 circuit: stim.Circuit object or path to .stim file (converted to DEM; if stim cannot write an error channel with
8285 disjoint cases, e.g., a PAULI_CHANNEL_1 without Y errors, as independent error mechanisms, with
8286 approximate_disjoint_errors=True, which only changes the probabilities of the error mechanisms).
8287 dist_m4ri: Path to dist_m4ri executable (optional).
8288 method: Solver method (1=RW, 2=CC, 3=Bracketing default).
8289 threads: Maximum number of worker threads (default: all logical CPUs available; subject to throttling).
8290 timeout: Execution timeout in seconds (default: 60.0; 0 or inf: no limit).
8291 nothrottle: If True, the automatic thread throttling of the binary is disabled (default: False).
8292 chunk_size: Maximum RW batch claimed at once by a thread (default: 0: adaptive, 25-500 steps; in method=3,
8293 at most about 0.5 s of RW steps, and an RW thread leaves its batch between two steps for a CC round).
8294 num_steps: Maximum RW steps.
8295 min_hits: RW stops once the average number of hits per codeword reaches min_hits (with a nonzero resolved
8296 rw_opt, not counting the hits of the row slabs and of the hybrid index windows), both for the codewords of
8297 the minimum weight found and for a representative set of cov_cws lowest-weight codewords; with the
8298 canonical classes of rw_opt 16 (automatic for quantum codes and DEMs with kwin <= 0), once the classes of
8299 the minimum weight found by the uniform RW steps pass the Good-Turing and Chao2 tests instead (none found
8300 by them, e.g., on deep circuit DEMs: RW runs to num_steps or the timeout); see run_dist_m4ri(). Passed if
8301 not None and >= 0 (None, the default: the binary's 5; 0: off, and then the repeated hits are not counted,
8302 unless codewords are collected with do_cws, outC, or maxC).
8303 cov_cws: Size of the representative set of lowest-weight codewords for min_hits (default: 100; 0: only the
8304 minimum weight).
8305 kwin / win_mode: A window of kwin columns in every RW step (alias: win; win_mode=0, the default: a Tanner
8306 graph ball, 1: an index window); kwin=0 (default): the automatic hybrid windows for n >= 500 (with a
8307 nonzero resolved rw_opt, only for a DEM or with win_hyb > 0: matrices then use uniform random permutations;
8308 an automatic rw_opt which resolves to 0, e.g., on classical codes, keeps the hybrid windows), see win_hyb
8309 and run_dist_m4ri(); kwin=-1: no windows (uniform random permutations in every step).
8310 refresh: RW steps between the basis refreshes of the experimental ksub RW (passed if not None; None,
8311 the default: the binary's 5000 with ksub > 0; 0: no refresh).
8312 d_exp: Expected distance estimate.
8313 d_min / dmin: Known lower bound on distance, inclusive.
8314 d_max / dmax: Known upper bound on distance, inclusive.
8315 dstop: Stop target for the lower bound (see compute_classical_distance(); default: 0 = off).
8316 wmin: Minimum distance of interest (terminate early if cw of weight <= wmin is found in RW or CC, default: 1).
8317 wmax: Maximum weight to search in CC.
8318 smax: Maximum syndrome weight for CC confinement profile.
8319 start: Expert option: list of CC start columns (int, comma-separated string "a,b,c", or
8320 sequence of ints; None or -1: all columns). CC clusters are grown only from the listed
8321 columns, and they are not limited to larger column indices. WARNING: the lower bound
8322 (and an exact result) is valid only if a code symmetry maps every minimum-weight codeword
8323 to one containing a listed column (e.g., one column per block of a quasi-cyclic code);
8324 the upper bound is always valid. Results are cached under the separate key
8325 '<key>:start=a,b,c'; only dmax and codewords update the main cache record.
8326 trust_start: Expert option: accept the start-list results as valid, i.e., also merge dmin and
8327 rw_steps into the main cache record, and copy an existing exact start-list record to the
8328 main record even if no calculation is needed (default: False).
8329 start_scan: Expert option, with start (default: False): a cluster grown from a listed column c only
8330 uses the columns > c (see run_dist_m4ri()), e.g., start=[0, l] for the two blocks of a two-block
8331 group-algebra code over an abelian group; cached under the key suffix ':start=a,b,c:scan' (not for a
8332 DEM: ignored with a warning).
8333 cbeg / cend / noscan: Disabled in the Python interface: accepted for backward compatibility,
8334 but ignored with a warning to stderr (use the dist_m4ri binary directly).
8335 sort_rows: Row order of H in the binary (see run_dist_m4ri()): True sorts the rows by increasing weight
8336 (faster CC for very different row weights with cc_prune=0), False keeps their order, and None (default)
8337 leaves the binary's default (sorted for matrices; the detectors of a DEM are kept in time order). The
8338 result and the cache key do not depend on it.
8339 cc_prune: The CC search of the binary (see run_dist_m4ri()): 0, the walk of the versions before 0.15.0; 1,
8340 the branch and bound (each codeword found once); 2, also the coverage and fractional cover bounds; None
8341 (default): the binary's default 1. The result and the cache key do not depend on it.
8342 win_hyb: Window size of the automatic hybrid RW steps (kwin=0, n >= 500: a window on every other step, for
8343 matrices only when the resolved rw_opt is 0 or win_hyb > 0; see run_dist_m4ri()); 0 (default): 256 columns
8344 for a DEM, 512 for matrices. The cache key does not depend on it.
8345 pairs: The RW pairs of non-pivot columns (p=2, see run_dist_m4ri()): the number of random pivot rows of
8346 their buckets (0: off; -1, the default: auto). The cache key does not depend on it.
8347 ksub: Experimental, should not be used (a warning is printed to stderr for ksub > 0 with method=1 or 3):
8348 subspace dimension sampled from ker(H) in RW (default: 0, full-matrix RW).
8349 dW: Extra weight window above dmin to collect codewords (only irreducible ones: not the union of a
8350 codeword and a disjoint nonzero vector with zero syndrome; the binary's default irred=1).
8351 maxC: Maximum number of codewords to collect (with expand=True, also the maximum number of codewords of the
8352 expanded list returned and written to outC; a warning is printed to stderr if some are dropped).
8353 pmin: Probability cutoff for error mechanisms in DEM.
8354 Note: CC start columns (start) and the codewords (finC, outC, do_cws) index the error mechanisms in
8355 their order of appearance in the (flattened) DEM, after the pmin cutoff: with another pmin, the columns
8356 (and the codewords) change.
8357 merge: Merge the equal columns of the DEM (error mechanisms with the same detectors and observables) in the
8358 binary (default: True). Exact: dropping two equal columns of a codeword gives a lighter one, so the
8359 distance does not change (and the cache key does not depend on merge). Column indices (finC, outC,
8360 start, the returned codewords) are those of the DEM; the codewords found use the first one of each set
8361 of equal columns (merge=False: all columns are kept, e.g., to enumerate the codewords with each of them;
8362 or expand=True to expand the list found).
8363 expand: If True, the codewords returned and written to outC are expanded in Python: each codeword is listed
8364 once for every choice among equal columns (default: False; see _expand_equal_columns()). The binary
8365 and the cache keep the merged list. With dW <= 1, the expanded list is that of merge=False (with
8366 dW >= 2, merge=False also lists lighter codewords with two equal columns added). The expanded list can
8367 be much longer (it grows quickly with the weight); with maxC > 0, it is cut at maxC codewords.
8368 drop: The detectors which the binary drops if this is verified to be exact, so that the distance (and every
8369 codeword found) is that of the DEM, found from the DEM without these detectors and the errors touching
8370 them (fewer detectors and errors: as fast as the DEM with only the primary-basis detectors of a CSS
8371 circuit). None, True, 1, or "auto" (default): the binary searches for the largest such set in the DEM alone
8372 (drop=auto, see the README), e.g., the minority-basis detectors of a CSS circuit (with the usual noise).
8373 "css": for a Stim circuit classified as CSS, its minority-basis detectors (see strip_minority_detectors()),
8374 passed as a file (otherwise, e.g., for a DEM, drop=auto is used, with a warning). False or 0: no detectors
8375 are dropped. A file name: the file with the detectors to drop (0-based, k for Dk; see read_drop_file()),
8376 for any DEM. With "css" or a file, if dropping the detectors is not exact, a note is printed to stderr and
8377 the full DEM is used. The codewords found use only the errors touching no dropped detector.
8378 outD: File to which the binary writes the detectors dropped (0-based, see read_drop_file()); with a cached
8379 result, the binary is run only to find them (with dmin = dmax: no search).
8380 out_reduced: True or a prefix PREFIX: writes the DEM without the detectors dropped (see outD) to
8381 PREFIX_red.dem, and the maps to the original DEM (its detectors and errors) to PREFIX_red.json, see
8382 write_reduced_dem() (True: PREFIX = <basename>, in out_dir or the directory of the input file).
8383 finC: Input file with initial codewords.
8384 outC: Output file to save codewords (NZLIST format).
8385 do_cws: Whether to return extracted error mechanisms / codewords.
8386 cache_file: Optional JSON file path for persistent distance caching.
8387 solver: "dist_m4ri", "cert", "tropidist", "auto", or "codedistance".
8388 codedistance_method: Method if using codedistance library.
8389 codedistance_params: Extra parameters for codedistance library.
8390 seed: Random seed.
8391 debug: Debug bitmap: the bits in BIN_DBG_MASK for the dist_m4ri binary, and the PY_DBG_* bits.
8392 verbose: Verbose reporting flag.
8393 simple / full: Disabled since version 0.13.0 (accepted for backward compatibility, but ignored with a warning
8394 to stderr): the DEM of a Stim circuit always has all detectors, and the minority-basis detectors of a CSS
8395 circuit (which simple=True stripped) are dropped by the binary if this is exact (see drop). The distance
8396 of the simplified circuit (a lower bound) can still be found by passing the circuit stripped with
8397 strip_minority_detectors().
8398 basis: Optional primary memory basis override ('X' or 'Z') for .stim circuits, only used with drop="css" (the
8399 other basis is that of the minority-basis detectors) and for the verbose report of the classification.
8400 rounds: Optional number of REPEAT rounds for .stim circuits (warns if no REPEAT block).
8401 out_dir: Optional output directory for saved DEM and/or Stim circuit files.
8402 out_dem: Optional bool or filename to save the constructed DEM (True = auto-named <basename>_full.dem). The
8403 codewords (outC, do_cws) index its error lines (in the order of the flattened DEM): save the DEM in the
8404 same run, since a DEM generated again from the circuit may differ (e.g., with another stim version); with
8405 outC but without out_dem, a warning is printed to stderr for a Stim circuit.
8406 out_stim: Optional bool or filename to save the processed (noisy, rounds-adjusted) Stim circuit
8407 (True = auto-named <basename>_full.stim).
8408 p_noise: Strength of the uniform circuit-level noise added to a noiseless Stim circuit (see add_noise();
8409 default: 0.001; 0: no noise is added, and a noiseless circuit gives no distance, with a note). The
8410 distance does not depend on it (unless pmin > 0), only on which faults are possible. A circuit with noise
8411 (a noise channel or a noisy measurement such as M(0.001), see has_noise()) is used as is, unless
8412 force_noise=True.
8413 force_noise: If True, the noise of a Stim circuit is replaced by the uniform noise of strength p_noise (see
8414 strip_noise(); with p_noise=0, all noise is removed, e.g., to save the noiseless circuit with out_stim),
8415 e.g., to compare circuits with the same noise model (default: False).
8416 engine: None or "dist_m4ri" (default): the dist_m4ri binary; "cert": qec_cert (certify_circuit() for a Stim
8417 circuit, certify_dem() for a DEM; with pmin > 0, certify_dem() of the DEM without the error mechanisms of
8418 probability < pmin, as the binary reads it: since version 0.17.2, before which qec_cert certified the full
8419 DEM, whose distance was cached under the key of the cut DEM); "tropidist": external `tropidist` subprocess
8420 (`python -m cdist`, passing the Stim circuit directly when `circuit` is given and `pmin <= 0` so native
8421 circuit relaxations and noiseless Stim witness replay apply, otherwise exporting the merged `(H, L)`
8422 matrices of the DEM after `pmin` and independently verifying the returned witness; `table_gb` sets its
8423 lookup-table memory budget); "auto" (since version 0.17.0, for a distance-only method=3 call with pmin=0,
8424 without outD and out_reduced; otherwise the binary): when qec_cert is available, with more than 25,000 raw
8425 error mechanisms and a timeout of at least 3 s (or 0, no limit), qec_cert first, whose exact reductions of
8426 large DEMs run before any search (the binary with the time left if qec_cert ends early with an open
8427 bracket, also with timeout=0); otherwise the two-stage portfolio of compute_quantum_distance() (the binary
8428 first, then qec_cert—or tropidist when qec_cert is unavailable and tropidist is configured—if the bracket
8429 is still open, and then the binary again with the time left); the binary only, with the whole timeout, if
8430 neither qec_cert nor tropidist is usable (a warning once per process if qec_cert is broken). With "cert"
8431 and "auto", a floor wmin > 1 is passed to qec_cert with search_opts={"force_dom": 1}, as in
8432 compute_quantum_distance() (since version 0.17.4); since version 0.17.5, a qec_cert with the handoff
8433 parameters also gets dmax_init, and with "auto" for a DEM (not for a Stim circuit, whose DEM qec_cert
8434 generates itself) the codeword of weight dmax_A found in Stage A, which qec_cert verifies on the DEM, see
8435 _cert_handoff_kw().
8436 rw_opt: Expert option (since version 0.17.0): the stages of the RW search of the binary (None, the default:
8437 the binary's -1, automatic; 0: all off, the RW of version 0.16.1; a bitmask 1..63: only the stages listed,
8438 see run_dist_m4ri()). The distance and the cache key do not depend on it (for codeword collection, see
8439 run_dist_m4ri()).
8440 dem_rounds: The rounds T of the DEM, passed to the binary (see run_dist_m4ri()): 1 adds the row slabs of
8441 rw_opt 4 to its automatic rw_opt, 2 or more excludes them, and 0 leaves the choice to the binary (a DEM
8442 without round structure and with at most 640 detectors). None (default): automatic, for a Stim circuit
8443 its rounds (see circuit_measurement_rounds(): the largest number of measurements of one qubit, e.g., 1 with
8444 rounds=0 for a circuit with one round before its REPEAT block, so that a shallow multi-round DEM whose round
8445 structure the binary does not see gets no slabs), 0 for a DEM. The distance and the cache key do not
8446 depend on it.
8447 table_gb: Optional lookup-table memory budget in GiB for `engine="tropidist"` (or `engine="auto"` when
8448 falling back to `tropidist`; 0: tropidist default; ignored with a warning for other engines).
8449
8450 Returns:
8451 tuple (dist, d_info, cws) if do_cws else (dist, d_info)
8452
8453 Raises:
8454 TypeError: for an unknown keyword argument (e.g., a misspelled option).
8455 ValueError: if neither dem nor circuit is given, for rounds without a Stim circuit (or rounds < 0), for
8456 p_noise outside [0, 0.5], for an invalid drop (e.g., a file which does not exist) or another invalid
8457 option value (e.g., start, cc_prune other than 0, 1, or 2, rw_opt outside -1..63, dem_rounds < 0, or
8458 negative table_gb), for method=2 with timeout <= 0 but without wmax, dmax, or dstop, or for do_cws / outC
8459 with solver="codedistance", engine="cert", or engine="tropidist".
8460 FileNotFoundError: if the dist_m4ri binary is not found (see find_dist_m4ri_binary()), or if a DEM or circuit
8461 file does not exist (since version 0.17.2; before, its name was read as the text of a DEM).
8462 RuntimeError: if the binary (or tropidist) exits with an error.
8463 ImportError: if stim is needed (e.g., for a Stim circuit) or solver="codedistance", engine="cert", or
8464 engine="tropidist" is requested but unavailable.
8465 """
8466 global _last_run_stats
8467 eff_dmin = dmin if dmin > 0 else d_min
8468 eff_dmax = dmax if dmax > 0 else d_max
8469 _check_kwargs(compute_dem_distance, kwargs)
8470 _check_rw_opt(rw_opt)
8471 _check_dem_rounds(dem_rounds, allow_none=True)
8472 eff_table_gb = _check_table_gb(table_gb)
8473 cert_mode = _resolve_cert_engine(solver, engine)
8474 is_codedist = solver == "codedistance" or str(engine or "").strip().lower() == "codedistance"
8475 if start_scan: # (the binary merges the equal columns of a DEM, which changes the order of the columns)
8476 _warn_ignored("start_scan=1 is not available for a DEM (ignored)")
8477 start_scan = False
8478 start_list = _prepare_start_option(start, trust_start, noscan, cbeg, cend, solver, start_scan=start_scan,
8479 engine_cert=cert_mode if cert_mode in ("cert", "tropidist") else False)
8480 _warn_cert_ignored(cert_mode, finC=finC, smax=smax, dW=dW, maxC=maxC, method=method)
8481 _warn_table_gb_unused(eff_table_gb, cert_mode, is_codedist=is_codedist)
8482 _warn_experimental_ksub(ksub, method, solver)
8483 _warn_disabled_simple_full(simple, full)
8484
8485 circ_verbose = verbose or bool(debug & PY_DBG_CIRCUITS) # Stim circuit to DEM conversion details
8486 if not 0.0 <= p_noise <= 0.5:
8487 raise ValueError(f"invalid p_noise={p_noise}: the noise strength must be in [0, 0.5]")
8488 drop_mode = _drop_mode(drop) # "auto", "0", "css", or a file name
8489 src_in = dem if dem is not None else circuit # (the input, for the names of the files of out_reduced)
8490 src_name = str(src_in) if isinstance(src_in, (str, Path)) else f"stim.{type(src_in).__name__}"
8491 css_list: List[int] = [] # the minority-basis detectors of a CSS circuit (drop=css)
8492 dem, circuit, saved_dem_path = _dem_from_input(
8493 dem, circuit, basis=basis, rounds=rounds, p_noise=p_noise, out_dir=out_dir, out_dem=out_dem,
8494 out_stim=out_stim, circ_verbose=circ_verbose,
8495 drop_out=css_list if (drop_mode == "css" and not is_codedist) else None, force_noise=force_noise
8496 )
8497 eff_dem_rounds = int(dem_rounds) if dem_rounds is not None else 0 # (the rounds of the DEM for the binary)
8498 if dem_rounds is None and circuit is not None and not is_codedist: # (1: the row slabs of rw_opt 4, >= 2: none)
8499 eff_dem_rounds = circuit_measurement_rounds(circuit)
8500 if circ_verbose:
8501 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Circuit rounds: dem_rounds={eff_dem_rounds} (the largest number of measurements of one "
8502 f"qubit; the binary's automatic rw_opt has the row slabs of rw_opt 4 only for 1)")
8503 if getattr(dem, "num_errors", None) == 0: # (a stim object; e.g., a noiseless circuit with p_noise=0)
8504 sys.stderr.write("# Note: the DEM has no error mechanisms (no noise, e.g., p_noise=0 for a noiseless circuit "
8505 "or with force_noise): no distance computed\n")
8506 return (0, [0, 0, 0], []) if do_cws else (0, [0, 0, 0])
8507
8508 if is_codedist:
8509 if do_cws or outC:
8510 raise ValueError("Codeword extraction is not supported with codedistance solver; use solver='dist_m4ri'.")
8511 if outD or out_reduced:
8512 _warn_ignored("outD and out_reduced are only used with solver='dist_m4ri'; ignored")
8513 _warn_codedistance_ignored(locals())
8514 codedistance = _get_codedistance()
8515 params = dict(codedistance_params or {})
8516 params.setdefault("filterCircuit", False)
8517 if num_steps is not None and "iterCount" not in params:
8518 params["iterCount"] = num_steps
8519
8520 try: # (k = 0: checked on the reduced DEM, merged equal columns and zero columns dropped)
8521 is_k0 = _dem_k0(dem, pmin=pmin)
8522 except Exception:
8523 is_k0 = False
8524 if hasattr(codedistance, "StimDEM2HL"):
8525 try:
8526 H_tmp, L_tmp, _ = codedistance.StimDEM2HL(dem)
8527 is_k0 = _k0_of_matrices(H_tmp, L=L_tmp)
8528 except Exception:
8529 is_k0 = False
8530 if is_k0:
8531 _k0_found("no observable independent of the detectors")
8532 return 0, [0, 0, 0]
8533
8534 if circuit is not None:
8535 res = codedistance.circuitDistance(
8536 circuit, method=codedistance_method, params=params,
8537 seed=seed if seed != 0 else None
8538 )
8539 else:
8540 dem_obj = (
8541 _get_stim().DetectorErrorModel.from_file(str(dem))
8542 if isinstance(dem, (str, Path)) and os.path.isfile(str(dem))
8543 else (_get_stim().DetectorErrorModel(str(dem)) if not hasattr(dem, "flattened") else dem)
8544 )
8545 if pmin > 0.0:
8546 dem_obj = _dem_pmin_cut(dem_obj, pmin)
8547 H, L, priors = codedistance.StimDEM2HL(dem_obj)
8548 if "priors" not in params and len(priors) > 0:
8549 params["priors"] = priors
8550 res = codedistance.codeDistance(
8551 H, L, tB=1, method=codedistance_method, params=params,
8552 seed=seed if seed != 0 else None
8553 )
8554 d = res.get("d", -1)
8555 d_info = format_bounds_list(d, d, 0) if d > 0 else [0, 0, 0]
8556 return d, d_info
8557
8558 # Solver is native multithreaded dist_m4ri (the cache key is that of the processed DEM, see get_cached_distance())
8559 if outC and circuit is not None and saved_dem_path is None:
8560 sys.stderr.write(f"# Warning: outC={outC}: the codewords index the error lines of the DEM generated from the "
8561 f"Stim circuit in this run (after the pmin cutoff), which is not saved; save it with "
8562 f"--out-dem (out_dem=...), since a DEM generated again later (e.g., with another stim "
8563 f"version) may not fit\n")
8564 fdem_run = saved_dem_path if (saved_dem_path is not None and os.path.exists(saved_dem_path)) else dem
8565 temp_files: List[str] = []
8566 try:
8567 fdrop = drop_mode # "auto", "0", or a file (drop=css: the minority-basis detectors written to a file)
8568 if drop_mode == "css":
8569 if css_list:
8570 fdrop = create_unique_file(extension="_drop.txt")
8571 temp_files.append(fdrop)
8572 with open(fdrop, "w") as f:
8573 f.write(f"# {len(css_list)} minority-basis detectors (drop=css)\n" +
8574 " ".join(str(r) for r in css_list) + "\n")
8575 if circ_verbose:
8576 print(f"[dist_m4ri] drop=css: the binary drops the {len(css_list)} minority-basis detectors if "
8577 f"this is exact")
8578 else:
8579 fdrop = "auto"
8580 _warn_ignored("drop=css: no minority-basis detectors (they are only known for a Stim circuit "
8581 "classified as CSS); using drop=auto (the detectors to drop found from the DEM)")
8582 outd_file = str(outD) if outD else None
8583 if out_reduced and outd_file is None:
8584 outd_file = create_unique_file(extension="_outD.txt")
8585 temp_files.append(outd_file)
8586 if outd_file is not None and not isinstance(fdem_run, (str, Path)): # (the same DEM file for the runs)
8587 fdem_file = create_unique_file(extension=".dem")
8588 temp_files.append(fdem_file)
8589 _write_dem_file(fdem_run, fdem_file)
8590 fdem_run = fdem_file
8591 cws_out_fn = None
8592 if expand and (do_cws or outC):
8593 def cws_out_fn(cws_in: List[List[int]]) -> List[List[int]]:
8594 return _expand_equal_columns(cws_in, fdem_run, pmin=pmin, maxC=maxC, verbose=verbose)
8595 eff_cache_file = str(Path(cache_file).resolve()) if cache_file is not None else _distance_cache_file
8596
8597 def _make_trop_dem_runner(t_budget: Optional[float]) -> Callable[[int, int], Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Any, Any]]:
8598 use_circuit = circuit is not None and pmin <= 0.0
8599
8600 def run_fn(w_lo: int, w_hi: int) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Any, Any]:
8601 if use_circuit:
8602 if _dem_k0(dem, pmin=0.0):
8603 return {"k0": "no observable independent of the detectors"}, None, None
8604 rec = _run_tropidist(
8605 circuit=circuit, w_lo=w_lo, w_hi=w_hi, threads=threads, timeout=t_budget,
8606 table_gb=eff_table_gb, debug=debug, verbose=verbose,
8607 )
8608 return rec, None, None
8609 H_csr, L_csr = _dem_to_hl_csr(dem, pmin=pmin)
8610 if int(L_csr.shape[0]) == 0 or int(H_csr.shape[1]) == 0 or _k0_of_matrices(H_csr, L=L_csr):
8611 return {"k0": "no observable independent of the detectors"}, None, None
8612 rec = _run_tropidist(
8613 H_csr=H_csr, L_csr=L_csr, w_lo=w_lo, w_hi=w_hi, threads=threads, timeout=t_budget,
8614 table_gb=eff_table_gb, debug=debug, verbose=verbose,
8615 )
8616 return rec, H_csr, L_csr
8617 return run_fn
8618
8619 if _can_delegate_to_tropidist(cert_mode, do_cws=do_cws, outC=outC, outD=outD, out_reduced=out_reduced):
8620 use_circuit = circuit is not None and pmin <= 0.0
8621 res = _tropidist_code_distance(
8622 lambda: _dem_cache_key(dem, pmin), _make_trop_dem_runner(timeout),
8623 label="DEM", is_circuit=use_circuit, dmin=eff_dmin, dmax=eff_dmax, dstop=dstop, wmax=wmax,
8624 eff_cache_file=eff_cache_file, debug=debug, verbose=verbose,
8625 )
8626 dist, d_info, cws = res["dist"], res["d_info"], res["cws"]
8627 return (dist, d_info, cws) if do_cws else (dist, d_info)
8628
8629 if cert_mode != "auto" and _can_delegate_to_cert(
8630 cert_mode, method=method, do_cws=do_cws, outC=outC, finC=finC, smax=smax,
8631 dW=dW, maxC=maxC, start_list=start_list, outD=outD, out_reduced=out_reduced, pmin=pmin
8632 ):
8633 _, _, qec_pipeline = _get_qec_cert()
8634 mode_arg = "ub" if method == 1 else "auto"
8635 t_lim = _auto_timeout(timeout)
8636 n_thr = threads or (os.cpu_count() or 8)
8637 r_seed = seed if seed != 0 else 1
8638
8639 def certify_cut(w_lo: int, w_hi: int, dmax_c: int) -> Any:
8640 func = "certify_circuit" if (circuit is not None and pmin <= 0.0) else "certify_dem"
8641 kw = dict(wmax=w_hi, threads=n_thr, seed=r_seed, time_limit=t_lim, mode=mode_arg,
8642 **_cert_handoff_kw(qec_pipeline, w_lo, func=func, search=mode_arg != "ub", dmax=dmax_c,
8643 debug=debug, verbose=verbose))
8644 if pmin > 0.0: # (qec_cert has no cutoff: it gets the DEM of the cache key, without the errors < pmin)
8645 return qec_pipeline.certify_dem(_dem_pmin_cut(dem, pmin), **kw)
8646 if circuit is not None:
8647 return qec_pipeline.certify_circuit(circuit, **kw)
8648 return qec_pipeline.certify_dem(fdem_run, **kw)
8649 res = _cert_code_distance(
8650 lambda: _dem_cache_key(dem, pmin), certify_cut,
8651 label="DEM", dmin=eff_dmin, dmax=eff_dmax, dstop=dstop, wmax=wmax,
8652 eff_cache_file=eff_cache_file, debug=debug, verbose=verbose,
8653 )
8654 dist, d_info, cws = res["dist"], res["d_info"], res["cws"]
8655 return (dist, d_info, cws) if do_cws else (dist, d_info)
8656
8657 def run_native(t_budget: Optional[float], dmin_s: int, dmax_s: int, json_out: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
8658 return _cached_code_distance(
8659 None, None, None, False, "DEM", dist_m4ri=dist_m4ri, method=method, threads=threads, timeout=t_budget,
8660 num_steps=num_steps, d_exp=d_exp, dmin=dmin_s, dmax=dmax_s, dstop=dstop, wmin=wmin, wmax=wmax,
8661 smax=smax if smax is not None else 0, start_list=start_list, dW=dW, maxC=maxC, finC=finC, outC=outC,
8662 need_cws=bool(do_cws or outC), eff_cache_file=eff_cache_file, seed=seed, debug=debug, verbose=verbose,
8663 nothrottle=nothrottle, chunk_size=chunk_size, ksub=ksub,
8664 kwin=kwin if kwin != 0 else int(kwargs.get("win", 0) or 0), win_mode=win_mode, min_hits=min_hits,
8665 cov_cws=cov_cws, refresh=refresh, trust_start=trust_start, fdem=fdem_run, pmin=pmin,
8666 merge=merge, key_fn=lambda: _dem_cache_key(dem, pmin), cws_out_fn=cws_out_fn, fdrop=fdrop,
8667 outD=outd_file, sort_rows=sort_rows, win_hyb=win_hyb, pairs=pairs, cc_prune=cc_prune, rw_opt=rw_opt,
8668 dem_rounds=eff_dem_rounds, json_out=json_out
8669 )
8670
8671 if cert_mode == "auto" and _auto_cert_eligible(
8672 method=method, do_cws=do_cws, outC=outC, finC=finC, smax=smax, dW=dW, maxC=maxC, start_list=start_list,
8673 outD=outD, out_reduced=out_reduced, pmin=pmin,
8674 ):
8675 def run_cert(dmin_s: int, dmax_s: int, cert_dmin: int, t_lim: float,
8676 dm4ri_json: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
8677 n_thr, r_seed = threads or (os.cpu_count() or 8), seed if seed != 0 else 1
8678 t_call = time.monotonic()
8679
8680 def certify(w_lo: int, w_hi: int, dmax_c: int) -> Any:
8681 _, _, qec_pipeline = _get_qec_cert() # (the import, before its time limit is counted)
8682 # (the codeword of Stage A indexes the error mechanisms of fdem_run, the DEM of the binary: not
8683 # necessarily those of the DEM which certify_circuit() generates from the circuit)
8684 func = "certify_circuit" if circuit is not None else "certify_dem"
8685 h_kw = _cert_handoff_kw(qec_pipeline, w_lo, func=func, dmax=dmax_c,
8686 dm4ri_json=dm4ri_json if circuit is None else None, debug=debug,
8687 verbose=verbose)
8688 kw = dict(wmax=w_hi, threads=n_thr, seed=r_seed,
8689 time_limit=_cert_time_left(t_lim, t_call), mode="auto",
8690 use_ub=_auto_stage_b_use_ub(dmin_s, dmax_s), **h_kw)
8691 if circuit is not None:
8692 return qec_pipeline.certify_circuit(circuit, **kw)
8693 return qec_pipeline.certify_dem(fdem_run, **kw)
8694 return _cert_code_distance(
8695 lambda: _dem_cache_key(dem, pmin), certify, label="DEM", dmin=dmin_s, dmax=dmax_s, dstop=dstop,
8696 wmax=wmax, eff_cache_file=eff_cache_file, debug=debug, verbose=verbose, certified_dmin=cert_dmin,
8697 keep_stats=True,
8698 )
8699 def run_trop(dmin_s: int, dmax_s: int, cert_dmin: int, t_lim: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
8700 use_circuit = circuit is not None and pmin <= 0.0
8701 return _tropidist_code_distance(
8702 lambda: _dem_cache_key(dem, pmin), _make_trop_dem_runner(t_lim),
8703 label="DEM", is_circuit=use_circuit, dmin=dmin_s, dmax=dmax_s, dstop=dstop, wmax=wmax,
8704 eff_cache_file=eff_cache_file, debug=debug, verbose=verbose, certified_dmin=cert_dmin,
8705 keep_stats=True,
8706 )
8707 num_err = (_dem_num_raw_errors(dem, limit=_AUTO_DEM_FAST_PATH_ERRORS)
8708 if _timeout_at_least(timeout, _AUTO_DEM_FAST_PATH_MIN_TIMEOUT) else -1)
8709 if num_err > _AUTO_DEM_FAST_PATH_ERRORS and (_qec_cert_available() or not _tropidist_available()):
8710 res = _auto_cert_first(run_native, run_cert, timeout=timeout, dmin=eff_dmin, dmax=eff_dmax,
8711 dstop=dstop, wmax=wmax, num_errors=num_err, debug=debug, verbose=verbose)
8712 else:
8713 res = _auto_two_stage(run_native, run_cert, timeout=timeout, dmin=eff_dmin, dmax=eff_dmax,
8714 dstop=dstop, wmax=wmax, label="DEM", debug=debug, verbose=verbose,
8715 run_tropidist=run_trop)
8716 else:
8717 res = run_native(timeout, eff_dmin, eff_dmax)
8718 ran = not res["cached"]
8719 drop_stats = _last_run_stats if ran else {}
8720 if outd_file is not None and res["cached"]: # a run only to find the detectors dropped (bounds coincide)
8721 if verbose:
8722 print("[dist_m4ri] Cached result: running the binary only for the detectors dropped (outD)")
8723 cached_stats = _last_run_stats
8724 run_dist_m4ri(dist_m4ri_path=dist_m4ri, method=2, fdem=str(fdem_run), dmin=1, dmax=1, wmax=1, threads=1,
8725 pmin=pmin, merge=merge, drop=fdrop, outD=outd_file, debug=debug & ~BIN_DBG_MASK)
8726 drop_stats, _last_run_stats = _last_run_stats, cached_stats # (the statistics of the cached result)
8727 ran = True
8728 if ran and fdrop not in ("auto", "0") and drop_stats.get("drop_note"):
8729 what = "the minority-basis detectors (drop=css)" if drop_mode == "css" else f"the detectors in {fdrop}"
8730 sys.stderr.write(f"# Note: dropping {what} is not exact for this DEM ({drop_stats['drop_note']}); "
8731 f"the full DEM was used\n")
8732 elif ran and fdrop not in ("auto", "0") and drop_stats.get("drop_none_listed"):
8733 sys.stderr.write(f"# Note: none of the detectors in {fdrop} is in the DEM; nothing dropped\n")
8734 if drop_mode == "css" and fdrop != "auto" and outd_file is not None and os.path.isfile(outd_file):
8735 with open(outd_file) as f: # the comment line: drop=css instead of the temporary file
8736 text = f.read()
8737 with open(outd_file, "w") as f:
8738 f.write(text.replace(f"(drop={fdrop}", "(drop=css", 1))
8739 if out_reduced and outd_file is not None:
8740 dropped, num_det = read_drop_file(outd_file)
8741 prefix = _reduced_out_prefix(out_reduced, src_name, out_dir)
8742 drop_label = "css" if (drop_mode == "css" and fdrop != "auto") else str(fdrop)
8743 dem_red, json_red = write_reduced_dem(
8744 fdem_run, dropped, prefix, pmin=pmin, num_detectors=num_det,
8745 meta={"source": src_name, "dem": saved_dem_path if saved_dem_path else
8746 (str(fdem_run) if str(fdem_run) not in temp_files else None), "drop": drop_label})
8747 if verbose or (debug & PY_DBG_CIRCUITS):
8748 print(f"[dist_m4ri] Saved the reduced DEM ({len(dropped)} detectors dropped) to '{dem_red}' and the "
8749 f"maps to '{json_red}'")
8750 finally:
8751 _remove_temp_files(temp_files, debug)
8752 dist, d_info, cws = res["dist"], res["d_info"], res["cws"]
8753 return (dist, d_info, cws) if do_cws else (dist, d_info)
